AccessLink.description: A link that opens an order, subscription, Return, or customer's account in the merchant's Flint-hosted customer account. Its purpose describes whether it signs the buyer in and how long it works. Its url is a bearer credential, returned only when the link is created.

expires_at.description: When the link stops opening the resource or signing the buyer in.

purpose.description: What the link opens and how long it works. New purposes may be added; treat one you don't recognize as opening its resource.
x-enum-descriptions: Opens an order and lets the buyer have its receipt sent again. Works for 30 days or 10 opens.
Opens a subscription without letting the buyer change it. Works for 14 days or 5 opens.
Opens a Return and its order. Works for 30 days or 10 opens.
Signs the buyer in to your Flint-hosted customer account as this customer. Works for 15 minutes and one open.

url.description: The link to send the buyer. It carries a bearer credential, so anyone with it can open the resource or sign in as the customer, as its purpose describes, until expires_at or until it reaches its open limit. The link uses the merchant's customer account host.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.
Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

AddRiskListItemsRequest.description: Provide one value or an array of values to add to the risk list.

value.description: A single value to add to the risk list. Limited to 512 characters (Unicode code points) before normalization and after normalization.

values.description: Values to add to the risk list.

items.description: Limited to 512 characters (Unicode code points) before normalization and after normalization.

expected_version.description: The gift card version last read. The command changes this card only when its current version matches.

AnalyticsOverview.description: Merchant analytics for one currency. Payments are selected by creation time (created_at) in the response timezone and counted when their current status is succeeded. All payment amounts and counts use the response currency. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

average_payment.description: Gross volume divided by payments count, rounded down to the currency minor unit. Zero when payments count is zero. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

currencies.description: Every currency with succeeded payments or counted refunds in the current window and, with include_previous_period=true, the previous window, regardless of the currency filter. Empty when neither window contains these payments or refunds.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency selected for every payment amount and count. Defaults to the merchant's default currency when the request omits currency.

gross_volume.description: Succeeded payment amounts for payments created in the window in the response timezone. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

has_multiple_currencies.description: Whether currencies contains more than one currency, regardless of the selected currency.

net_volume.description: Gross volume minus refunds total. Does not subtract processing fees, disputes, or chargebacks. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

new_customers.description: Customers created in the window in the response timezone. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

new_subscriptions.description: Subscriptions created in the window whose current status is trialing, active, paused, or past_due. Excludes incomplete subscriptions awaiting initial payment. Excludes canceled subscriptions because Flint does not record whether they started. Reflects current status, so a past window's count can drop later. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

payments_count.description: Succeeded payments created in the window in the response timezone. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

refunds_total.description: Refunds created in the window that are not failed or canceled, counted once per refund execution. Parent refunds with child executions count through the children, regardless of when the refunded payment was created. Previous values and change_percent are present only with include_previous_period=true. The previous window has the same span immediately before the current window, ending at the same wall-clock time. change_percent is omitted when the previous value is zero.

The response was requested using a checkout session credential.

order_discount_id.description: Identifier for this applied discount, unique within the order. It starts with ad_. Pass it to POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/discounts/remove to remove the discount.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code used to create this discount. Present only when source is promotion and a code was used.

promotion_id.description: Promotion that created this discount. Present only when source is promotion.

expected_version.description: Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.
Optional order version from the last order read. The mutation fails if the order changed.

expected_catalog_default_version.description: Optional catalog settings version. When provided, the profile must still be the current catalog default.

expected_version.description: Current version of the delivery profile.

default_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

max_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

max_total_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

min_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

Balance.description: Current balances for one currency at observed_at. Available and pending amounts are separate buckets and can be negative. Reserve and held amounts are excluded from available_money.

available_by_source_type.description: Signed available amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to available_money. Active payout holds reduce both available_money and one source entry by the same amount. A payout with no recorded source type uses card. A hold whose source is absent from the map uses the largest source amount, with ties broken by source name.

available_money.description: Signed amount available for payouts after active payout holds are deducted. Separate from pending_money, reserve_money, and held_money.

held_money.description: Funds set aside for payouts you created that haven't been debited from your balance yet. They aren't payable and aren't included in `available_money`.

observed_at.description: When Flint observed these amounts, as an RFC 3339 UTC instant at second precision. Stored balances retain their observation time; a fresh provider read uses the time of that read.

pending_by_source_type.description: Signed pending amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to pending_money. These amounts are separate from available_by_source_type.

pending_money.description: Signed amount awaiting availability. Separate from available_money; pending_by_source_type breaks down this amount when source details are supplied.

reserve_money.description: Amount held in reserve. It doesn't overlap available_money or held_money.

next_page_token.description: Omitted because all currency balances fit on one page.

amount_money.description: Signed gross amount of this balance movement, before any fee.

fee_money.description: Flint fee for this balance movement, never a provider cost passed through. Charges are positive; returned fees are negative. A payment of 5000 with a fee of 175 has a net amount of 4825. A payout reversal returning a fee of 25 reports fee_money -25.

net_money.description: Signed net effect on your Flint balance: amount_money minus fee_money in the same currency.

payout_id.description: Flint payout containing this balance transaction. Present after the paid payout's entries are recorded.

type.description: Kind of balance movement. Unmapped movement types are returned as other.

categories.description: Always present. Empty collections are returned as [].

component_count.description: Number of components in the bundle.

components.description: The bundle's components in position order, on every bundle response including list rows. [] only when the bundle has no components.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

modifier_set_id.description: Attached modifier set. Send null on update to remove it.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

product_name.description: Name of the product the variant belongs to.

BuyerAction.description: One thing a buyer can do with an order, subscription, invoice or return they read through /v1/me. Show the actions with is_required as what needs the buyer's attention, and the first available action as the primary action on the resource's page in your account.

due_at.description: When the buyer needs to act by. Omitted when the action has no deadline, or when the resource's state or the store's policy doesn't allow it.

is_available.description: Whether this session can take the action now.

is_required.description: Whether the store needs the buyer to take the action, such as paying a due invoice. It stays true when the only thing in the way is signing in.

kind.description: What the action is. Each resource lists its own kinds in a fixed order. New kinds may be added; ignore kinds you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: Order: start a return of delivered items with POST /v1/me/return-previews, then POST /v1/me/returns.
Order: email the receipt again with POST /v1/me/orders/{order_id}/send-receipt.
Subscription: resume a paused subscription with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/resume.
Subscription: keep a subscription set to cancel at the end of the billing period, with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/reactivate.
Subscription: change the card it charges with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/payment-method.
Invoice: pay what is due now through a checkout session from POST /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session.
Return: withdraw a return the store has not decided on, with POST /v1/me/returns/{return_id}/cancel.
Return: send or drop off the items the return's handoff_requirements list.
Return: pay what the buyer owes for an exchange or a replacement through a checkout session from POST /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-session.
Subscription: charge the past-due amount again now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/payment-retries, for example after changing the card.
Subscription: change shipping details with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/delivery.
Subscription: skip the next renewal with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/skip-cycle.
Subscription: choose an offered frequency with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/billing-interval.
Subscription: choose an offered quantity with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/quantity.
Subscription: change an eligible variant with PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/line-items/{subscription_line_item_id}.
Subscription: order the next renewal now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/renew.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the action can't be taken now. Present exactly when is_available is false. New reasons may be added; show a general message for a reason you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: The session came from an email link that opens only this resource, and the action needs the buyer to sign in. Customer sessions you create with POST /v1/customer-sessions never have this reason.
The store turned the action off, such as letting buyers pause, or its return policies don't let the buyer return these items.
The resource's current state doesn't allow the action, such as resuming a subscription that isn't paused, or returning items not yet delivered.
The return window ended for everything left on the order.
Everything delivered on the order is already in a return.
The invoice can't be paid online, such as one the store collects outside Flint.
The buyer has reached the store's maximum consecutive skipped renewals. A paid renewal resets the count.

BuyerCapabilities.description: What a store lets buyers do to their own subscriptions. Send at least one field; each field you omit takes its default.

can_update_delivery.description: Whether buyers may change the shipping address and delivery method of their physical subscriptions.

cancellation_reasons.description: Reasons a buyer is asked to choose from when canceling, in the order shown. Empty: the buyer is not asked. When the list is not empty, a buyer's cancellation_reason_code must be one of them.

cancellation_timing.description: When a subscription a buyer cancels ends. end_of_period: when the current billing period ends. buyer_chooses: the buyer picks the end of the period or right away. A trialing, paused, or incomplete subscription, or a past_due one whose missed_billing_at is before current_period_end_at (its first paid period was never paid), ends right away either way.

pause.description: Whether buyers may pause, and for how long. Omit it to let buyers pause with no limit.

retention_offer.description: The offer a buyer sees before canceling. The buyer can always decline it and cancel. Omit it for no offer.

skip.description: Whether buyers may skip renewals. Omit it to allow skipping with no consecutive limit.

BuyerCreditNote.description: The buyer-visible view of a credit note. Drafts are never returned, and how much credit is left to allocate is omitted.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

credit_note_number.description: Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft.

x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

line_items.description: Itemized corrections against frozen invoice lines. Amount and quantity corrections share each source line's remaining value, discount, and tax across issued, non-void credit notes. Drafts reserve no credit.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

status.description: draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired.

total_money.description: The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines.

email.description: Customer email, or null when the customer has none. Unique among the environment's customers.

name.description: Customer name, or null when none.

phone.description: Customer phone number, or null when none.

courier_pickup_at.description: Time at which the courier collected the order.

courier_pickup_window_duration_seconds.description: Width of the promised courier pickup window, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

courier_provider_name.description: Delivery network or merchant fleet provider handling the job.

courier_support_phone.description: Buyer-safe support number for the courier or merchant fleet.

dropoff_notes.description: Driver-facing notes for the final handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which an undelivered job should enter merchant review.

instructions.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

no_contact.description: Whether the buyer requested a no-contact handoff. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

prep_time_duration_seconds.description: Expected preparation time before courier pickup, from 0 to 86400 seconds.

ready_at.description: Time at which the order became ready for courier pickup.

tracking_url.description: Absolute HTTPS carrier tracking URL. Embedded URL credentials are rejected. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

recipient_requirements.description: Recipient fields this option asks for. A selection can leave out required fields, but payment needs them.

buyer_location.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

buyer_reasons.description: Buyer-safe reasons no delivery option was available. Merchant configuration details are never included.

destination_address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

expires_at.description: Authoritative expiry for this quote: 24 hours when every method uses fixed, tiered, or rate_table pricing, and at most 15 minutes otherwise. A cart with tracked inventory shortens it to the 5 minutes its stock check stays valid. Read this value from every response.

input_requirements.description: Inputs the delivery methods need. A quote requirement, such as the destination address, is input a method needs before Flint can price it. A selection requirement is input a delivery selection needs before payment, such as a recipient field or delivery window an option requires. A method that waits on the buyer's address or store, or on an address the buyer must correct, already lists the recipient fields it requires. Those requirements name the method's choice group and have no delivery_option_ids.

address_advisories.description: Buyer-actionable address verification results that affected this choice group. A suggested_address is an explicit correction the buyer may confirm; Flint does not apply it silently.

method_types.description: Types of the delivery methods that can serve this group's items, each listed once, in the order the methods display. A type is listed before its options are priced, such as a local delivery that waits for the buyer's address, and stays listed while its methods need more input or cannot serve the current input. options lists what the buyer can choose now. A method whose type these items do not allow is left out, and the list is empty when no method can serve them.

destination_address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

input_requirements.description: Inputs this selection still needs before payment: each recipient field a chosen option requires that the selection does not include. Each entry repeats the quote's requirement for that option, with the same delivery_input_requirement_id. Payment fails with DELIVERY_RECIPIENT_REQUIRED until a new delivery selection includes them. Empty when nothing is missing, and always empty unless status is selected.

recipient.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for displaying window_start_at and window_end_at.

checkout_session.description: The checkout session after the change. Merchant-only fields, such as metadata and external_reference_id, are omitted.

inventory_reservation.description: Omitted for checkout credentials, which cannot read the merchant's inventory reservation. Merchant credentials receive it on DeliverySelectionResult.

order.description: The order after the change. Merchant-only fields, such as external_reference_id and internal_note, are omitted.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

status.description: Active plans accept new signups. Inactive plans refuse new signups with PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE while existing subscriptions keep renewing. Archived plans are read-only and their status is set only by DELETE /v1/subscription-plans/{subscription_plan_id}.

dispatched_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached dispatched.

lifecycle_status.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle status, including accepted, on_hold, and no_show. status continues to report accepted as pending, no_show as failed, and an active hold's previous status. Omitted when the lifecycle status is unknown.

order_number.description: Human-readable number of the order this fulfillment belongs to. Omitted when the order has no number.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome details. The mark_no_show action records its reason here and returns status as failed.

packed_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached packed.

picked_at.description: First time this fulfillment reached picked.

recipient.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

request_status.description: Provider acceptance state, independent from fulfillment work progress. The accept action sets this field to accepted while status remains pending.

shipment_details.description: Shipping schedule and ship time for a shipment fulfillment. Present only on shipment fulfillments with at least one value.

status.description:
Public work status. Fulfillments with request_status accepted project to status pending. Fulfillments with outcome.outcome_type no_show project to status failed. A fulfillment with active_hold projects to its public work status from before the hold.
- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

BuyerInstructionsConfig.description: Controls buyer instructions for a delivery option. Omit it from a method configuration to disable instruction collection.

label.description: Checkout field label, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

placeholder.description: Checkout field placeholder, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

required.description: Whether the buyer must enter instructions before selecting the option. Requires enabled=true.

active_payment_attempt.description: The payment attempt in progress for this invoice, such as a bank debit still processing. Omitted when none is open. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

balance_rows.description: What changed after the invoice was issued, in display order, such as late fees, payments, credit notes, and write-offs. When present, rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `outstanding_money`. The opening `total` row contributes to the sum; the closing `amount_due` row is informational and states it. `[]` when nothing changed or the invoice is void. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the invoice: pay. pay is available when a checkout session can take a payment now, and then required, due by due_at or by the due date of the installment it collects.

collection_mode.description: How the invoice is collected: buyer_initiated, automatic, or external. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Numbering is per merchant, with test and live mode numbered independently.

issue_rows.description: The rows of the invoice's totals as issued, in display order. Rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money`. A closing `total` row is informational and states that sum. Show the rows in order without merging or summing them. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Omitted when the merchant set none. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

payment_option_cost_comparison.description: A payment option that costs the merchant less to accept for this invoice, with the estimated savings. Present when the invoice's payment policy turns on `show_cost_comparison` and Flint can compare the options. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

payment_options.description: Ways the buyer can pay this invoice online, leaving out any option whose limit the amount exceeds. `[]` when it can't be paid online. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

status.description: Current status of the issued invoice.

theme.description: The theme Flint's hosted invoice page renders with, from your branding settings. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

version.description: Current invoice version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

reused_existing.description: True when an existing checkout of the requested surface was reused. For POST /v1/checkout-sessions and payment link resolve, true when a retry with the original Idempotency-Key returns the session that request created.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the order, in this order: start_return, then resend_receipt. A buyer's read through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists both every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. A list of orders leaves start_return out, since only a read of one order checks return eligibility. start_return is due when the last open return window ends.

buyer_contact.description: Email and phone saved when payment started, from the pay request's buyer_contact or the paying checkout session's saved contact. It does not change the linked customer.

delivery_destination.description: The shipment or local-delivery destination committed for this order. Payment freezes this value; fulfillment recipient changes do not replace it. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order, including pickup choices without a delivery destination. Read with GET /v1/orders/{order_id}; other order responses may omit this field. While present, change the destination through the delivery selection. Omitted when no selection governs the order.

payment_link_id.description: Payment link whose checkout created this order. Absent for orders that did not come from a payment link. Filter GET /v1/orders by payment_link_id to list a link's orders.

return_credit_settlements.description: Value applied to this order from items the buyer returned, such as an exchange's replacement order. Included in settlement_amounts.paid_money.

return_resolution_id.description: ID of the return resolution that created this order as a replacement. Omitted for orders a return did not create.

subscription_cycle.description: Charged subscription cycle associated with this order. Signup is cycle 1; unpaid retries and skipped renewals do not advance the cycle.

subscription_delivery_changed_at.description: Time the subscriber changed delivery after this paid renewal was prepared. The order keeps its committed destination until you correct it or refund and replace it.

ticketed_event.description: Event and tickets this order sold through an event payment link. Absent on other orders.

version.description: Order version for optimistic concurrency. Send this value as the expected version when changing the order.

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment requirements fixed when the line item was created. direct describes a single item; components describes each bundle component. Omitted for older line items without recorded requirements.

fulfillment_quantities.description: Current quantities for each required fulfillment obligation: one entry for a single item or one per bundle component that requires fulfillment. Quantities use line units for single items and component units for bundles. required_quantity equals unassigned_quantity + assigned_quantity + fulfilled_quantity + canceled_quantity + failed_quantity. Omitted when the line needs no fulfillment or the order's obligations cannot be computed, including older lines without recorded requirements.

purchased_gift_cards.description: Masked card identities for fully funded units of this purchase line. Partial consideration does not issue a card.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

refunded_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

subscription.description: Recurring offer and cadence frozen for this line at signup.

subscription_id.description: Subscription created for this line after the order is paid.

subscription_offer.description: Applicable active offer for a one-time line, or the offer terms frozen for a subscribed line.

version.description: Version to send as expected_version when changing gift_card_recipient or replacing modifiers. Checkout-session reads return the checkout modifier version for modifier choices.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

is_resumable.description: Whether the attempt can continue through PayOrder with action: resume and this order_payment_attempt_id after any pending client action is complete. If false, check status before starting another payment; the attempt may still be in progress.

last_payment_error.description: The concluded failure of a payment leg that failed this attempt. Absent for non-payment failures.

payment_method_save.description: Set when the pay request sent save_payment_method: true and the attempt paid without saving the payment method. A card typed into checkout and saved has no entry here; read payment_method_save on the checkout session for a card saved with a mobile phone number.

status_reason.description: Non-payment reason an attempt failed, was canceled, or expired. Failed attempts with an unmapped non-payment reason report other. Canceled and expired attempts include a reason only when it adds information beyond status. New values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: The coupon could not be reserved.
The gift card balance could not be reserved.
The selected payment source is invalid.
The order changed before payment started.
The payment customer does not match the order.
The attempt failed for another non-payment reason.
The confirmation request was rejected before a payment outcome.
The payment link capacity could not be claimed.
The payment link capacity could not be validated.
The payment method is awaiting activation.
The payment option is not allowed.
The payment source could not be assigned.
The payment source conflicts with this attempt.
The payment source cannot be updated.
The payment source belongs to another customer.
The resources required for payment could not be secured.
The payment setup action is unavailable.
The payment setup hold could not be acquired.
The payment setup result is incomplete.
The tip allocation could not be synchronized.
The resources for a zero-balance payment could not be secured.

automatic_profile.description: Identifies which automatic tax behavior applies to this order. connected means the account's tax connection calculated it. standard marks an order calculated before automatic tax required a tax connection.

price_mode.description: Whether the order's prices include tax (`inclusive`) or tax is added to them (`additive`). Present on every order Flint renders after 2026-10-20; a response replayed for an idempotent retry of an earlier request omits it. Each line item and charge also states its own mode in `tax.calculation.price_mode`, which decides that item's tax.

address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

BuyerPauseCapability.description: Whether buyers may pause their own subscriptions. Send at least one field.

enabled.description: Whether buyers may pause. When false, a buyer's pause returns PAUSE_NOT_ALLOWED.

max_cycles.description: The longest pause a buyer may choose, in billing periods. When set, a buyer's pause must send pause_duration_cycles from 1 to this value. Omit it for no limit, which also lets a buyer pause until they resume.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Capture is unavailable at or after this time, even if the payment still has requires_capture status.

capturable_money.description: Payment intent's stored capturable amount. A positive amount does not override authorization_expires_at or the payment status.

selected_payment_option.description: Payment option used by this leg, using the same values as PaymentIntent.selected_payment_option. Fixed when the attempt becomes terminal. Omitted when no payment option has been selected.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. No webhook is sent for this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. cancellation_reason is authorization_expired, and the payment_intent.canceled event reports it.

BuyerPaymentCollectionStripeElements.description: Stripe Elements collection guidance. Follow next_step in the browser, then submit the result to submit_to through Flint.

mode.description: Whether Elements is collecting a payment source for an immediate payment or a setup source for future use.

next_step.description: Browser collection operation to perform before calling submit_to.

payment_method_creation.description: Stripe Elements payment method creation mode. Follow next_step: standalone PaymentIntents and checkout-authenticated order collection create a ConfirmationToken, while merchant-authenticated order collection and setup collection create a PaymentMethod.

submit_to.description: Flint operation that accepts the result of next_step.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

message.description: Flint-authored merchant-facing payment failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

BuyerPaymentIntent.description: A payment as the buyer sees it. Omits the store's fees, net, risk assessment, and dispute state.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected.

authorization_expires_at.description: When the hold lapses if it hasn't been collected. Set when the hold is placed.

authorized_at.description: When the processor authorized the payment. Absent until then.

authorized_money.description: The amount the processor authorized. It always equals amount_money and doesn't change once set. Absent until the payment is authorized, and on payments canceled before authorization.

cancellation_reason.description: Flint-normalized reason the payment intent was canceled. Unknown processor values are returned as payment_canceled.

capturable_money.description: The part of the authorization that can still be collected. Positive only while status is requires_capture, and zero after it is collected, released, or expires. Absent until the payment is authorized.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold on the payment method. The merchant collects all or part of it, or releases it, before authorization_expires_at.

captured_at.description: When money was captured. For automatic capture, this is when the payment succeeded. Absent until capture.

captured_money.description: The amount collected from the buyer. Zero while a hold is open, and positive whenever status is succeeded. Absent until the payment is authorized.

checkout_session_id.description: Flint checkout session ID associated with this payment, when present.

current_payment_action.description: Typed browser authority for the current standalone payment action. Complete it, then call the same confirm endpoint without a replacement credential. Null when no buyer action is needed, and always null for a credential without the payments.payment_intents.write scope. With that scope, it can also be null while status is requires_action if Flint cannot produce the action yet; retrieve the payment intent again.

customer.description: The linked customer. Returned only with expand=customer.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment_hold.description: Present when a payment provider asked Flint to pause fulfillment for this payment. While its status is active, open fulfillments on the order are on hold.

invoice.description: The linked invoice. Returned only with expand=invoice.

invoice_id.description: Invoice this payment intent collects, when it pays an invoice.

last_payment_error.description: Most recent payment error. Null when no payment error is recorded.

merchant_id.description: Merchant that owns this payment intent.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint and aren't returned.

order.description: The linked order. Returned only with expand=order.

payment_flow.description: How the payment was started. Fixed when the payment is created.
x-enum-descriptions: Started in a Flint checkout session.
The first payment of a subscription.
Entered in the Dashboard virtual terminal.
Created through the merchant's API integration.

payment_options.description: Payment options the buyer can use for this payment.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

receipt_email.description: Email address for this payment's receipt. When it isn't set, Flint uses the customer's email.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

refunded_money.description: Total of refunds against captured_money that the processor has accepted, including refunds still pending. Failed and canceled refunds aren't counted. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

released_money.description: The part of the authorization returned to the buyer without being charged: the uncollected remainder after a partial capture, or the whole authorization after a cancellation or expiry. It was never collected, so it needs no refund. Absent until the payment is authorized.

return_id.description: Flint return ID associated with this payment, when present.

selected_payment_option.description: The payment option the most recent confirmation used. Absent until the payment intent is first confirmed.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Submit payment details again to retry.
Payment details are attached, but the payment hasn't been confirmed yet. This status is brief unless the confirmation was interrupted.
A step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, must be finished before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step.
Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly.
A hold is in place on the payment method and no money has been collected. The merchant collects some or all of it, or releases it, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected. Final. cancellation_reason says why when it is known. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.
A hold reached authorization_expires_at without being collected, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. cancellation_reason is authorization_expired.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money.

transaction_purpose.description: Why a bank debit is taken. Set only when payment_options includes ach_debit, and fixed once the payment intent exists.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

failure_reason.description: Why a refund failed or a payment refund was canceled. Failed and canceled amounts become refundable again. Fix the cause, then create a new refund with a new idempotency key. Unknown provider values are returned as refund_failed.
x-enum-descriptions: The card can no longer receive credits.
The card was reported lost or stolen.
The refund could not be funded.
Your available balance could not cover the refund.
The card issuer declined the credit.
The refund was stopped at the merchant's request.
The payment is under dispute, or a bank return took the money back first. The buyer already has it through their bank.
On partially_succeeded: one or more payment refunds failed. Read payment_refunds.
This payment refund was canceled before it was attempted because another payment refund failed.
The refund failed with no more specific reason.

idempotency_key.description: Present only on refunds created through POST /v1/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/refunds: the Idempotency-Key of that call. Use it with GET /v1/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/refunds?idempotency_key= to recover a refund whose create response was lost.

refund_method.description: Where the money goes. Always original_payment today: refunds go back to the tenders that paid. Gift card replacement destinations are reported in tender_allocations.

status.description: Summary of payment_refunds and tender_allocations. Only failed is final: succeeded and partially_succeeded can still change when a bank rejects a refund after accepting it. Follow refund.updated.
x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

BuyerRetentionOffer.description: The offer a buyer sees before canceling. Send at least one field.

kind.description: none: no offer. pause_instead: offer to pause for pause_cycles billing periods instead of canceling. pause_instead needs pausing turned on.

pause_cycles.description: Billing periods the offered pause lasts. Required when kind is pause_instead, and at most pause.max_cycles when that is set. Not allowed with kind none.

Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.

Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. No webhook is sent for this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.

BuyerSkipCapability.description: Whether buyers may skip renewals. Send at least one field.

enabled.description: Whether buyers may skip a renewal. Merchant credentials may always skip an eligible cycle.

max_consecutive_skips.description: Maximum consecutive cycles a buyer may skip. Omit it for no limit. The count resets after a paid renewal.

BuyerSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: A retry of a past-due payment on the buyer's subscription. Includes, when available, the buyer's order and a failure they can act on. Omits the store's idempotency keys and payment attempt IDs.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

swap_variants.description: Current sellable alternatives in swap_variant_ids order, excluding the line's own variant and variants priced in a different currency. Present on variant lines, including an empty array.

BuyerSubscriptionRenewalResult.description: The renewal result projected for the buyer, using the same subscription and order fields as the corresponding /v1/me reads.

device_name.description: Optional compatibility field for the computer name sent by released Flint CLI versions. Accepted and ignored.

platform.description: Optional compatibility field for the operating system sent by released Flint CLI versions. Accepted and ignored.

scope.description: Required space-separated public API scope names. Only requested scopes approved in the browser are granted. Normal login sends x-flint-cli-bootstrap-scopes; explicit requests may use x-flint-cli-allowed-scopes. Unsupported scopes return invalid_scope.

Optional space-separated subset of the consented scopes for this access token. Omit to use the full grant or context scopes. Does not change consent.

failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

- `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time.

order_payment_attempt_id.description: Owning Flint payment attempt ID. Required while the payment leg belongs to an active attempt.

handback_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

cancel_immediately.description: When true, ends the subscription now instead of at the end of the billing period. A buyer, in Flint's buyer account or with a customer session, may send it only when the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_timing is buyer_chooses; otherwise the request returns CANCEL_IMMEDIATELY_NOT_ALLOWED. A trialing, paused, or incomplete subscription, or a past_due one whose missed_billing_at is before current_period_end_at (its first paid period was never paid), ends now either way.

cancellation_comment.description: Free text about the cancellation, up to 500 characters after surrounding spaces are trimmed. Recorded in cancellation_details.comment, which only merchant credentials read.

cancellation_reason_code.description: Optional. Why the subscription is being canceled. When the store lists customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_reasons, a reason a buyer sends must be one of them; merchant credentials may send any code. Recorded in cancellation_details.reason_code.

CapabilityReadiness.description: Merchant capability readiness for a payment or money movement capability.

capability.description: Flint-owned capability name. Payment capabilities describe transaction acceptance readiness; money movement capabilities describe payout and balance movement readiness.
x-enum-descriptions: Collect customer payments through ACH debit.

domain.description: Product domain this capability belongs to: payments for payment acceptance or money_movement for balances and payouts.

next_actions.description: Actions that can remediate or refresh this capability when Flint can suggest one.

requirements.description: Merchant requirements that affect this capability.

status.description: Current readiness status for this capability.

order_payment_attempt_id.description: Owning Flint payment attempt ID. Required while the authorization belongs to an active attempt.

amount_money.description: Amount to capture, in the authorization's currency. Omit it to capture all of capturable_money. A smaller amount is a partial capture: Flint releases the rest in the same request, and the payment intent can't be captured again. Must be greater than zero and at most capturable_money. Affirm payments can only be captured in full.

cash_out_reference.description: Your reference for the cash you paid the buyer outside Flint, such as a receipt number. Required; 1 to 255 characters. The value is preserved exactly as sent.

Payment requests do not accept null.

email.description: Email for the buyer, such as buyer@example.com. On checkout session updates, null clears the saved email.

address_autocomplete_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers address suggestions while the buyer enters an address.

billing_address.description: The customer's default billing address. Omitted when the customer has none.

False when the merchant turned checkout.saved_payment_details off, customer accounts are merchant hosted, card is not an available payment option, the checkout collects an invoice, a subscription, or a return, or the checkout acts for no customer and Flint cannot email the buyer a verification code.

True while Flint can send texts and either save_payment_method_requires_verification is true, so the number replaces confirming an email before paying, or the checkout acts for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed with this credential, so the number joins that customer's saved details once the buyer confirms it.

fulfillment.description: Current fulfillment choices for Flint-owned pricing. merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant for help: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. A checkout whose payment is approved stays open until the capture.

problems.description: Named conditions that affect checkout completion. When Flint cannot read the checkout's delivery, the read still succeeds and reports delivery_unreadable; its remediation says whether reading the session again can succeed, and its next action's reason_code names the error.

recovery_expires_at.description: RFC3339 deadline for the restricted payment-attempt recovery window.

recovery_payment_attempt_id.description: Payment attempt that this checkout credential may recover while is_in_recovery is true.

Present only on reads with the session's checkout credential. A credential other than the one a confirmation returned, such as the hosted checkout link opened on another device, reads true. Send the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications. False while the checkout acts for a customer, and whenever can_save_payment_method is false.

save_payment_method_types.description: What save_payment_method keeps, present when can_save_payment_method is true: card, a card the buyer types into checkout. The values can grow.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

Omit it to use the purpose's default: auto for use_saved_payment_methods, and email for gift_card_purchase and save_payment_method. email emails the code. With use_saved_payment_methods, it answers the same whether or not the email has saved details. sms texts it: for use_saved_payment_methods, to the mobile phone number saved with the email's details; for confirm_saved_payment_method, to the number given with the payment. auto, for use_saved_payment_methods only, lets Flint pick from the email's saved details: it texts the number they carry, or, when they carry none, emails the code when the email has cards saved by email, and sends nothing otherwise, returning CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_SENT. The response's channel says which. Required for confirm_saved_payment_method, which takes sms or email, and gift_card_purchase and save_payment_method take only email.

By sms, Flint texts the number saved with the email's details. confirm_saved_payment_method: after a payment that sent save_payment_method_phone, the buyer confirms the card it saved.

charges.description: Named order charges to refund. Allowed with refund_type amount or targets. In amount mode their value must fit within amount_money; Flint allocates the rest.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

gift_card_load_id.description: Allowed with refund_type full or amount. Original standalone gift card funding load paid by a Flint payment. Refunds its paid consideration and removes the corresponding eligible unspent face value. Requires Idempotency-Key; cannot be combined with order, line item, charge, tax or tender targets.

line_items.description: Named order line items to refund. Allowed with refund_type amount or targets. In amount mode their resolved value must fit within amount_money; Flint allocates the rest.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API.

order_id.description: Order to refund. May be combined with payment_intent_id to select a payment on that order. Required for named targets unless payment_intent_id belongs to an order.

payment_intent_id.description: Payment to refund. May be combined with its order_id. Named targets require a payment on an order.

reason.description: Optional. When omitted, no reason is recorded or sent to the processor, and the buyer's refund email has no reason line.

refund_type.description: Required amount mode: full refunds the full remaining amount; amount requires amount_money and permits named targets and tender_allocations within that amount; targets refunds named line_items, charges, or tax_breakdown_refunds without amount_money. Full and targets do not accept tender_allocations. Gift card loads support full and amount only.

tax_breakdown_refunds.description: Named order tax breakdowns to refund. Allowed with refund_type amount or targets. In amount mode their value must fit within amount_money; Flint allocates the rest. Requires commerce.refunds.tax_overrides.write.

tender_allocations.description: Exhaustive allocations to original tenders. Allowed only with refund_type amount. Amounts must sum to the required amount_money. Selected line-item, charge and flat-tax components must be covered by their original tenders. Additional untargeted value follows the default tender order. Gift card destinations default to original. Select replacement when the original card is closed or cannot accept the full credit within its balance cap.

gift_card_codes.description: Replacement card codes recovered only within 24 hours of the original command and only while each code remains current. Omitted after the recovery window and never returned by ordinary refund reads or events.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

failure_reason.description: Why a refund failed or a payment refund was canceled. Failed and canceled amounts become refundable again. Fix the cause, then create a new refund with a new idempotency key. Unknown provider values are returned as refund_failed.
x-enum-descriptions: The card can no longer receive credits.
The card was reported lost or stolen.
The refund could not be funded.
Your available balance could not cover the refund.
The card issuer declined the credit.
The refund was stopped at the merchant's request.
The payment is under dispute, or a bank return took the money back first. The buyer already has it through their bank.
On partially_succeeded: one or more payment refunds failed. Read payment_refunds.
This payment refund was canceled before it was attempted because another payment refund failed.
The refund failed with no more specific reason.

gift_card_codes.description: Replacement card codes recovered only within 24 hours of the original command and only while each code remains current. Omitted after the recovery window and never returned by ordinary refund reads or events.

idempotency_key.description: Present only on refunds created through POST /v1/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/refunds: the Idempotency-Key of that call. Use it with GET /v1/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/refunds?idempotency_key= to recover a refund whose create response was lost.

refund_method.description: Where the money goes. Always original_payment today: refunds go back to the tenders that paid. Gift card replacement destinations are reported in tender_allocations.

status.description: Summary of payment_refunds and tender_allocations. Only failed is final: succeeded and partially_succeeded can still change when a bank rejects a refund after accepting it. Follow refund.updated.
x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

unissued_gift_card_recoveries.description: Cash returned after an unissued gift card purchase refund failed. Return it through a new refund against payment_intent_id and order_line_item_id. It does not issue another card. Source remaining and pending amounts describe the entire original settlement allocation; repeated entries for that source are not additive.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency. Reports never combine currencies. gift_card_liability_v1 supports USD only; other currencies return REPORT_CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED.

interval_end_at.description: Exclusive report interval end instant. Each report type matches its own occurrence time. At most the same local time 366 calendar days after interval_start_at in timezone. Must not be in the future.

interval_start_at.description: Inclusive report interval start instant. Each report type matches its own occurrence time.

report_type.description: Which report to generate. The value names the row and the column version, such as payments_itemized_v1. The Reports guide lists each type's rows, interval matching, and columns.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for timestamps and date bucketing. A payout occurs at the start of its arrival_date in this timezone. Defaults to UTC.

scopes.description: The scopes to grant. Send either scopes or scope_preset.

subscription_plan_id.description: Limit the migration to this plan's live subscriptions.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

product_ids.description: Catalog targets for new signups. At least one product or variant is required.

promotion_id.description: An active promotion with forever recurrence. On PATCH, null removes the discount for new signups; omission keeps it.

status.description: Use active or inactive. Archive the offer with DELETE.

subscription_delivery_method_ids.description: Delivery methods offered at signup. An empty array uses the store's checkout defaults. Existing subscriptions keep their selected method.

variant_ids.description: Catalog targets for new signups. At least one product or variant is required.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

images.description: The complete desired gallery in display order. The first image is primary. Send [] to clear the gallery.

inventory_routing_source.description: Where tracked demand from this plan is routed: a fixed Location, an allocation policy, or an immutable policy revision. Required when any line item tracks inventory. New subscriptions and payment links for the plan copy it, unless the payment link sends its own.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API.

status.description: Active plans accept new signups. Inactive plans refuse new signups with PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE while existing subscriptions keep renewing. Archived plans are read-only and their status is set only by DELETE /v1/subscription-plans/{subscription_plan_id}.

oneOf.description: Flint owns the renewal date. billing_anchor_day is allowed only in this branch.
The integration owns the renewal date. billing_anchor_day is not allowed.
The merchant default selects the owner. Owner-specific sibling fields are not allowed.

billing_anchor_day.description: UTC day of the month used for monthly and yearly billing. Applies only to Flint-owned schedules.

enabled_events.description: Event types to deliver. Send ["*"] for every type the endpoint's event_sources deliver, including types added later; * must be the only entry and is not available with installed_merchants. At least one entry is required. Previous event type names from the 2026-10 rename are accepted for one release and are stored and returned under their new names. See the [changelog](/docs/changelog).

event_sources.description: Event sources this endpoint receives. Defaults to merchant. Use partner_app for app lifecycle events and installed_merchants for events from merchants that installed the partner app.

installed_merchant_modes.description: Modes of installed-merchant events this endpoint receives. Required when event_sources includes installed_merchants and omitted otherwise. Partner app lifecycle events are delivered regardless of these modes.

partner_app_id.description: Partner app that owns partner_app or installed_merchants event sources.
