CreditNote.description: A correction against an issued invoice. Credit notes reduce what is owed; refunds return what was already collected.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

credit_note_number.description: Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again.

line_items.description: Itemized corrections against frozen invoice lines. Amount and quantity corrections share each source line's remaining value, discount, and tax across issued, non-void credit notes. Drafts reserve no credit.

memo.description: Free text shown on the credit note, up to 4096 characters.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

status.description: draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired.

total_money.description: The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines.

unallocated_money.description: Credit still available to allocate. Equals total_money at issue, falls as credit is applied, and rises again when an allocation is reversed.

version.description: Current credit note version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

CreditNoteAllocation.description: One application of credit to the invoice. Allocations are append-only: a reversal sets reversed_at rather than removing the row.

amount_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice balance.

idempotency_key.description: The key the caller sent when allocating. It is this allocation's identity and is filterable on the allocations list.

reversed_at.description: When the allocation was reversed and its credit returned. Absent while the allocation stands.

CreditNoteAllocationResult.description: The allocation, the credit note with its new unallocated_money, and the recomputed invoice.

amount_money.description: Positive billed value to credit in the invoice currency, no more than the frozen source line's remaining value. Consumes proportional remaining tax and discount without consuming quantity; later quantity corrections use the reduced remaining value.

quantity.description: Positive whole units; fractional quantities are not supported. No more than the source line's remaining uncredited quantity. Credits that fraction of its remaining billed value, rounded half up once at line level. Earlier amount corrections reduce that remaining value without consuming quantity. A share that rounds to zero is rejected; use a larger quantity or a positive amount.

type.description: quantity credits whole units and requires quantity. amount credits a named figure and requires amount_money. The two are mutually exclusive.

CreditNoteLineItem.description: One correction calculated from the frozen invoice line's remaining billed value, discount, and tax. The source line's inclusive or additive tax mode is preserved. Current catalog prices and tax settings do not affect the correction. Stored issued values are never recalculated by a read.

credit_note_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the credit note line item.

discount_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining allocated merchandise discount, rounded half up in currency minor units.

invoice_line_item_id.description: The invoice snapshot line this corrects.

name.description: Label of the credited invoice line.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

subtotal_money.description: Credited subtotal before the credited discount, in the source line's inclusive or additive price units. Balances the total after tax and discount are rounded from the remaining pool; it is not a rounded per-unit price.

tax_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining tax, rounded half up in currency minor units. Included tax is already part of total_money. Tax-exclusive consideration is total_money minus tax_money.

total_money.description: Billed value credited by this line. For inclusive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money. For additive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money plus tax_money. A full remaining-value correction consumes the exact remaining components.

credit_note_line_item_id.description: Existing credit note line item to retain. Omit to create a new line item.

active_payment_attempt_count.description: Payment attempts in progress whose hosted checkout started on this hostname. Present for checkout domains.

redirect_expires_at.description: End of the 30 day redirect window for a removed hostname.

email.description: Customer email, or null when the customer has none. Unique among the environment's customers.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this customer in an external system, or null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

internal_note.description: Internal note about this customer, or null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

is_merchant_verified.description: Flag you set on the customer, for example after checking ID in store. Promotion and delivery rules can match it. Flint does not set it; it is unrelated to customer verifications, which prove a buyer controls an email address.

name.description: Customer name, or null when none.

phone.description: Customer phone number, or null when none.

segment.description: Free-form label you assign, such as wholesale, so promotion and delivery rules can match groups of customers. It is not an ID; Flint does not check it against any resource. Null when none. Not returned to customer sessions.

custom_domain.description: An exact hostname such as pay.example.com. Omission keeps the current hostname. Null removes it and starts the redirect window. Send null to clear it.

buyer_capabilities.description: What buyers may do to their own subscriptions in Flint's buyer account or through a customer session, in either mode. Merchant credentials are not bound by it. Buyers can always cancel. Written as a whole: an update that includes buyer_capabilities replaces the stored value, and each field it omits takes its default. Effective settings include every default.

phone.description: E.164 phone number. Limited to 30 characters (Unicode code points).

checkout_reminders.description: A reminder after leaving checkout without paying.

customer_id.description: Flint customer ID fixed by the customer session.

shipping_updates.description: Emails about shipments and deliveries, such as shipped, out for delivery, and delivered.

status.description: pending while the code can be confirmed; confirmed while an unused proof can link purchases; used after linking; expired when the code or proof expires.
x-enum-descriptions: The code has not been confirmed and has not expired.
The code was confirmed and the unused proof has not expired.
The verification was used to link purchases.
The code or confirmed proof expired.

expected_version.description: Optional version of the parent Return. A stale value returns RETURN_VERSION_CONFLICT with the current Return version.

completion_mode.description: Omit to use the mode shared by all pinned policies that set completion_mode, or automatic when no pinned policy sets one. Conflicting pinned policy modes return 400 naming completion_mode. An explicit manual or automatic value is used as sent.

suggested_address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

state.description: State, province, or region. State conditions read it as a subdivision of the address's country: send its code with or without the country prefix, such as NY or US-NY. In the US and Canada, the English name, such as New York, also matches. US addresses also accept the USPS military codes AA, AE, and AP. If the address country is listed by a state condition but state names no subdivision of that country, the condition cannot be decided: the method or rate is left out as cannot_calculate (invalid_buyer_input).

earliest_date.description: Calendar date in the option timezone. Do not parse it as a UTC timestamp.

latest_date.description: Calendar date in the option timezone. Do not parse it as a UTC timestamp.

preparation_lead_time_seconds.description: Notice the merchant needs before a window starts, in seconds. A buyer can choose a window until this long before it starts. Quotes offer only windows that can still be chosen, so a window already under way is not offered.

DeliveryBuyerLocationResource.description: The normalized buyer address or coordinate used for this quote.

base_fee_currency_options.description: Base delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

per_item_handling_fee_currency_options.description: Handling fee per item by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

base_fee_currency_options.description: Base delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

maximum_fee_currency_options.description: Maximum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

minimum_fee_currency_options.description: Minimum delivery fee by ISO currency code. Each key must equal the Money object's currency.

failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry.
- `callback_circuit_open`: Restore the callback and wait for circuit recovery before retrying.
- `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry.
- `callback_unavailable`: Retry when callback capacity is available, restore the configured callback endpoint, or choose a non-callback pricing strategy.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `option_lifetime_too_short`: Lower the method's minimum option lifetime below the quote's remaining lifetime. A quote for a cart with tracked inventory lasts just under 5 minutes.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `invalid_configuration`: Correct the invalid delivery configuration identified by diagnostics, then retry.
- `invalid_buyer_input`: Correct the buyer input identified by the outcome, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

- `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location.

- `method_type_not_allowed`: Choose a method type allowed by every line item in the choice group.
- `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price.
- `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory.

values.description: Postal codes, each with its country. Flint compares codes in uppercase without spaces or hyphens. An exact value matches that code, and a prefix value matches every code that starts with it. A five-digit ZIP code in the US or a US territory also matches the ZIP+4 codes within it, so 07030 matches 07030-5788, which address verification returns for a full address. A ZIP+4 value matches only that ZIP+4.

A method that waits on the buyer's address or store, or on an address the buyer must correct, already lists the recipient fields it requires. Those requirements name the method's choice group and have no delivery_option_ids.

allowed_types.description: Required as a non-empty unique list when requirement is required. quote accepts shipment, pickup, and local_delivery. manual accepts digital and service.

combination_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls which delivery obligations can share a choice group.

dimensions.description: Optional dimensions of one unit of the item. Delivery pricing does not use dimensions. Forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual.

origin_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden for none or manual resolution. fixed_location requires location_id. inventory_routing forbids location_id and applies only to tracked inventory. method_origin forbids location_id.

requirement.description: Whether delivery planning applies. none forbids every other configuration field. required also requires resolution_mode and allowed_types, plus the fields required by that resolution mode.

resolution_mode.description: Required when requirement is required. quote plans physical delivery and requires origin_policy, combination_policy, and splitting_policy. manual supports digital and service items and forbids physical planning fields.

splitting_policy.description: Required for quote resolution and forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual. Controls whether a line item quantity can be split across delivery assignments.

weight.description: Optional physical weight used by quote planning. Forbidden when requirement is none or resolution_mode is manual.

active_method_definitions_count.description: Number of active delivery methods whose type is allowed by this profile.

covers_all_items.description: True when this is the physical catalog default and every active physical catalog obligation uses it.

locations_without_rates_count.description: Number of active Locations that no active delivery method compatible with this profile can use as an origin.

unassigned_locations.description: Up to 20 active Location IDs that no compatible active delivery method can use as an origin. Use locations_without_rates_count for the complete count.

unassigned_locations_truncated.description: True when more matching Locations exist than are returned in unassigned_locations.

zone_country_count.description: Number of distinct countries explicitly named by zones referenced from compatible active delivery methods.

buyer_location.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

delivery_quote_version.description: Version of the order's delivery details evaluated by this quote.

destination_address.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

eligibility_context_version.description: Version of the checkout eligibility context evaluated by this quote.

expires_at.description: Authoritative expiry for this quote: 24 hours when every method uses fixed, tiered, or rate_table pricing, and at most 15 minutes otherwise. A cart with tracked inventory shortens it to the 5 minutes its stock check stays valid. Read this value from every response.

input_requirements.description: Inputs the delivery methods need. A quote requirement, such as the destination address, is input a method needs before Flint can price it. A selection requirement is input a delivery selection needs before payment, such as a recipient field or delivery window an option requires. A method that waits on the buyer's address or store, or on an address the buyer must correct, already lists the recipient fields it requires. Those requirements name the method's choice group and have no delivery_option_ids.

revocation_reason.description: Why the quote was revoked: the reason on the delivery revocation that fenced a dependency this quote used. Present when status is revoked.

execution_legs.description: Where the group's items leave from, one leg per origin Location, when all of its methods leave from the same Locations. Omitted when the origin depends on the chosen method, such as shipping from a warehouse or picking up at a store. Each option then lists its own execution_legs.

method_types.description: Types of the delivery methods that can serve this group's items, each listed once, in the order the methods display. A type is listed before its options are priced, such as a local delivery that waits for the buyer's address, and stays listed while its methods need more input or cannot serve the current input. options lists what the buyer can choose now. A method whose type these items do not allow is left out, and the list is empty when no method can serve them.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

recommendation_priority.description: Marks this method as recommended. Within each choice group, the available method with the lowest value is recommended and listed first. Ties go to the lower display_position, then the method ID. Null never recommends the method.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

circuit_failure_count.description: Consecutive callback failures since the last successful response.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

secret.description: Initial signing secret. Returned only by the create response.

DeliveryRateCallbackConfigurationPatchIn.description: Only the keys you send change; keys you leave out keep their current values. Null restores a key's default, as each field describes. The result must be a configuration you could create. Requires expected_version. An empty configuration is invalid.

failure_category.description:
Why the callback connection check failed and the action that can make the next check succeed.
- `authentication_or_http_error`: Return a 2xx status for a signed request. A 401 usually means the wrong secret or a body parsed before verification.
- `blocked_target`: Use a public HTTPS callback target allowed by Flint's outbound network policy.
- `connection_error`: Restore network connectivity to the callback host, then test again.
- `dns_error`: Fix the callback hostname or its DNS records, then test again.
- `invalid_response`: Return a 2xx application/json response within maximum_response_bytes. For a test delivery, the body must also follow the callback response rules. Then test again.
- `request_error`: Flint couldn't complete the request for another reason. Check the URL and your server logs, then test again.
- `timeout`: Acknowledge the callback within its configured timeout, then test again.
- `tls_error`: Fix the callback certificate and TLS configuration, then test again.

email.description: Recipient email address. Limited to 254 characters (Unicode code points), counted before surrounding whitespace is trimmed. When the selected delivery option requires it, payment needs it: send it with this selection or a later one. Send null to clear it.

name.description: Recipient name. Limited to 200 characters (Unicode code points), counted before surrounding whitespace is trimmed. When the selected delivery option requires it, payment needs it: send it with this selection or a later one. Send null to clear it.

phone.description: Recipient phone number. After surrounding whitespace is trimmed, use + followed by 7 through 15 ASCII digits, with a nonzero first digit. Limited to 16 characters (Unicode code points), counted before trimming. When the selected delivery option requires it, payment needs it: send it with this selection or a later one. Send null to clear it.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

values.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, such as US-NY or DE-BY. For a US state or Canadian province you can send the two-letter code, such as NY or ON, and Flint stores US-NY or CA-ON. USPS military codes AA, AE, and AP are also accepted and stored as US-AA, US-AE, and US-AP. An address matches when its state names one of these subdivisions of its country, whether it was sent as NY, US-NY, or New York. If the address country is listed by the condition but state names no subdivision of that country, the condition cannot be decided: the method or rate is left out as cannot_calculate (invalid_buyer_input).

x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: The resource has no customer, and an access link opens a resource only for its customer. Set customer_id on orders before payment to link their buyers to them and to their returns.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED: The merchant hosts its own customer account, so Flint has no account page for an access link to open. Show the resource in your own account with a customer session, or set customer_account.mode to flint_hosted.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT: The stored account-provisioning configuration is not supported by this application release. Contact Flint support to repair the account setup configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_REPAIR_REQUIRED: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SETUP_UNAVAILABLE: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACH_BILLING_DETAILS_REQUIRED: The ACH debit confirmation token is missing the billing name or billing email. Collect the buyer's billing name and email, create a new confirmation token, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACH_MANDATE_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: The ACH debit confirmation token does not include the buyer's online mandate acceptance. Collect the buyer's mandate acceptance in the payment form, create a new confirmation token, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACH_TRANSACTION_PURPOSE_UNRESOLVED: ACH debit cannot be offered because the order's line items do not show whether the purchase is for goods or services. Include a physical or digital product line item, or use service products for every line item that is not a fee. Otherwise collect payment without ACH debit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: The resource's current state does not allow this action. Branch on details[0].reason; fall back to current_status for unknown reasons and use supported_actions when present.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_BUNDLE_COMPONENTS_IMMUTABLE: An active bundle cannot replace its components. Set the bundle to inactive, then replace components using the latest version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGE: An active payment link cannot add, remove, or change the key or catalog source of its line items. Keep every existing payment_link_line_item_id with its key, variant_id, and bundle_id, or set status to inactive before replacing line items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_OPTION_SELECTOR_COLLAPSE: The option replacement would make active variant selections indistinguishable. Keep enough active options and values to distinguish every active variant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ACTIVE_VARIANTS_REQUIRE_OPTION_BACKFILL: An active option cannot be added while active variants lack a selection for it. Inactivate the variants or backfill their option selections before adding the active option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AFFIRM_REFUND_RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED: A failed provider refund already exists for this Affirm payment. Do not create a new provider refund. Use an alternative reimbursement and reconcile the failed Refund.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ALREADY_EXISTS: A resource already occupies the requested key or slot. Use details[0].current_resource, or choose another key or slot.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMBIGUOUS_AUTH: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_ABOVE_MAX: A unit_price_overrides amount is above the line item's max_unit_price_money. Send an amount at or below the line item's max_unit_price_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_BELOW_LIMIT: The amount is below the minimum allowed for the payment option. Send an amount at or above the payment option's minimum, or use a different payment option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_BELOW_MIN: A unit_price_overrides amount is below the line item's min_unit_price_money. Send an amount at or above the line item's min_unit_price_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The manual payment is larger than the invoice's collectible balance. Retrieve the invoice and record an amount_money no greater than its collectible balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT: The amount exceeds the maximum allowed for the payment option. Send a smaller amount or use a different payment option. The error message says whether the merchant can raise the limit or must contact support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The refund amount is more than what remains refundable on the order, payment, line item, or charge. Reduce the amount named by param. For a line item or charge, details[0].maximum_money gives the remaining refundable amount and currency; otherwise read the order's settlement amounts. To refund the full remainder, set refund_type to full and remove amount_money, line_items, charges, tax_breakdown_refunds, and tender_allocations.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment processor's amount for this payment intent no longer matches Flint's record. Do not retry the confirmation. Contact support with the request_id and the payment intent ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: unit_price_overrides names a line item whose price buyers cannot change. Remove the line item from unit_price_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_NOT_UPDATABLE: amount_money cannot change once a payment source is attached or confirmation is attempted. Create a new payment intent with the new amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The amount exceeds the maximum payment amount. Send an amount no greater than the maximum stated in the error message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL: The amount is below the minimum payment amount for the currency. Send an amount of at least the minimum stated in the error message, in minor units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ALREADY_REVOKED: The API key is already revoked. Retrieve the API key to confirm its status. Revocation is permanent; create a new key if you need an active credential.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_CHANGED: The API key changed before the update or revocation could be applied. Retrieve the API key, review its current state, and retry the action if it still applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_MANAGEMENT_FORBIDDEN: The user's merchant role does not allow API key management. Ask a merchant owner or admin to create the key, or use a credential whose role can manage API keys.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.API_VERSION_RETIRED: The requested API version has retired. Set Flint-Version to a supported version listed in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.APPLICATION_METHOD_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ATTRIBUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The attribute is not available for this merchant's risk rules. Use another attribute from the risk attribute registry. The error message explains why this one is unavailable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Authentication is required to complete this request. Complete the authentication described by the error message and next_actions before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PAYOUT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_PROMOTIONS_DISABLED: Automatic promotions are turned off in the merchant's promotion settings. Set promotions.automatic_enabled to true with PATCH /v1/settings first, or stop turning on automatic promotions in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_CATEGORY_UNSUPPORTED: The default line item tax category is not supported while automatic tax is connected. Set tax.default_line_item_tax_category to general, physical_goods, prepared_food, digital_goods, software, saas, services, or professional_services.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_CHARGE_UNSUPPORTED: Automatic tax cannot calculate this taxable order charge. Automatic tax taxes only charges whose tax category is shipping or delivery. A charge without charge_tax_category takes delivery from delivery_fee, shipping from shipping_fee, service_fee from service_fee, and handling from handling_fee; other types take none. details[].param names the field that set the category; order_charge_id identifies an existing charge. Set charge_tax_category to shipping or delivery if the charge is one, or mark it not taxable, remove it, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_COMPONENTS_FORBIDDEN: The tax calculation includes components in automatic mode. Omit components, or use external mode with caller-supplied components. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_CONNECTION_REQUIRED: Automatic tax needs an active tax connection for the account. Connect automatic tax in the dashboard's tax settings, use external tax, or turn tax off.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_DELAYED_CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTE: Automatic tax requires the order payment to be captured immediately. Pay with payment intents that use automatic capture, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_EXEMPTION_UNSUPPORTED: Automatic tax cannot apply a customer tax exemption. Use external tax for an exempt customer, or remove the customer exemption before retrying automatic tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_INCLUSIVE_PRICING_UNSUPPOR: Automatic tax cannot calculate tax-inclusive prices. Set price_mode to additive, or use external tax for tax-inclusive prices. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_INVOICE_INSTALLMENTS_UNSUP: An automatic tax invoice cannot be split into installments. Send a single full-balance schedule entry, omit schedule_entries, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_MULTIPLE_DESTINATIONS: Automatic tax found more than one buyer destination for taxable components. Ship or deliver every taxable item to one address, pick up every taxable item at one store, split the items into separate orders, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_MULTIPLE_ORIGINS: Automatic tax found more than one seller origin. Fulfill every taxable item from one location, split the items into separate orders, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_ORIGIN_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: A location the order ships or is picked up from has no country or postal code. Add a country and postal code to the location named in the message, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_PARTIAL_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTE: An automatic tax invoice takes one payment for the full balance. Record or collect the full outstanding balance in one payment. To correct a manual payment, reverse the full applied amount, then record the correct payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_POST_TAX_DISCOUNT_UNSUPPOR: Automatic tax cannot calculate a post-tax subtotal discount. Use subtotal_pre_tax for the discount calculation basis, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: Automatic tax requires the order to be paid with one payment intent. Select a single payment intent for the full balance, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.AUTOMATIC_TAX_UNAVAILABLE: Automatic tax is temporarily unavailable for this account. Use external tax for this order or contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BILLING_ANCHOR_DAY_NOT_SUPPORTED: The billing cadence does not support a billing anchor day. Remove billing_anchor_day for daily or weekly billing. Use it only for monthly or yearly billing.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BILLING_INTERVAL_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other billing intervals for this subscription. Change it only when the subscription's billing_interval_options lists more than one option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENTS_REQUIRED: An active bundle requires at least one component. Include at least one valid component or create the bundle as inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_PRODUCT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a product that is not active. Use a variant whose parent product is active, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_COMPONENT_VARIANT_NOT_ACTIVE: A bundle component references a variant that is not active. Use an active variant, or keep the bundle inactive.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUNDLE_NOT_SELLABLE: The bundle is inactive or its component configuration cannot be sold. Choose an active, sellable bundle or correct its component configuration before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUYER_FULFILLMENT_CORRELATION_FORBIDDEN: Buyer credentials cannot set merchant-owned fulfillment correlation fields. Remove external_system and external_reference. Set merchant correlation from a server-authenticated request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.BUY_X_GET_Y_REQUIRED: The stored promotion has no buy_x_get_y configuration. Set application_method on the promotion before applying this change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CALCULATION_BASIS_FORBIDDEN: calculation_basis was sent for a charge that uses a fixed amount. Omit calculation_basis for amount_money charges. Send it only with percent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CALCULATION_BASIS_NOT_APPLICABLE: Service charge promotions do not use a calculation basis. Omit application_method.calculation_basis when discount_class is service_charge.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCELLATION_COMMENT_TOO_LONG: The cancellation comment is longer than 500 characters. Send a cancellation_comment of 500 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCELLATION_REASON_DUPLICATE: The store's cancellation reason list names a reason twice. List each cancellation reason once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCELLATION_REASON_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The store's cancellation reason list has more than 8 reasons. Send at most 8 cancellation_reasons, each standard code once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCELLATION_REASON_NOT_OFFERED: The buyer chose a reason the store does not ask about. Send one of the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_reasons, or omit cancellation_reason_code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_IMMEDIATELY_NOT_ALLOWED: The store ends a buyer's cancellation when the billing period ends. Omit cancel_immediately to cancel at the end of the billing period. The store can let buyers choose with customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_timing buyer_chooses.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_CANCEL_EXPIRED_PAYMENT: The payment intent has expired and cannot be canceled. Retrieve the payment intent to confirm its status. An expired payment intent needs no cancellation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_CANCEL_SUCCEEDED_PAYMENT: The payment intent has already succeeded and cannot be canceled. Create a refund to return the funds instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_PAUSE: The subscription cannot be paused in its current status. Fetch the subscription and pause it only from an active state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_RESUME: The subscription cannot be resumed in its current status. Fetch the subscription and resume it only from a paused state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_RESUME_INITIAL_PAYMENT_PENDING: The subscription is still waiting for its initial payment. Complete or recover the initial payment instead of resuming the subscription.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CANNOT_RESUME_PAST_DUE_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: The past-due subscription must recover through payment. Update the payment method and create or await a payment retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITIES_IMMUTABLE: The requested capabilities differ from the ones account setup already started with. Omit requested_capabilities, or send the same capabilities as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITY_DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED: A requested capability needs another capability that the request does not include. Add the capability named in the error message, such as receive_payouts for accept_card_payments, or omit requested_capabilities to use the default set.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITY_NOT_REQUESTED: The operation needs a capability that has not been requested for this merchant account. Check readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant. For accept_ach_debit_payments, add ach_debit to the checkout or invoice payment options with PATCH /v1/settings. For other capabilities, contact Flint support.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPABILITY_SET_UNSUPPORTED: The requested onboarding capability combination is not supported by Flint's current merchant-account configuration. Request accept_card_payments and receive_payouts together. You may also include accept_ach_debit_payments, or omit requested_capabilities to use the default set.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPTURE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURABLE: The requested capture exceeds the authorization's current capturable amount. Use an amount no greater than capturable_money, or omit amount_money to capture the available authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPTURE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment was already captured for a different amount. Read the payment intent. Retry only with amount_money equal to the captured amount, because no further capture is possible.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CAPTURE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The requested capture currency differs from the authorization currency. Send amount_money in the capturable authorization currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_INVENTORY_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID: The catalog item's inventory configuration is inconsistent. Correct the catalog item's inventory relationship before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_CURRENCY_CHANGED: The catalog item's currency no longer matches the order line item. Use a catalog item in the order's currency, or create a new order in the catalog item's current currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_FIELDS_READ_ONLY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CHANGED: The order line item's catalog source no longer matches the current variant. Remove the line item and add the current variant to the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CATALOG_MODIFIERS_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHALLENGE_FAILED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHALLENGE_TOKEN_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHARGE_NAME_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHARGE_NOT_ON_ORDER: A charge in the request does not belong to the order or has no settled amount to refund. Use an order_charge_id from the order's charges that was collected by a succeeded payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHARGE_TARGETS_EXCEED_REFUND_AMOUNT: The charges in the request add up to more than the refund amount_money. Raise amount_money to at least the charge total, or omit it to refund exactly the named charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED: Checkout authentication was rotated before payment work became durable. Refresh the checkout session through its owning invoice or checkout entry point, then resume the same payment attempt if it remains available.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED: The checkout already acts for a customer, so it needs no code. Save or pay with that customer's cards without a code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_CHANGED: The order's customer is not the customer this checkout session was created for. Create a new checkout session for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_CONFLICT: The checkout customer does not match the order's customer. Omit customer_collection.customer_id or send the order's customer_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_NOT_SET_ON_ORDER: The checkout names a customer, but the order has no customer. Set customer_id on the order first, or omit customer_collection.customer_id, then create the checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_DISCOUNT_ID_NOT_ALLOWED: Checkout buyers cannot apply discounts by resource ID. Provide the buyer-facing promotion code instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_DISCOUNT_NOT_REMOVABLE: Checkout buyers can remove only promotion-code discounts. Remove a buyer-applied code discount or ask the merchant to change other discounts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_MANUAL_DISCOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED: Checkout buyers cannot create manual discounts. Apply a promotion through checkout, or create the manual discount with merchant authentication.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_ORDER_UPDATE_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: The checkout credential cannot update this order field. Send only requested_tip or tax, or use a merchant credential for other order fields.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_PAYMENT_METHOD_STATUS_UNSUPPORT: A checkout session can list only active payment methods. Omit status or set it to active.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_EMAIL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Checkout reminder emails need a business address on the merchant, which the reminder prints. Set address on the merchant with PATCH /v1/merchant, then turn checkout.recovery_email.enabled on again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_REPLACEMENT_REQUIRES_ORDER: replace_checkout_session_id is only valid when creating an order-backed checkout session. Send replace_checkout_session_id together with order_id, without quick_pay_item or subscription_plan_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SAVED_PAYMENT_DETAILS_REQUIRES_: Saved payment details for checkout can only be configured for a merchant. Send checkout.saved_payment_details in a merchant-scoped settings update.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_CURRENT_CHANGED: The session named by replace_checkout_session_id is no longer the order's current open session. Refresh the session identified by current_checkout_session_id and blocking_resources before retrying the replacement.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_EXPIRED: The checkout session closed, so it cannot be used for this request. Create a new checkout session for the order and continue through it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_MODIFIERS_READ_ONLY: This checkout session cannot modify line item modifiers. Inspect reason: existing_order_checkout uses the existing Order, invoice_finalized uses a finalized Invoice, and subscription_terms_locked uses locked subscription terms. Update the source resource when its state allows changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_MODIFIER_FIELDS_ONLY: Checkout sessions can only update line item modifiers or an unfunded gift card recipient. Send only modifiers or gift_card_recipient, each with expected_version, or use an API key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_NOT_OPEN: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_REQUIRED: The request could not be authenticated. Send a valid Flint credential supported by this endpoint, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_REVISION_CONFLICT: The checkout session line item's modifiers changed after the version you supplied. Show the current state from details[0], then retry with its current_version as expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The checkout credential cannot use this mode or checkout session. Use the credential issued for this checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The checkout session request sets more than one of quick_pay_item, order_id, or subscription_plan_id. Send exactly one of quick_pay_item, order_id, or subscription_plan_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SESSION_UPDATE_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWE: The credential cannot update this checkout session field. Send buyer_contact and timezone with the session's checkout credential, and metadata or external_reference_id with a merchant credential.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: Hosted checkout collects an order with one payment method, and the order has more than one unpaid payment leg. Cancel each leg in payment_intent_ids with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/cancel, then create the session again so hosted checkout collects the balance in one payment. To take a split payment, collect it in your own payment UI, for example under an embedded checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: A payment is in progress on this checkout, so its surface can't change. Finish or cancel the payment on existing_checkout_session_id, or request the session's current surface.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_TAX_CALCULATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout session reached its tax calculation limit. Start a new checkout session or contact the merchant before calculating tax again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_TIPPING_DISABLED: Tipping is disabled for this checkout session. Continue without a tip or start a checkout session with tipping enabled.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CHECKOUT_TIP_NOT_ALLOWED: The requested tip is not available for this checkout session. Choose one of the checkout session's configured tips or enable custom tipping.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CODES_NOT_ALLOWED: Codes can only be set on a promotion whose redemption_type is code. Remove codes, or set redemption_type to code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CODE_EMPTY: The promotion code is empty. Send a code of 1 to 100 printable characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CODE_TOO_LONG: The promotion code is longer than 100 characters. Send a code of 100 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COMPONENT_REQUIRED: A bundle component entry is missing. Replace the empty entry with a valid component or remove it from the array.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: The write lost internal contention while the caller's basis was still current. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_RETURN_URL_INVALID: The ConfirmationToken contains a malformed payment return URL. Create a new ConfirmationToken using the exact payment_collection.stripe.return_url.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_RETURN_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: The ConfirmationToken return URL does not match this payment's active Flint relay. Create a new ConfirmationToken using the exact payment_collection.stripe.return_url for this payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_RETURN_URL_REQUIRED: The ConfirmationToken does not contain Flint's payment return relay URL. Create a new ConfirmationToken using the exact payment_collection.stripe.return_url.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED: The confirmation token was already used for a different payment intent. Create a new confirmation token for this payment intent and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_EXPIRED: The confirmation token has expired. Create a new confirmation token and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The confirmation token was not found for this merchant and environment. Create a new confirmation token for this merchant in the same environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_SDK_REQUIRED: The confirmation token was not created by the payment processor's browser SDK, which this payment option requires for buyer authentication. Create the confirmation token in the browser with the payment processor's client SDK, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONTRACT_TERM_REQUIRED: An early termination fee requires a contract term. Set contract_term_months, or remove early_termination_fee_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONTRACT_TOO_LONG: The contract term is longer than 120 months. Send a contract_term_months value from 1 through 120.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CONTRACT_TOO_SHORT: The contract term is shorter than one month. Send a contract_term_months value from 1 through 120.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COUNTRY_IMMUTABLE: The country differs from the one account setup already started with. Omit country, or send the same country as the earlier request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.COUNTRY_REQUIRED: A country is required to start live account setup. Send country as the business's uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, such as US.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREATE_ORDER_LINE_ITEM_DISCOUNT_UNSUPPOR: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_ALREADY_REVERSED: The credit note allocation was already reversed. Read the allocation to confirm its reversed_at value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The allocation exceeds an available balance. Allocate no more than the credit note's unallocated amount and the invoice's outstanding amount. When required_money is present, the invoice must keep the order's unpaid tip outstanding: allocate up to that limit, collect the remaining balance, then refund the rest of the note once the invoice is paid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CREDITABLE: The correction exceeds the invoice line's remaining creditable value. Reduce the correction amount or quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The correction or refund currency does not match the invoice or credit note. Use the invoice or credit note currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_ISSUE_IN_PROGRESS: Another credit note is being issued for this merchant. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key after the current issue finishes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_LINE_EXCEEDS_INVOICE_LINE: The correction exceeds the invoice line's quantity or billed amount. Use a quantity or amount no greater than the frozen invoice line's quantity or total_money.amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_DRAFT: Only draft credit notes can be changed. Create a new draft credit note for another correction.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_ISSUED: The credit note is not issued. Check current_status. Issue a draft before allocating it, refunding it, or downloading its PDF. Only issued notes can be voided, and void notes cannot be allocated or refunded.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_REFUND_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: The refund exceeds the available credit. Use an amount no greater than the credit note unallocated_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CREDIT_NOTE_REFUND_INVALID: The credit note refund request is invalid. Use a paid invoice and a caller-chosen idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The amount uses a different currency from the resource it applies to. Send the amount in the currency of the invoice, order, payment, or plan it belongs to.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CURSOR_MISMATCH: The webhook stream resume values disagree. Send either Last-Event-ID or after_event_id, or make both values identical.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_MODE_CONFLICT: The customer account fields do not match the selected mode. Send merchant_account_url and route_templates only with merchant_hosted mode, and presentation only with flint_hosted mode.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_URL_REQUIRED: Merchant-hosted customer accounts need a merchant account URL. Send customer_account.merchant_account_url with customer_account.mode merchant_hosted.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_ALREADY_APPROVED: The customer's deletion has already been approved. Retrieve the latest deletion request to check its status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_BLOCKED: The customer still has subscriptions or saved payment methods that could remain operational after account deletion. Cancel every non-canceled subscription and remove every saved payment method, then retry approval.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_PROCESSING: The customer is being deleted and cannot be changed. Wait for the deletion to finish, or use a different active customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: The deletion request's status does not allow this decision. Retrieve the deletion request. A failed request can only be approved again; repeat an applied decision only to retrieve its result.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_DELETION_STATE_CHANGED: The customer changed while the deletion request was being resolved. Retrieve the deletion request and try again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_BUYER_MANAGED: this customer's email is their sign-in for your store's Flint-hosted account, so only the customer can change it Create a customer session for this customer with POST /v1/customer-sessions, then create the change with POST /v1/me/email-change-requests and the new email. The customer confirms it with the codes Flint emails them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: The customer has no email address, so there are no email preferences to read or change. Add an email to the customer, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_ID_NOT_CLEARABLE: customer_id cannot be cleared from a payment intent. Send a customer ID, or omit customer_id to keep the current customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_NOT_UPDATABLE: customer_id can only be updated before a payment source is attached. Omit customer_id, or create a new payment intent for the other customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_METHOD_MISMATCH: The saved payment method belongs to a different customer than the payment intent. Use a payment method owned by the payment intent's customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_TERM_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice has no customer default payment term to use. Attach a customer with a default invoice payment term, or choose another payment_due.type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_SESSION_REFRESH_EXPIRED: The customer session refresh token is invalid or expired. Authenticate the buyer again and mint a new customer session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_SESSION_REFRESH_REUSED: A rotated customer session refresh token was presented again, so the session family was revoked. Authenticate the buyer again and mint a new customer session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The verification is already confirmed. Link the purchases with this verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: The verification has no confirmation attempts left. Request a new verification code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong, has expired, was replaced by a newer code, or has no tries left, the checkout was confirmed again after the code was used, the email or number is past its limit on wrong tries, or the customer changed its email or number or was deleted after the code was sent. Enter the code from the latest email or text, or request a new code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EMAIL_CHANGED: The customer's email changed after verification. Request a code for the customer's current email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED: A code that confirms a saved card goes to the number given with the payment, or to the customer's email, so the request names no email. Remove email and send channel sms or email.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The customer verification expired. Create a new customer verification and confirm its code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The checkout has requested as many codes of this channel as it can: 5 emailed codes, or 6 texted-code requests. After a texted-code request, send the code by email instead; otherwise continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: The customer verification has not been confirmed. Confirm the Flint-sent code before linking guest purchases.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout does not offer saved payment details. Read the checkout session and request a code only when save_payment_method_requires_verification is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_SENT: Flint sent no code for a use_saved_payment_methods request with channel auto, the default: the email has no saved details at this merchant, a cap on codes was reached, or codes can't be sent right now. Show nothing about saved details, and let the buyer pay without them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_PURPOSE_MISMATCH: The customer verification has another purpose. Create a verification with purpose link_guest_purchases.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE: Flint can't text a code for this checkout: the email has no details saved with a mobile phone number at this merchant, a cap on texts was reached, or texts can't be sent right now. Offer the emailed code instead, or continue without saved details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_USED: The customer verification was already redeemed. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key, or create and confirm a new verification.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED: No custom domain of this type is set. Set a hostname before validating it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The customer account hostname's payment method domain is not ready for Apple Pay and Google Pay in this environment. Flint registers the hostname as a payment method domain when you set it. Find it with GET /v1/payment-method-domains and read validation_status and payment_options: unavailable means Flint couldn't read a wallet's status, for example while the environment's payment account isn't ready, and action_required means the registration or one of its wallets isn't active. Then set customer_account.presentation.custom_domain again, which checks the registration again; if you send an idempotency key, use a new one. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Custom domains are not active for this account. Activate custom domains, then set the custom domain again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_UNAVAILABLE: The custom domain is in use by another account, as the other custom hostname, or in another environment. Use a different hostname, or remove it where it is set and then set it again. If another account used it, verify ownership after that account removes it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_FIELD_KEY_TOO_LONG: A custom field key is longer than 243 characters. Shorten custom_fields[].key to 243 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_FIELD_KEY_WHITESPACE: A custom field key has leading or trailing whitespace. Remove the leading and trailing whitespace from custom_fields[].key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTION_TOO_LONG: A dropdown custom field option is longer than 4,096 characters. Shorten each custom_fields[].options entry to 4,096 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.CUSTOM_FIELD_OPTION_WHITESPACE: A dropdown custom field option has leading or trailing whitespace. Remove the leading and trailing whitespace from each custom_fields[].options entry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED: The merchant has no default live environment configured. Configure a default live merchant environment before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATIONS_MANAGED_EXTE: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_INVALID: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REPLACEMENT_R: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_PAYOUT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_ARCHIVED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_SANDBOX_CANNOT_BE_RESET: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_VARIANT_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_CALCULATION_EXPIRED: The calculation behind the delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_CALLER_RATES_UNAVAILABLE_TO_BUY: This checkout requires a rate supplied by the merchant server. Create the delivery quote from the merchant server and then let the buyer select from the resulting options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_COMMERCE_TREATMENT_UNSUPPORTED: The selected delivery obligations require incompatible commerce treatment. Change the delivery method or obligation configuration so the selected quantities share compatible tax, currency, and destination treatment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: The delivery configuration does not satisfy its typed contract. Fix the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DEPENDENCY_REVOKED: A pinned delivery dependency was revoked and can no longer authorize a new quote or selection. Publish or select a replacement configuration revision, then create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: The delivery address is incomplete. Provide line1, city, and country, plus state and postal_code for US addresses, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_CONTROLLED_BY_SELEC: The current delivery selection controls the order's delivery destination. Change or clear the delivery selection instead of updating delivery_destination directly.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_COUNTRY_INVALID: The delivery address country is invalid. Use a two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_FIELD_TOO_LONG: A delivery destination field exceeds its maximum length. Shorten the field identified by param and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_FROZEN: The order's delivery destination can no longer be changed. Read the current order and use fulfillment recipient corrections for execution changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_INVALID: The delivery destination is invalid. Fix the destination field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_NOT_APPLICABLE: This order has no shipment or local delivery that can use a delivery destination. Remove delivery_destination or add a line item with a shipment or local-delivery obligation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_DESTINATION_UPDATE_CONFLICT: The delivery destination update is ambiguous. Send delivery_destination as an object to replace it or null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_ELIGIBILITY_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The delivery eligibility context changed. Request a new delivery quote and retry. Request a new delivery quote and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_REUSED: The delivery external reference is already bound to another selection. Reuse the existing selection or submit a new external reference.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_FIELD_NOT_SUPPORTED: The request includes a field that does not apply to this delivery resource. Remove the field identified by param and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_GROUPING_UNSUPPORTED: The delivery obligations cannot form a valid set of buyer choices. Change the assigned delivery profiles, origin policies, or splitting rules before creating another quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_MERCHANT_INPUT_REQUIRED: This delivery input requires merchant authentication. Create the quote from the merchant server with an API key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_METHODS_NOT_APPLICABLE: The payment link has no line item that can use a delivery method. Clear delivery_method_ids, or use a catalog-backed line item with an applicable delivery profile.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_ALREADY_SELECTED: The selected delivery option belongs to another selection. Read the current selection, then retry with its ID as the compare-and-swap value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_EXPIRED: The selected delivery option or its guarantee expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_OPTION_NOT_IN_CHOICE_GROUP: The selected option does not belong to the specified choice group. Use an option ID from the same choice group in the quote response.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed during the pickup search. Read the current delivery selection and retry with its ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_AVAILABILITY_INVALID: The pickup availability input is invalid. Fix the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PICKUP_LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The requested pickup location is not available for the configured delivery methods. Choose a pickup location from the configured collection and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PREVIEW_INVALID: The delivery preview input is invalid. Fix the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PREVIEW_METHOD_TYPES_INCOMPATIB: The requested methods cannot fulfill at least one line item's allowed fulfillment types. Change delivery_method_ids or line_items[].fulfillment.allowed_types so at least one requested method supports each line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PREVIEW_REQUIRES_CHECKOUT: The requested preview depends on checkout-only state. Create or update a checkout session, then request a checkout delivery quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_PROFILE_NOT_APPLICABLE: The selected delivery profile does not apply to the component product type. Use a delivery profile that supports the referenced product type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_BASIS_INVALID: The pending quote no longer matches the supplied checkout inputs. Create a new quote from the current checkout inputs.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_EXPIRED: The delivery quote or one of its options expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INCOMPLETE: The delivery quote still requires caller input or rates. Supply every input or caller-supplied method result requested by the pending quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INPUT_CHANGED: The selected destination conflicts with address facts used by the quote. Create a new delivery quote using the selected destination.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_INVALID: The delivery quote input is invalid. Fix the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_REVOKED: The delivery quote was revoked. Create a new quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_QUOTE_STALE: The quote no longer matches the current checkout authority. Create a new delivery quote and retry the selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RATE_CALLBACK_SECRET_ROTATION_O: The delivery rate callback's previous signing key is still valid from an earlier rotation. Retry after previous_key_expires_at. If the current key leaked, revoke it, then rotate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RECIPIENT_REQUIRED: The delivery selection is missing recipient details that the selected delivery requires. Create a delivery selection that includes every field named by details[].param, with the current selection's ID as expected_delivery_selection_id, then retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_REQUEST_INVALID: The delivery request does not satisfy the endpoint contract. Fix the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another write changed the delivery resource while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the delivery resource again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_CHANGED: The current delivery selection changed after the request basis was read. Read the effective selection, create a replacement-basis quote, and retry with its exact selection ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_EXPIRED: The delivery selection expired before payment began. Create a new delivery quote, select a current option, and retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_INCOMPLETE: The selection does not choose one option for every choice group. Submit exactly one choice for every choice group in the quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_NOT_MUTABLE_AFTER_PAY: The delivery selection can no longer be changed after payment begins. Read the current order and continue with its committed delivery selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_SELECTION_REPLACEMENT_LIMIT_REA: This checkout reached its protected delivery selection history limit. Finish or restart the checkout. Terminal private payloads become eligible for redaction after their retention period.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_STATE_CONFLICT: The delivery resource is not in a state that allows the operation. Read the current resource and choose an operation valid for its lifecycle state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_STATUS_COMBINATION_INVALID: A delivery status change must be requested separately from other mutable fields. Send status and expected_version in their own PATCH request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_UPDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow buyers to change subscription delivery. Ask the store to update the preference or enable customer_account.buyer_capabilities.can_update_delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_WINDOW_EXPIRED: The selected delivery window expired. Create a new delivery quote and select a current window.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DELIVERY_WINDOW_INVALID: The selected window was not offered by the chosen delivery option. Use a delivery_window_id from the selected option, or omit it when the option does not require a window.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_NOT_CURRENT: demo_session_id is not this client's current demo session. Send the current session's demo_session_id, which ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS returns, or create a demo session when none is active.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: The description is longer than this resource allows. Shorten the description to the maximum length in the error message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_ARCHIVED: The device is archived and cannot be changed. Use the ID of an active device.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DEVICE_LOCATION_MISMATCH: The device does not belong to the given location. Send a device_id assigned to location_id, or change location_id to the device's location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISCOUNTED_ITEM_RULES_REQUIRED: The promotion needs discounted_item_rules to identify what it discounts. Add application_method.discounted_item_rules. A line_item promotion can omit them only when its eligibility_rules use line_item conditions alone.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISCOUNT_NOT_REMOVABLE: The discount comes from an automatic promotion, which applies while the order qualifies. Make the promotion inactive to stop applying it. Merchant discounts and code discounts can still be removed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DISPLAY_NAME_TOO_LONG: The promotion display_name is longer than 255 characters. Send a display_name of 255 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_CONFIG_NOT_APPLICABLE: Donation amount settings apply only to donation payment links. Remove donation_suggested_amount_money_options, donation_min_amount_money, and donation_max_amount_money, or create the link with payment_link_type set to donation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_LINE_ITEMS_NOT_ALLOWED: A donation payment link cannot include line_items. Remove line_items. Flint creates the donation line item for a donation payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_LINE_ITEM_MISSING: The donation payment link has no line item with an adjustable price to hold the donation amount settings. Replace line_items with a line item that sets allow_unit_price_adjustment to true, then update the donation amounts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_PLAN_NOT_ALLOWED: A donation payment link cannot use a subscription plan. Remove subscription_plan_id, or use a payment_link_type other than donation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_PROMOTION_NOT_ALLOWED: Promotions cannot be enabled on a donation payment link. Set promotion_config.automatic_enabled and promotion_config.codes_enabled to false, or omit them.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_TAX_NOT_ALLOWED: Tax cannot be enabled on a donation payment link. Set tax.enabled to false or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DONATION_TIP_NOT_ALLOWED: Tips cannot be configured on a donation payment link. Omit tip, or set only tip.enabled to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_BUNDLE_COMPONENT_ID: A bundle component ID appears more than once in the replacement. Include each bundle_component_id only once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CAPABILITY: requested_capabilities lists the same capability more than once. Send each capability once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CHARGE_TARGET: The request names the same order charge more than once. Send each order_charge_id once in charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CODE: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_COMPONENT_VARIANT: A variant appears more than once in the bundle components. Include each variant_id only once and express the desired count with quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_CUSTOM_FIELD_KEY: Two custom fields use the same key. Give each custom field a unique key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_FIELD: A request field appears more than once in the same JSON object. Send each field once. If you send a corrected write, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_FULFILLMENT_LINE_ITEM: line_items lists the same order line item more than once. Send each order_line_item_id once, with its total quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_IMAGE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ID: Two images in the gallery use the same external reference ID. Use a unique external_reference_id for each image in the gallery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_IMAGE_SOURCE: The same source URL appears more than once in the gallery. Include each source_url only once in the gallery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_INVOICE_LINE: An invoice line appears more than once in the credit note. Combine the correction into one credit note line per invoice line.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_INVOICE_PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT: Two invoice payment option limits use the same payment option and currency. Send one limit per payment option and currency in invoices.payment_policy.payment_option_limits.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_INVOICE_REMINDER_OFFSET: Two invoice reminder rules use the same days_from_due. Send each days_from_due value once in invoices.reminder_policy.rules.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_LINE_ITEM_ID: A subscription plan line item ID appears more than once in line_items. Include each subscription_plan_line_item_id only once.
