x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_PLAN_NOT_ALLOWED: An event payment link cannot use a subscription plan. Remove subscription_plan_id and describe ticket tiers in line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_SOLD_OUT: The event has no tickets left. Stop offering the event, or raise event_config.max_total_quantity on the payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EVENT_TICKETS_INSUFFICIENT: The event has fewer tickets left than this order requests. Request no more than available_quantity tickets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXACTLY_ONE_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXPANSION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The caller cannot read a resource requested through expand. Remove the inaccessible expansion, or use a key whose creator can access that resource.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXPLICIT_TAX_REFUND_NOOP: The explicit tax_money equals the tax the line would refund automatically. Use tax_refund_mode automatic to refund the full tax, or send a smaller tax_money to withhold part of it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_IMAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: A transaction image referenced an external URL instead of a Flint-owned canonical image. Ingest the image on an image-bearing resource, then use the untransformed image.url returned by Flint.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_PAID_ORDER_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED: The billing account reached its monthly limit for externally recorded paid orders. Request a higher allowance from Flint, or record the payment after the monthly limit resets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: A required external service failed. Retry the same request with exponential backoff and jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_TAX_COMPONENTS_REQUIRED: An external tax calculation has no components. Provide at least one component for each line item and charge with an amount, including non-taxable ones. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_TAX_PAID_DELIVERY_UNSUPPORTED: External tax cannot calculate Flint-generated paid delivery charges. Use automatic tax for paid delivery options, remove paid options, or add delivery as a merchant charge with its own tax.calculation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CALLER: The authenticated caller is not allowed to set this field or value. Remove the field or use a caller authorized for that operation, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FIELD_NOT_UPDATABLE: This field cannot be set for this operation. Remove the field identified by the response and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: The file bytes have not arrived. PUT the bytes to upload.url before upload.expires_at, then complete the file.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_PAYMENT_ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE: The flat tax is not fully attributable to refundable payment settlements. For a flat tax split across payments, refund by order_id instead of payment_intent_id. Otherwise, check the order's remaining refundable tax and payment amounts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_PRICE_MODE_INVALID: A flat tax component uses an unsupported price mode. Set price_mode to additive for a flat_amount component.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL: A flat tax must be refunded for its full remaining amount or omitted. Set tax_money to the full remaining flat tax amount, or omit this tax breakdown.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_REFUND_STATE_INVALID: Stored flat-tax refund lineage is inconsistent with whole-or-nothing reversal. Contact support with the request ID so Flint can repair the order's refund records
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FLAT_TAX_SCOPE_INVALID: A flat tax component was assigned to a line item or charge. Move flat tax components to the order-level tax calculation, or use a percentage component for the line item or charge. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FORBIDDEN: The credential does not permit this request. Use a credential authorized for this operation. Read details[0].reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_ACTIVE_SHIPMENT_EXECUTION: A shipment fulfillment cannot release its quantity while it has a shipment that is not voided. Void the fulfillment's shipments first, or fail it with release_quantity set to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This fulfillment requires explicit merchant approval before work begins. Accept the fulfillment, then advance it into preparation, movement, or completion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_BUNDLE_UNSUPPORTED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CHANGED: Another write changed the fulfillment while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the fulfillment again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETED_DETAILS_REPLACEMEN: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETION_TIMESTAMP_CONFLIC: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETION_TIMESTAMP_NOT_ALL: The request includes a completion timestamp that is not allowed for this operation. Remove the completion timestamp from this request and complete the fulfillment with a status transition.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_COMPLETION_TIMESTAMP_REQUIRE: Completion timestamps can be recorded only on a completed fulfillment. Complete the fulfillment with the complete action, then correct its completion timestamp with PATCH if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_CONFIGURATION_ACTION_REQUIRE: The catalog item has no active fulfillment profile with a usable revision. Assign an active fulfillment profile with a usable current revision to the catalog item before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_DETAILS_TYPE_MISMATCH: The fulfillment details object does not match the fulfillment type. Send the details object for the fulfillment's type, such as pickup_details for a pickup fulfillment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_DEDUPE_CONFLICT: An event with this external_system and external_event_id already exists with different details. Resend the original event unchanged, or use a new external_event_id for a different event.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_PROVIDER_IDENTITY_INCO: external_system and external_event_id must be sent together. Send both external_system and external_event_id, or omit both.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_EVENT_SUBJECT_INVALID: Flint could not resolve the fulfillment event's subject. Contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_FIELD_TOO_LONG: A fulfillment text field is longer than its limit. Shorten the field named by param to the length stated in the error message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_INACTIVE: The fulfillment is canceled, failed, or marked no-show, so it cannot take this change. Use an active fulfillment, or create a new fulfillment for the items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_LABEL_URL_INVALID: label_url is not an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials. Send an absolute https URL with no user name or password.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_ASSIGNMENT_UNSATISFIA: The assigned delivery methods cannot fulfill every item that requires delivery. Assign, for each item, a method whose type is in the item's delivery profile allowed_types: in delivery_method_ids on the checkout session or payment link, or in settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, which payment links without methods and invoice checkouts use.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_DUPLICATE: The delivery method IDs include the same ID more than once. Include each delivery method ID only once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request assigns more than 25 delivery methods. Assign at most 25 delivery method IDs.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: A delivery method in the request, a checkout, a payment link, or the checkout default, or a zone, location set, or rate callback it uses, is missing or not active. Use IDs of active delivery methods whose zones, location sets, and rate callbacks are active. When present, blocking_resources names the resource to replace or activate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_OBLIGATION_UNAVAILABLE: The order line item has no fulfillment requirement that this fulfillment can cover. Include only line items whose fulfillment requirement is required with resolution_mode manual or quote.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_REQUIRED: The bundle component needs a delivery profile. Set delivery_profile_id to an applicable active profile.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_REVISION_UNUSABLE: The fulfillment profile revision cannot fulfill this catalog item. Correct the fulfillment profile revision described in the error response before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE: The delivery profile is not available. Use an active delivery profile in the same environment, or omit delivery_profile_id when the catalog default applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: A fulfillment line item quantity is more than the quantity left to fulfill. Send a quantity no greater than the line item's unfulfilled quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_LINE_ITEM: The line item quantity would be less than the quantity in its active fulfillments. Keep quantity at or above the quantity in active fulfillments, or cancel those fulfillments first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID: A fulfillment line item quantity is zero or negative. Send a quantity greater than zero for each entry in line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SCHEDULE_INVALID: scheduled_start_at is not earlier than scheduled_end_at. Send a scheduled_start_at that is earlier than scheduled_end_at.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SCHEDULE_NOT_ALLOWED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: This checkout requires a delivery selection before payment can begin. Create a current delivery quote, select one option for every choice group, then retry payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_NOT_MUTABLE: The shipment is past the packed stage, so its packages and contents cannot change. Change packages only while the shipment is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_NOT_VOIDABLE: The shipment is past the packed stage and cannot be voided. Void a shipment only while it is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_PROVIDER_REFERENCE_: external_reference_id was sent without external_system. Send external_system together with external_reference_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_SHIPMENT_TERMINAL: The shipment is delivered or voided, so only metadata can change. Send only metadata for this shipment and its packages.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_STATUS_CONFLICT: The fulfillment, shipment, or package changed while this request was being saved. Read the current resource and retry the change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_STATUS_REASON_TOO_LONG: The fulfillment transition reason_message exceeds the supported length. Use reason_message no longer than 500 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_TERMINAL: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED: A window, schedule, or expiry time was sent without the details timezone. Send timezone in the same details object, using an IANA name such as America/New_York.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_TRACKING_URL_INVALID: tracking_url is not an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials. Send an absolute https URL with no user name or password.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: A line item's delivery profile does not allow this fulfillment type. Use a type allowed for every included line item, or create a separate fulfillment for each type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_TYPE_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.FULFILLMENT_WINDOW_INVALID: window_start_at is not earlier than window_end_at. Send a window_start_at that is earlier than window_end_at.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_ALLOCATION_CHANGED: The gift card authorization or allocation changed before payment. Refresh the order, apply the current code when required, and accept the new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_ALLOCATION_REQUIRED: The order has selected gift cards but the payment does not accept their allocation. Read the order and send its current gift_card_estimate amounts and order_version in accepted_gift_card_allocation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUNDLE_NOT_SUPPORTED: A bundle cannot contain a gift card variant. Sell the gift card as a separate line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUYER_DEVICE_REQUIRED: The gift card purchase requires a valid device identifier. Send a stable 32-character lowercase hexadecimal identifier in Flint-Buyer-Device.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUYER_EMAIL_REQUIRED: gift card purchases need the buyer's email for purchase limits Use a customer that has an email, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_BUYER_REQUIRED: Gift card purchases require an identified buyer. Set customer_id on the order or verify the buyer in checkout before paying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CATALOG_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: The gift card variant has incompatible tax, inventory, or currency settings. Use USD, set taxable to false, and remove tax_category and inventory_item_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: A gift card challenge is required after repeated failed codes. Show the challenge from remediation.next_actions to the buyer, then retry the same request with its proof in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. If there is no next action, launch the checkout session with page_origin.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: The gift card face value, price mode, or custom amount bounds are invalid. Use positive USD values up to 200000 cents, bounds that contain the reference face value, and face_value or discounted price mode. Discounted pricing must collect less than the face value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CONFIGURATION_NOT_APPLICABLE: The variant's product is not a gift card. Omit gift_card_configuration or create a product with product_type gift_card.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Gift card variants require USD. Use USD for unit_price_money.currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: Gift card value can only pay for orders in USD. Use an order in USD.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_FUNDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The requested gift card funding exceeds a funding or balance limit. Send a smaller amount, wait for the limit to reset at the reported time, or split the value across cards.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_INSUFFICIENT_VALUE: The gift card has insufficient available value for the requested allocation. Refresh the balance and accept a new allocation before payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_INVENTORY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Gift card variants cannot track inventory. Omit inventory_item_id and inventory_item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_MODIFIERS_NOT_SUPPORTED: Gift card variants cannot include modifiers. Omit modifier_set_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PRODUCT_TYPE_IMMUTABLE: A gift_card product_type cannot change to or from another type. Create a separate product with the required product_type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_CONFLICT: The gift card purchase cannot be funded under its original terms or funding limits. Keep the original buyer and offer, resolve any existing payment attempt, and check the buyer funding limit before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_INVALID: The gift card purchase amount or recipient is invalid. Choose a USD face value within the variant's denomination or custom amount bounds. Use a valid recipient email, a message of at most 200 characters, and a send_at between now and 90 days from now.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The gift card purchase exceeds a daily purchase limit. Wait until the next UTC day before starting a new purchase attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_NOT_APPLICABLE: This line item does not sell a gift card. Use gift_card_purchase only with a gift_card variant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_REFUND_CONFLICT: The original gift card purchase value is unavailable for this cash refund. Check the original funding load and pending refunds. Refund only eligible unspent value and resolve any reserved or spent value before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_SOURCE_REQUIRED: A gift card purchase requires a catalog variant. Supply the variant_id of a gift_card product. Ad-hoc gift card purchase lines are not supported.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_REFUND_DESTINATION_REQUIRED: The original gift card cannot accept the full refund within its lifecycle and balance cap. Select replacement for that gift card allocation and retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_STATE_CONFLICT: The gift card operation conflicts with a lifecycle or provenance constraint. Retrieve the current resource and resolve its stated constraint before submitting a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_SUPPORTED: Gift card variants cannot be sold through subscriptions. Use a one-time purchase.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_SUBSCRIPTION_TENDER_UNSUPPORTE: Gift card value cannot pay for subscription orders. Remove selected gift cards and use a processor payment source.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_TAX_NOT_SUPPORTED: Gift card variants cannot include tax. Set taxable to false and omit line_item_tax_category.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.GIFT_CARD_UNAVAILABLE: The gift card code is not available for this order. Check the current code and the issuing merchant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.HOSTED_CHECKOUT_CALLER_RATES_UNSUPPORTED: A delivery method with caller_supplied pricing cannot be used by hosted checkout or a payment link. Use delivery methods with another pricing type in delivery_method_ids or settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, or create an embedded checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS: A request with the same idempotency key is still in progress. Retry with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The idempotency key was reused with a different request body. Use the original request body with this idempotency key, or generate a new idempotency key for a new operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Flint cannot safely recover the original operation's outcome. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm whether the original operation took effect. Do not switch keys or resend as a new operation until you have confirmed it had no effect. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: fresh identity verification is required Verify your identity again and obtain a new session token, then retry the original request. Keep the same Idempotency-Key if one was sent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_ANIMATION_UNSUPPORTED: The image source is animated, but Flint accepts still images only. Provide a still JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_ASSET_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The canonical image has expired or was deleted. Upload a new file with POST /v1/files and complete it, then pass its url as source_url on a catalog or branding resource.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_DIMENSIONS_EXCEEDED: The image dimensions exceed Flint's axis or pixel limits. Resize the source to at most 12,000 pixels per axis and 40 megapixels, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_DIMENSIONS_UNSUPPORTED: The image's dimensions don't fit what this image is for: a merchant icon must be square and at least 128 by 128 pixels. Upload a square image at least 128 by 128 pixels, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: The image format is unsupported or malformed. Provide a valid still JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_GALLERY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The requested gallery contains more than eight images. Send no more than eight images in the gallery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_COUNT_EXCEEDED: The mutation contains more external image ingestions than one request allows. Split the change into mutations containing at most 32 external image sources.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_EXPIRED: The prior image ingestion expired and its reserved storage was cleaned up. Retry the request with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_IN_PROGRESS: The same image ingestion step is still running. Retry with the same idempotency key and request body using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_INGESTION_RESTART_REQUIRED: The prior image ingestion attempt ended and cannot be resumed. Wait briefly for cleanup, then start a new ingestion with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_NOT_ATTACHABLE: The image cannot be attached to this resource. Use an attachable image returned for the same merchant and environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_OWNER_NOT_MUTABLE: The resource no longer accepts image changes. Retrieve the resource and update images only while the resource is mutable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PIXEL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The mutation exceeds the total decoded image pixel budget. Resize the sources or split the images across smaller mutations.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Image processing capacity is temporarily exhausted. Retry with exponential backoff. If remediation says to start a new ingestion, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_FAILED: The image could not be decoded or processed safely. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key. If the ingestion requires a restart, follow the reason-specific remediation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Image processing exceeded its deadline. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_REVISION_MISMATCH: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_FETCH_FAILED: The source did not return a complete supported image response. Check the source response, redirects, encoding, and content length, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_NOT_PUBLIC: The source URL does not resolve to an allowed public origin. Use a public HTTPS origin that does not resolve to private, loopback, link-local, or Flint infrastructure addresses.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_TIMEOUT: The source host did not return the image before the fetch deadline. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion, or use a more reliable source host.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The source image exceeds the 5 MB byte limit. Reduce the source file below 5 MB, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source host was temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff and a new idempotency key when remediation says to start a new ingestion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_SOURCE_URL_INVALID: The image source URL violates Flint's HTTPS source rules. Use an HTTPS URL on port 443 without credentials or a fragment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The merchant's stored image bytes have reached the configured quota. Remove unused image attachments or wait until ready unattached images expire, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_URL_INVALID: The submitted image URL is invalid. Use the exact untransformed image.url returned by Flint.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.IMAGE_URL_MUST_BE_CANONICAL: The image URL is a transformed delivery URL instead of the canonical asset URL. Use the exact image.url returned by Flint without a variant path, query, or fragment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INCOMPLETE_OPTION_SELECTION: An active variant does not select one value for each active option. Select one active value for each active option on the product.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INHERIT_ONLY_VIOLATION: An organization settings policy requires this merchant to inherit the setting, so the request cannot set it. Remove the setting identified by param from the request, or ask the organization to change its settings policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INITIAL_API_KEY_ALREADY_CREATED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSTANT_PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE: Instant payouts are not available. Create a standard payout instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE_BALANCE: No single balance source covers the requested payout amount. Each payout draws from one source; details[0].available_by_source_type lists what each source has available. Create one payout per source, each within that source's available amount, or wait for more funds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: The API key is missing a required scope. Create or use an API key with the required scope, then retry the request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Flint returned an internal server error. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INTERVAL_COUNT_TOO_LARGE: The billing interval count is greater than 365. Send a billing_interval_count from 1 through 365.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_AMOUNT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_AMOUNT_OFF: The promotion amount_off_money is missing, not positive, or has no currency. Send application_method.amount_off_money with a positive amount and a currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_API_VERSION: The requested API version is not supported. Set Flint-Version to a supported version listed in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_APPLICATION_METHOD: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BILLING_ANCHOR_DAY: The billing anchor day is outside the supported range. Set billing_anchor_day to a day from 1 through 31.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BILLING_INTERVAL_COUNT: billing_interval_count must be from 1 to 365 Send subscription_terms.billing_interval_count as an integer from 1 to 365.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BILLING_INTERVAL_OPTIONS: The offered billing interval options are invalid. Provide unique billing_interval and billing_interval_count pairs with supported intervals and positive counts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BOGO_QUANTITY: The buy_x_get_y quantities must be positive. Set application_method.buy_min_quantity and application_method.get_quantity to 1 or more.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BOOTSTRAP_SCOPES: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BUSINESS_NAME: The business name is null, blank, or longer than 120 characters. Send business_name with 1 to 120 characters. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed, and the name cannot be cleared.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BUYER_PAUSE_MAX_CYCLES: The longest buyer pause is outside the supported range. Set customer_account.buyer_capabilities.pause.max_cycles from 1 to 12, or omit it for no limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_BUYER_SKIP_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SKIPS: The consecutive skip limit is outside its allowed range. Set customer_account.buyer_capabilities.skip.max_consecutive_skips to an integer from 1 to 12, or omit it for no limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CAPTURE_AMOUNT: The requested capture amount is invalid. Send a positive amount in the authorization currency, or omit amount_money to capture the available authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CATEGORIES: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: The category description is invalid. Provide a description with at most 2,048 characters, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CATEGORY_HANDLE: The category handle is invalid. Use lowercase letters and numbers separated by single hyphens.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CATEGORY_NAME: The category name is invalid. Provide a category name with 1 through 100 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CHARGE_AMOUNT: The charge amount is zero or negative. Send amount_money with a positive amount in minor units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CHARGE_PERCENT: The charge percent is outside the supported range or precision. Send percent greater than 0 and no more than 100, with no more than four decimal places.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CHARGE_REFUND_AMOUNT: A charge refund amount_money is zero or negative. Send a positive charges[].amount_money, or omit it to refund the charge's remaining amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CHARGE_VALUE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CHECKBOX_VALUE: A checkbox answer is not "true" or "false". Send "true" or "false" for the checkbox answer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CODE: The promotion code contains invalid characters or surrounding whitespace. Send printable characters without leading or trailing whitespace.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COLOR: A branding color is not a six-digit hex color. Send the color identified by param as # followed by six hex digits, such as #FF0000.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COMPONENT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COMPONENTS: The bundle component collection is invalid. Send components as an array, or omit it to leave components unchanged.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COMPONENT_POSITION: The bundle component position is invalid. Use a position of zero or greater.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COMPONENT_QUANTITY: The bundle component quantity is outside the supported range. Use a quantity from 1 through 9999.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CONFIRMATION_TOKEN: stripe.confirmation_token must not be empty. Omit stripe.confirmation_token to use the payment source already attached.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CORNER_RADIUS: The branding corner radius is outside 0 to 32. Send branding.corner_radius from 0 through 32.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_COUNTRY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CREDENTIAL: The credential cannot authenticate this request. Send a valid credential supported by this endpoint. Read details[0].reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CREDIT_NOTE: A credit note text field is empty or longer than 255 characters. Send external_reference_id or query with 1 to 255 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CREDIT_NOTE_LINE: A credit note line is invalid. Use a positive correction within the frozen invoice line's remaining amount or quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CREDIT_NOTE_MEMO: The credit note memo exceeds the supported length. Use a memo no longer than 4096 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CURRENCY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CURRENCY_OPTION: A currency_options entry is invalid or not allowed here. Key each entry by its currency with a positive amount in that currency. Use currency_options on rules only for money attributes that are not compared with is_defined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ROUTE_TEMPLATE: A customer account route template is not a clean relative path with the placeholders its route allows. Send a path that starts with / and has no scheme, query, fragment, or .. segments. Include {resource_id} once in the order, subscription, return, and invoice templates, and no placeholder in email_preferences.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_URL: The merchant account URL is not an absolute HTTPS URL on a merchant-owned hostname. Send an https URL without credentials or a fragment, on a hostname outside withflintpay.com that is not an IP address.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CUSTOMER_SESSION: The customer session request is invalid, or the customer session credential is malformed, unknown, or revoked. Fix the field described by the error or create a new customer session, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CUSTOM_DOMAIN: The custom domain is not an exact subdomain. Send a subdomain such as pay.example.com, not a registrable domain, an IP address, or a withflintpay.com host.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DEFAULT_SMART_TIP_AMOUNT: The default smart tip amount is not positive or is not one of the effective smart_tip_money_options, whether sent with it or inherited from tipping settings. Set default_smart_tip_money to one of the amounts in the effective smart_tip_money_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DEFAULT_TIP_PERCENTAGE: The default tip percent is outside 1 to 100, has more than four decimal places, or is not one of the effective tip_percent_options, whether sent with it or inherited from tipping settings. Set default_tip_percent to one of the values in the effective tip_percent_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DEFAULT_VARIANT: default_variant_id does not identify an active variant on this product. Send the ID of an active variant on this product.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DELAY_DAYS_OVERRIDE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DESCRIPTION: The risk rule description is blank or longer than 512 characters. Send a description of 1 through 512 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DISCOUNT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DOMAIN_NAME: The payment method domain name is not an exact fully-qualified hostname. Send one domain or subdomain without a scheme, path, port, IP address, or wildcard.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DONATION_AMOUNT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DROPDOWN_VALUE: A custom_field_values answer is not one of the dropdown field's options. Send one of the field's options exactly as listed on the payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_DUNNING_RETRY_DAYS: The dunning retry period is outside 1 to 90 days. Send subscriptions.dunning_retry_days from 1 through 90.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_EMAIL_FORMAT: The email address is not valid. Send an address such as buyer@example.com, with no surrounding spaces.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ENVIRONMENT_SELECTION: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_EXPIRATION: The checkout expiration is outside 60 to 86,400 seconds. Send a value from 60 through 86,400.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_EXPIRES_AT: The request included an invalid or past expiration timestamp. Send expires_at as a future RFC3339 timestamp, or omit it so the resource does not expire.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ID: The external reference ID has an invalid length. Use an external_reference_id of at most 255 characters, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_FEEDBACK_SHAPE: The feedback fields do not match the selected kind. Provide the required fields for the selected feedback kind and remove fields that do not apply.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_FLAT_TAX: The flat tax amount or currency is invalid. Send a positive flat_money amount in the order currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_FULFILLMENT_DETAILS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_FULFILLMENT_REQUIREMENT: The inline fulfillment requirement is invalid. Fix the identified fulfillment field and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_FULFILLMENT_TYPE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_GIFT_CARD_CODE: The gift card code is missing or exceeds 64 characters. Submit the full current gift card code in code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_GIFT_CARD_PURCHASE_REFUND: The purchase refund target does not identify original standalone payment funding. Supply a standalone gift_card_load_id, omit order and tender targets, and use its original payment_intent_id when specifying a payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_GIFT_CARD_SELECTION: The gift card selection is invalid, exceeds the 20 card limit, or sends different order version values. Keep at most 20 selected cards. When sending both version fields, send the same order version in expected_version and accepted_gift_card_allocation.order_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_IMAGE_ALT: The image alt text exceeds the supported length. Shorten alt to 512 characters or fewer, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_IMAGE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ID: The image external reference ID has an invalid length. Use a non-empty external_reference_id of at most 255 characters, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_IMAGE_GALLERY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_RESOLUTION_R: The resolution reason_message is longer than 500 characters. Send reason_message of 500 characters or fewer, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVENTORY_SOURCE_KEY: An inventory.origin_policies key is not a supported origin. Use default, virtual_terminal, payment_link, checkout, api, or subscription as origin_policies keys.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_AUTOPAY_RETRY_OFFSETS: The invoice autopay retry offsets are not unique, strictly increasing days from 1 through 30. Send retry_day_offsets in increasing order, each from 1 through 30 and used once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_COLLECTION: The invoice collection input contains fields that do not apply to its mode. Send only the fields supported by the selected collection mode.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_LATE_FEE_AMOUNT: The calculated late fee is zero or exceeds the supported balance. Review the frozen policy and current principal balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_LATE_FEE_REASON: The waiver reason_message is missing or too long. Provide reason_message between 1 and 4096 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_LATE_FEE_SCHEDULE: The schedule entry does not match the invoice. Provide an entry from the scheduled invoice, or omit it for an unscheduled invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_PAYMENT_DUE: The invoice payment due input does not match its due type. Provide the fields required by the selected type and remove fields that do not apply.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT: An invoice payment option limit is missing a positive amount or a currency. Send max_total_money with a positive amount in minor units and a currency for each limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_PAYMENT_POLICY: The invoice payment policy is invalid. Use supported payment options and valid per-option limits.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_PAYMENT_TERM: The invoice payment term is invalid. Correct the calculation or late fee fields and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_REMINDER_OFFSET: An invoice reminder rule's days_from_due is outside -90 to 365. Send each days_from_due from -90 through 365.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_REPLY_TO_EMAIL: The invoice reply-to address is not a valid email address. Send invoices.reply_to_email as a single bare address, such as billing@example.com.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_INVOICE_TIMEZONE: The invoice timezone is not a valid IANA timezone name. Set invoices.timezone to an IANA timezone name such as America/New_York.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_JSON: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Send valid JSON. If you send a corrected write, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LINE_ITEM: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LINE_ITEM_REFUND_AMOUNT: A line item refund amount is zero or negative, or nothing remains after its refund adjustments. Send a positive line_items[].amount_money, and keep refund adjustments below the line's refund amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LINE_ITEM_REFUND_QUANTITY: A line item refund quantity is zero or negative. Send a positive line_items[].quantity, or omit it to refund the line's remaining quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LIST_ALIAS: A list_alias in the predicate is not a lowercase identifier. Use the alias of a risk list: a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits, or underscores.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LIST_ITEM_COUNT: The request adds no risk list items or more than 500. Send 1 through 500 values in one request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD: The low stock threshold is negative. Send inventory.low_stock_threshold as 0 or greater. 0 turns off low stock alerts.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_AMOUNT: The max_amount filter is not a single positive integer in minor units. Send max_amount once as a positive integer in minor units and include its three-letter currency, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_APPLICATIONS_PER_ORDER: The promotion max_applications_per_order is less than 1. Set application_method.max_applications_per_order to 1 or more, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_COMPLETIONS: max_completions is less than 1. Set max_completions to 1 or more, or omit it for no limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_DISCOUNTED_QUANTITY: The promotion max_discounted_quantity is not positive or does not apply to this promotion. Use a positive value with type percent_off and allocation each on a line_item or service_charge promotion, or omit application_method.max_discounted_quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_LENGTH: A custom field max_length is outside the supported range. Set custom_fields[].max_length from 1 through 4,096, or omit it to use the default.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_PROMOTIONS_PER_ORDER: The maximum promotions per order is outside 1 to 10. Send promotions.max_promotions_per_order from 1 through 10.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_TOTAL_QUANTITY: event_config.max_total_quantity is less than 1. Set event_config.max_total_quantity to 1 or more, or omit it for no event capacity limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MAX_USES: The max_uses limit is not a positive number. Set max_uses to 1 or more.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MERCHANT_ADDRESS: A merchant address field is too long, or the country is not a two-letter country code. Keep line1 and line2 within 255 characters, city and state within 100, and postal_code within 20, and set country to an uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MERCHANT_SELECTION: The requested merchant is unavailable to this developer identity. Retry with a merchant_id from selectable_merchants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_METADATA: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_METADATA_KEY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MINIMUM_BALANCE_AMOUNT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MINIMUM_BALANCE_CURRENCY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MIN_AMOUNT: The min_amount filter is not a single positive integer in minor units. Send min_amount once as a positive integer in minor units and include its three-letter currency, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MODIFIER_GROUP: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MODIFIER_SET: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MONEY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MONTHLY_PAYOUT_DAY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_NAME: The name is missing, blank, or too long. Send a non-empty name. A risk list name can be up to 255 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPERAND: A comparison value does not fit its attribute or operator. Fix the value the error message describes. A values list holds 1 through 100 literals.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPERATOR: The promotion rule operator is not valid for its attribute. Use one of the operators the error message lists for that attribute.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPTIONS: The product option collection is invalid. Send options as an array, or omit it to leave options unchanged.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPTION_POSITION: The product option position is invalid. Use a position of zero or greater.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPTION_VALUE: A variant selection uses an option value that is unavailable for this product. Select an active value for each option on the product.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_OPTION_VALUE_POSITION: The product option value position is invalid. Use a position of zero or greater.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_CLOSE_REASON: The close reason_message is longer than 500 characters. Send reason_message of 500 characters or fewer, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_STATUS: The order cannot be changed in its current status. Read the order and retry only while its status permits this change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAGE_ORIGIN: page_origin is not a valid checkout page origin, or the session is not embedded. Send the origin of your checkout page, such as https://shop.example.com, with surface embedded. Leave page_origin out for hosted sessions.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAGE_SIZE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAGE_TOKEN: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PARENT_ORGANIZATION: The parent organization is deleted or is the organization itself. Set parent_organization_id to a different active organization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PARTNER_APP: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAUSE_DURATION_CYCLES: The pause length must be at least one billing cycle. Send pause_duration_cycles of at least 1, or omit it to pause until you resume the subscription.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAYMENTS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT: A payment option limit is missing a positive amount or a currency. Set max_total_money with a positive amount and a currency on each payment option limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAYMENT_SOURCE: The payment source is unknown, not active, or could not be resolved. Send an active saved payment_method_id, or collect a new token or stripe.confirmation_token, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PAYMENT_SOURCE_TOKEN: payment_source_token must not be empty. Omit payment_source_token to use the payment source already attached.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PERCENT_OFF: The promotion percentage is outside 1 to 100 or has more than 4 decimal places. Send application_method.percent_off, or application_method.get_percent_off for buy_x_get_y, between 1 and 100 with at most 4 decimal places.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PHONE_FORMAT: The phone number is not in E.164 format. Send the number with a plus sign and country code, such as +14155551234.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PREDICATE: The risk rule predicate is not valid JSON. Send predicate as a JSON object that follows the risk rule predicate grammar.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PREDICATE_GROUP: An all or any node has no child nodes or more than 50. Put 1 through 50 nodes in each all or any node.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PREDICATE_NODE: A risk rule predicate node has the wrong shape. Make each node either a comparison with attribute and operator, or an all, any, or not node that contains only that field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PRICE: A price or fee amount is zero or negative. Send a positive amount. A modifier unit_price_delta_money amount can also be zero.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PRODUCT_CREATE_SHAPE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_QUANTITY: A quantity is outside the allowed range, or a line or amount is too large at that quantity. Send a line quantity from 1 through 9,999. For a subscription, choose a quantity that keeps every line at 9,999 units or fewer once multiplied. If the amount is too large, lower the quantity, the line quantities, or the line prices.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_QUANTITY_OPTIONS: The offered quantity options are invalid. Provide unique quantities from 1 to 100.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_QUERY: The query value has an invalid length. Use a query of at most 255 characters, or omit it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RECOVERY_EMAIL_DELAY: The checkout reminder delay is outside the supported range. Send checkout.recovery_email.delay_seconds between 900 and 86400, in multiples of 60.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT: A refund adjustment amount_money is zero or negative. Send a positive line_items[].refund_adjustments[].amount_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REFUND_AMOUNT: An adjustment refund amount_money is zero or negative. Send a positive line_items[].adjustment_refunds[].amount_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_TARGET: A restocking_fee adjustment must use applies_to none. Set applies_to to none for restocking_fee adjustments.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REFUND_TENDER_ALLOCATION: The refund allocations do not identify valid original tenders and amounts. Use payment_intent or gift_card_redemption, its original resource ID, positive money in its currency, and a gift card destination only for gift card tenders.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RELATED_REQUEST_ID: The related request ID is not valid. Use a Flint request ID from the response or request logs.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RELATED_RESOURCE_ID: A related resource ID is not a supported Flint public resource. Use a public Flint resource ID returned by the API.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REQUEST: The request is invalid. Correct the field named by param as the message describes, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RETENTION_OFFER_PAUSE_CYCLES: The offered pause length is outside the supported range. Set customer_account.buyer_capabilities.retention_offer.pause_cycles from 1 to 12.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RETURN_URL: The return_url is not an address of the merchant's customer account. Send an HTTPS URL on the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RISK_LIST_ALIAS: The risk list alias is not a lowercase identifier. Send an alias that starts with a lowercase letter and contains only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, up to 128 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RISK_LIST_ITEM: A risk list item value is invalid. Send each value in the format required by the list's item_type.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RULE_ACTION: The risk rule action is not supported. Set action to allow, block, review, or require_3ds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RULE_GROUP: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_RULE_VALUE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SANDBOX_ID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SCOPE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SHIPMENT_DIMENSIONS: Package dimensions need a positive length, width, and height and a unit of millimeter, centimeter, or inch. Send dimensions with length, width, and height greater than 0 and unit millimeter, centimeter, or inch.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_ITEM_QUANTITY: The package item quantity is zero or negative. Send a quantity greater than 0.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SHIPMENT_WEIGHT: Package weight needs a positive value and a unit of gram, kilogram, ounce, or pound. Send weight.value greater than 0 and weight.unit as gram, kilogram, ounce, or pound.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SMART_TIP_AMOUNT: A smart tip amount is not positive. Send each smart_tip_money_options amount as a positive integer in minor units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SMART_TIP_AMOUNTS_COUNT: The smart_tip_money_options list does not contain exactly 3 amounts. Send exactly 3 amounts in smart_tip_money_options, or omit the field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SOURCE_CONTEXT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STATEMENT_DESCRIPTOR: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STATUS_FOR_CAPTURE: The payment intent is not awaiting capture. Capture only a payment intent whose status is requires_capture. Retrieve it to check its current status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: The resource cannot move to the requested status from its current status. For example, only an open checkout session can be closed. Retrieve the resource and continue from its current status.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_MIGRATION_: The delivery methods must differ. Send different from_delivery_method_id and to_delivery_method_id values.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_TARGETS: One or more catalog targets cannot be subscribed. Select active physical, digital, or service products or variants. Read details for each failing target.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_LINE_ITEM_ID: The item ID does not identify an item on this plan. Use a subscription_plan_line_item_id from this plan, or omit the ID to create an item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUGGESTED_AMOUNT: A suggested donation amount is less than 1 in minor units. Set each donation_suggested_amount_money_options amount to 1 or more.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUPPORT_EMAIL: The support email address is not valid. Send a plain email address of at most 320 characters without a display name. Send null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUPPORT_PHONE: The support phone number is not in E.164 format. Send support_phone in E.164 format with 7 to 15 digits, such as +12125551234. Send null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUPPORT_URL: The support URL is not a valid http or https URL. Send an absolute http or https URL of at most 2,048 characters with no surrounding whitespace. Send null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SURFACE_ROUTE: The surface route is not a canonical public API route. Use the documented route template without a host, query string, or concrete resource ID.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SWAP_VARIANTS: The plan line contains an unsupported swap variant. Use at most 25 distinct active variants from the same product. Only variant lines support swaps.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUND_AMOUNT: A line item tax breakdown refund tax_money is zero or negative. Send a positive tax_money for each tax breakdown, or leave out breakdowns with nothing to refund.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_CATEGORY: The tax category is invalid for this taxable item or charge. Use a documented Flint tax category for the field identified by param. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the item already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_IDENTITY: The tax identity is invalid. Send printable legal_name and tax ID values, list each tax ID once, and reference only this identity's document_tax_id values.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_JURISDICTION: The external tax jurisdiction is invalid. Provide a US jurisdiction with a valid code, two-letter state, level, and name. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_MONEY: The explicit tax_money amount is negative. Send a tax_money amount of zero or more.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TAX_PERCENTAGE: A tax percentage is outside the supported range or precision. Set percent from 0 through 100 with at most four decimal places. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIMEZONE: The timezone is not a valid IANA timezone name. Use an IANA timezone name such as America/New_York.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIP: The requested tip must use one value type. Send exactly one of amount_money or percent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIP_AMOUNT: The tip amount is invalid. Send a positive amount in minor units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIP_PERCENT: A tip percent is outside the allowed range or exceeds the supported precision. Send each tip percent from 1 through 100 with at most four decimal places.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIP_PERCENTAGES_COUNT: The tip_percent_options list does not contain exactly 3 percentages. Send exactly 3 values in tip_percent_options, or omit the field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_UPDATE_MASK: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_URL: A URL in the request is malformed or does not use HTTPS where HTTPS is required. Send an absolute https URL with a host in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_URL_HOST: The URL host does not resolve to a public IP address. Use a URL whose hostname resolves to a public IP address, not localhost or a private network.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_URL_SCHEME: The webhook endpoint URL does not use HTTPS. Send a url that starts with https://.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_VALUE: A field's value is invalid. Correct the field named by param as the message describes, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_VALUES: The promotion rule values do not fit its operator. Omit values for is_defined rules, and send more than one value only with the in operator.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_VALUE_TYPE: A promotion rule value has the wrong type for its attribute. Send each value with the type the attribute expects, such as a string, number, boolean, or money object.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_VERIFICATION: The request could not be authenticated. Send a valid Flint credential supported by this endpoint, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_WEBHOOK_EVENT: The webhook endpoint's event_sources cannot deliver the requested event_type. Send an event_type that the endpoint's event_sources can deliver.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVALID_WEBSITE_URL: The merchant website URL is not valid for account onboarding. Send the merchant's real, publicly reachable business website URL in profile.website_url, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_CONDITION_INVALID: The requested inventory quantities violate a physical-condition invariant. Correct the condition quantities and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_COUNT_INCOMPLETE: The inventory count has lines without saved observations. Save an observation for every inventory item before applying the count.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_DEMAND_DUPLICATE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_DEMAND_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT: Current eligible inventory cannot satisfy the complete demand. Change demand, replenish stock, or change the routing source before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ITEM_INACTIVE: The inventory item is not active, so it cannot be assigned to a variant. Activate the inventory item, or assign another active inventory item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ITEM_NAME_INVALID: The inline inventory item name is missing or too long. Send an inventory_item.name with 1 through 255 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: The inventory item does not accept new sale or routing use. Activate the item or use another active inventory item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_LOCATION_ALLOCATION_INACTIVE: The Location inventory capability rejects new claims. Activate allocation for the Location or choose another Location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_LOCATION_INELIGIBLE: The Location cannot supply this inventory demand. Inspect eligibility_reason, then change the routing source, configure the Location, or replenish inventory before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_POLICY_INVALID: The allocation policy request is structurally invalid. Correct the policy groups, ordering, splitting behavior, or limits and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The allocation policy is inactive or archived. Activate the policy or choose another active allocation policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_QUANTITY_CONFLICT: The requested reservation or transfer transition conflicts with its current cumulative quantities. Read the reservation or transfer lines and submit cumulative targets within their eligible quantities.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_RECEIPT_CONFLICT: The inventory receipt conflicts with current inventory lineage. Read the linked consumed quantities and retry with a valid remaining return quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_RECEIPT_INVALID: The inventory receipt request is structurally invalid. Correct the receiving Location, disposition, lineage, and quantities and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_RESERVATION_OWNER_MISMATCH: The caller cannot mutate this reservation owner type. Use the workflow that owns the reservation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ROUTING_LOCATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDE: The demand requires more Locations than the allocation policy allows. Reduce demand, replenish inventory, or increase the policy's maximum_locations_per_assignment and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ROUTING_SOURCE_INVALID: The inventory routing source does not match a supported branch. Send exactly one valid fixed Location, allocation policy, or immutable policy revision reference.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_ROUTING_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Tracked demand requires an explicit inventory routing source. Use line items that do not track inventory, or send inventory_routing_source with a fixed Location, active policy, or immutable policy revision.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_SHORTAGE: The requested committed quantity is not protected by physical stock. Replenish, release, cancel, or explicitly reallocate the affected claim.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_SOURCE_SEQUENCE_CHANGED: The physical observation sequence is stale or conflicting. Read the accepted source sequence and submit a strictly newer absolute observation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_TRANSFER_INVALID: The inventory transfer request is structurally invalid. Correct the Locations, lines, physical conditions, or cumulative targets and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_TRANSFER_LINE_CONFLICT: The requested line change conflicts with the transfer's current quantities or lines. Read the current transfer lines and submit a change compatible with their quantities.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Stock could not be held for this order's tracked line items. Check availability for the order's routing source, then replenish, widen the allocation policy, or reduce the quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_AUTOPAY_PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: Automatic invoice collection has no saved card to charge. Set collection.payment_method_id or configure a default card for the customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_AUTOPAY_PAYMENT_METHOD_UNSUPPORT: Automatic invoice collection requires a reusable saved card. Choose an active reusable card that belongs to the invoice customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_AUTOPAY_RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The invoice autopay retry policy has more than 5 retry offsets. Send at most 5 values in invoices.autopay_retry_policy.retry_day_offsets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_BALANCE_CHANGED: The invoice balance changed after the payment request was prepared. Refresh the invoice and rebuild the payment selection from its current collectible balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_CHECKOUT_REPLACEMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Invoice-owned checkout sessions cannot be replaced through generic checkout creation. Manage checkout through the invoice listed in blocking_resources using POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_BLOCKED: Invoice collection is blocked until inventory is available. Resolve the inventory block, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_CHANGED: The invoice collection state changed after the request was prepared. Refresh the invoice, then rebuild the request from its current state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COLLECTION_MODE_UNSUPPORTED: The invoice collection mode does not support this payment flow. Use hosted checkout for buyer_initiated invoices or POST /collect for automatic invoices.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_COST_COMPARISON_REQUIRES_OPTIONS: Showing a cost comparison needs ACH debit and at least one card payment option enabled. Add ach_debit and card, apple_pay, or google_pay to invoices.payment_policy.enabled_payment_options, or set show_cost_comparison to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_ISSUE_IN_PROGRESS: Invoice issue state changed before the request could complete. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice has no eligible balance for this action. Use an open or partially paid invoice with unpaid principal for assessment or an unpaid fee for waiver.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_NOT_DUE: The late fee grace period has not elapsed. Wait until the invoice due date and frozen grace period have passed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LATE_FEE_POLICY_REQUIRED: The invoice has no frozen late fee policy. Assess fees only on invoices issued with a late fee policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: The invoice has no active public link, so hosted collection or link delivery cannot proceed. Regenerate the invoice public link, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_LOCKED_ORDER_FINANCIALS: An active invoice owns the order's financial fields and collects its balance. Collect through the invoice listed in blocking_resources: issue it if it is a draft, then send the buyer to its public_url or call POST /v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-session. To edit the order or collect it another way, void the invoice first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice is not open or partially paid with a balance remaining. Collect only open or partially_paid invoices with a positive outstanding_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_CREDITABLE: The invoice cannot receive a credit note in its current state. Use an issued invoice that has not been voided.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: The invoice is no longer a draft. After an invoice is issued, only reminders_paused can be changed. Read the current invoice. To change it after issue, send only reminders_paused, or correct it with a credit note.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED: The invoice has not been issued and has no public link. Issue the invoice before managing its public link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_MARKABLE_UNCOLLECTIBLE: The invoice cannot be marked uncollectible in its current state. Use an open or partially_paid invoice with a positive outstanding balance and no active payment attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_REVERSIBLE: The invoice payment cannot be reversed. Check the payment and invoice state before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_NOT_VOIDABLE: The invoice cannot be voided in its current state. Void only an unpaid draft or open invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ALREADY_SETTLED: The invoice payment settled before cancellation completed. Read the settled attempt and current invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE: An invoice payment attempt is open. Wait for it to finish or cancel it before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_NOT_APPLIED: The invoice is paid, but the selected payment intent has not been applied to it yet. Wait for invoice payment processing to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_OPTIONS_REQUIRED: Buyer-initiated collection requires at least one payment option. Enable a supported payment option in collection.payment_policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The invoice payment policy has more than 100 payment option limits. Send at most 100 items in invoices.payment_policy.payment_option_limits.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT_NOT_ENABLED: An invoice payment option limit names a payment option that is not enabled. Add the payment option to invoices.payment_policy.enabled_payment_options, or remove its limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_PROCESSING: An invoice payment attempt is processing. Wait for it to settle, fail, or be canceled before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_RESOLVING: Invoice payment work is still resolving, so competing collection or mutation cannot proceed yet. Wait for the payment resources listed in blocking_resources to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_TERM_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The payment term's fixed late fee uses a different currency than the invoice. Choose a payment term whose fixed late fee uses the invoice currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_PAYMENT_TERM_UNAVAILABLE: The selected invoice payment term is not active for this merchant environment. Choose an active invoice payment term and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_REMINDER_CHANGED: The invoice changed while the reminder was being prepared. Retry the reminder request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_REMINDER_RULE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The invoice reminder policy has more than 20 rules. Send at most 20 rules in invoices.reminder_policy.rules.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_SCHEDULE_ENTRY_NOT_COLLECTIBLE: The invoice has no collectible schedule entry, or the selected entry is not the next one due. Wait until the next entry is due and has an outstanding balance, then collect it. Omit invoice_schedule_entry_id if the invoice has no schedule.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_SCHEDULE_INVALID: The invoice schedule is invalid. Correct the complete schedule and replace it again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_TAX_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: The invoice has no frozen automatic tax calculation to collect against. Void the invoice, then create and issue a new invoice for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_TAX_SNAPSHOT_STALE: The order's tax or totals changed after the invoice was issued. Void the invoice, then create and issue a new invoice for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.INVOICE_TIMEZONE_REQUIRED: The payment term needs an invoice timezone, and none is set. Set invoices.timezone in settings, or use an on_receipt payment term without a late fee.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ITEMS_REQUIRED: The item collection is empty or missing. Provide at least one item in line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_DISCOUNT_NO_CHARGE_IDS: A line_item class manual discount cannot target order charges. Remove manual.order_charge_ids, or use the service_charge discount class to discount charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_DISCOUNT_REQUIRES_IDS: A line_item class manual discount does not name any order line items. Send at least one ID in manual.order_line_item_ids, or use the order discount class.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_INVALID_QUANTITY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_KEY_WHITESPACE: A line item key has leading or trailing whitespace. Remove the leading and trailing whitespace from line_items[].key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_NAME_TOO_LONG: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_NEGATIVE_PRICE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_NOT_ON_ORDER: A line item in the request does not belong to the order or has no settled amount to refund. Use an order_line_item_id from the order's line_items that was collected by a succeeded payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_PRICE_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_QUANTITY_TOO_LARGE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REFUND: The line item refund quantity is more than the line's remaining refundable quantity. Read the line item's refunded_quantity and refund no more than the remaining units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_REFUND_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LINE_ITEM_TARGETS_EXCEED_REFUND_AMOUNT: The line items in the request add up to more than the refund amount_money. Raise amount_money to at least the line item total, or omit it to refund exactly the named lines.
