x-flint-enum-descriptions.LIST_RESERVED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_GEOGRAPHY_INVALID: The Location geography input is structurally invalid. Correct the address, timezone, coordinate, or coordinate source and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_INVALID: The Location request is structurally invalid. Correct the reported Location field and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The Location is not active for a new dependency or claim. Activate the Location or choose another active Location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_TOO_LONG: The event venue is longer than 500 characters. Shorten event_config.venue to 500 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: The Location is not active in this environment. Use the ID of an active Location, or activate the Location before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_BOUND_VIOLATION: The new value is above the maximum an organization settings policy allows. Send a value at or below the organization's maximum for the setting identified by param, or ask the organization to change its settings policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_COMPLETIONS_BELOW_COMPLETED: max_completions is lower than the link's completed_count. Set max_completions to at least completed_count, or send null for no limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_LENGTH_NOT_APPLICABLE: max_length applies only to text and textarea custom fields. Remove max_length from dropdown and checkbox custom fields.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MAX_TOTAL_QUANTITY_BELOW_SOLD: event_config.max_total_quantity is lower than the tickets already sold or held by payments in progress. Set event_config.max_total_quantity to at least the event's sold and held tickets, or send null for no ticket limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED: The acting user has no role in this organization or its parent organizations. Use a credential created by a member of this organization or a parent organization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The merchant account URL is not on an active verified payment method domain or one of its subdomains. Flint registers the URL's hostname as a payment method domain when you save it. Read it with GET /v1/payment-method-domains, run its check again with PATCH status active once the hostname serves your site, then save merchant_account_url again; if you send an idempotency key, use a new one.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_NOT_READY: The merchant payment account is not ready for domain registration. Complete merchant payment onboarding in the selected environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_ACCOUNT_SETUP_R: The merchant's account setup needs repair before an account session can be created. Contact Flint support to repair account setup before creating another account session.
The merchant must complete account setup before creating an account session. Complete account setup through the onboarding API, then create an account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_ACCOUNT_SETUP_U: The merchant's account setup is unavailable for account sessions. Contact Flint support to restore account setup before creating an account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_CONTROLLER_MISM: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_INELIGIBLE: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_INVALID_COMPONE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_INVALID_LAUNCH_: launch_token is missing, invalid, or expired. Create a new account session and send its launch_token.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_INVALID_POLICY_: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_LAUNCH_TOKEN_SC: launch_token belongs to a different merchant environment than the authenticated caller. Use a launch_token created for the authenticated merchant environment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_POLICY_NOT_SUPP: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_PROVIDER_GRANT_: The provider issued an account session grant that does not match Flint's request. Contact Flint support with the request_id before creating another account session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_TARGETED_REMEDI: Targeted remediation is unavailable for one or more requested requirement IDs. Retrieve the merchant's current requirements and use requirement IDs that support targeted remediation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_UNMAPPABLE_REQU: The requirement ID cannot be targeted in an account session. Use an available targeted_requirement_ids value from the merchant's current requirements.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ADDRESS_INCOMPLETE: The merchant address is missing a required field. Send address with line1, city, state, postal_code, and country, or send address as null to clear it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_BILLING_SUSPENDED: Payment processing is suspended because the merchant billing balance is past due. Processing resumes automatically once the merchant's past-due Flint balance is paid. The merchant can see what it owes under Billing in the Flint Dashboard and contact Flint support to pay.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_ONBOARDING_REQUIRED: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_PROCESSING_RESTRICTED: The merchant's payment account is restricted and cannot accept payments. Retrieve the merchant to find the required remediation, resolve it, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: A merchant must be selected before creating an onboarding session. Retry with a merchant_id from selectable_merchants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MERCHANT_UNDER_REVIEW: Flint paused payment processing for this merchant account while it completes a review. Processing resumes when Flint completes the review. The merchant can contact Flint support for details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METADATA_KEY_TOO_LONG: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METADATA_TOO_LARGE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METADATA_TOO_MANY_KEYS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METADATA_VALUE_TOO_LONG: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The route exists, but does not support the requested HTTP method. Use one of the methods supported by the route, as listed in the Allow header.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ME_CUSTOMER_ID_FORBIDDEN: The customer is determined by the customer session on every /v1/me route. Remove customer_id from the query string and request body, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MINIMUM_BALANCE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MIN_BOUND_VIOLATION: The new value is below the minimum an organization settings policy allows. Send a value at or above the organization's minimum for the setting identified by param, or ask the organization to change its settings policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MISSING_DISPLAY_NAME: The promotion display_name is empty. Send a non-empty display_name, or omit it to keep the current value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MISSING_EXCLUSIVITY_GROUP: The promotion exclusivity is missing its group. Set exclusivity.group to a non-empty name, or omit exclusivity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MIXED_VARIANT_CURRENCIES: Product variants use different currencies. Use one currency for every variant in the product.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_DEFAULT_INVALID: The modifier defaults conflict with the group's selection limits. Set selected_by_default to true for any modifier with default_quantity, select no more defaults than max_selected, and keep default quantities within max_total_quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_DUPLICATE_SELECTION: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_GROUP_NAME_REQUIRED: The modifier group name is missing. Provide a non-empty modifier group name.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_GROUP_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE: A referenced modifier group was archived before the modifier set was saved. Retrieve the modifier group, replace it with an active reusable modifier group, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_METADATA_UNSUPPORTED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_OVERRIDE_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_QUANTITY_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_SELECTION_ID_INVALID: order_line_item_modifier_id does not match an existing modifier selection on the line item. Send the order_line_item_modifier_id of the existing selection for the same modifier, or omit it to add a new selection.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_SELECTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_SET_GROUP_SOURCE_INVALID: The referenced modifier group is defined inline by a modifier set and cannot be reused. Use source existing with a reusable modifier group ID, or define the group with source inline.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_SET_NAME_REQUIRED: The modifier set name is missing. Provide a non-empty modifier set name.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_TEXT_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MODIFIER_UNAVAILABLE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MONEY_MOVEMENT_OPERATION_BLOCKED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MONEY_MOVEMENT_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MONTHLY_PAYOUT_DAYS_NOT_ALLOWED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.MULTIPLE_IDENTITIES_FOUND: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NAME_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NAME_TOO_LONG: The name is longer than this resource allows. Shorten the name to the maximum length in the error message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NEW_ACCOUNT_PAYOUT_TERMS_ACTIVE: Flint pays new live accounts at most once a week for their first 60 days. Choose a schedule that pays out at most once a week, keep delay_days_override at or above delay_days, or make the change after payout_terms_expires_at.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NORMALIZED_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The normalized image exceeds Flint's canonical byte limit. Reduce the source dimensions or complexity, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTE_TOO_LONG: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND: Nothing remains to refund: the order or payment is fully refunded, or a bank return already took the money back. Treat the refund as already complete. List the order's refunds and disputes to see where the money went.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_CHARGE: A charge in the request has nothing left to refund. Remove the fully refunded charge from charges and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_LINE_ITEM: A line item in the request has nothing left to refund. Remove the fully refunded line item from line_items and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOTHING_TO_REFUND_FOR_TAX_BREAKDOWN: The selected flat tax has no refundable amount remaining. Remove the tax breakdown from the request or read the order and its refunds before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NOT_ALLOWED: This request cannot use the field's value. Change the field named by param to a value this request can use.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NO_DISCOUNTABLE_BALANCE: No order balance is eligible for the requested discount. Remove the discount or add eligible line item value, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NO_FIELDS_TO_UPDATE: The update contains no mutable fields. Provide at least one mutable field documented for this resource.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.NO_PAYMENTS_FOR_ORDER: The order has no succeeded payments to refund. Wait for a processing payment to succeed before refunding, or leave the order unrefunded if nothing was collected.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ONBOARDING_CONTROLLER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTE: The application release cannot resume the provider-account controller policy frozen on this onboarding attempt. Contact Flint support before retrying. Account setup cannot resume until Flint restores support for this account's setup configuration.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ONBOARDING_DIRECT_OWNER_REQUIRED: The direct merchant owner who initiated onboarding no longer authorizes initial provider-account setup. Have the initiating direct owner retry, or restart before provider provisioning under the current direct owner.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ONBOARDING_PROFILE_PROVIDER_MANAGED: The account profile is managed through the embedded account experience after provider account setup begins. Open an account-management session and edit the profile there.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.OPTION_VALUE_TOO_LONG: The product option value label is too long. Use a value label with no more than 255 characters.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_CLOSED: The order is already closed. Read the order and continue from its current terminal state instead of closing it again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_ACTIVE_INVOICE: The order already has an active invoice. Use the invoice listed in blocking_resources or void it before creating another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_PAYMENTS: The order already has a payment, so it cannot be invoiced. Inspect the payments and owning invoices listed in blocking_resources. Invoice an unpaid order, or collect the remaining balance another way.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_HAS_REFUNDS: The order has a refund, so it cannot be invoiced. Inspect the refunds listed in blocking_resources. Invoice an order that has no refunds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_PAID: This change isn't allowed after the order has received a payment. Keep the current settings. Change order charges or tax mode and enablement only before the order receives a payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED: The order changed after the caller prepared the request. Refresh the order or checkout session and rebuild the request from current state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CHARGE_TAX_INPUT_REQUIRED: A taxable order charge is missing required tax input. Provide the charge tax field identified by param, then retry. order_charge_id identifies an existing charge: send the fields named by details[].param to PATCH /v1/orders/{order_id}/charges/{order_charge_id}, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CHECKOUT_SESSION_CHANGED: The order's open checkout session changed while this request was running. Retry the request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CLOSED: The order is closed and cannot accept this change. Read the order and continue from its current state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_COLLECTION_ALREADY_ACTIVE: Another collection flow is already active for this order. Finish or close the collection resource listed in blocking_resources before starting another flow.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_COLLECTION_IN_PROGRESS: A checkout or invoice flow currently owns collection for the order. Finish or close the collection resource listed in blocking_resources before starting another payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CONFLICT: The order changed before this request could commit. Read the current order and retry the intended change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CURRENCY_REQUIRED: The order has no line items, so it has no currency for a charge. Add at least one line item to the order before adding charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_SET: The order already belongs to a customer and cannot be reassigned. Keep the current customer_id or create a new order for a different customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE: An open checkout already owns collection for the order, so customer authority cannot change under its issued credential. Close the checkout session listed in blocking_resources before setting customer_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_NOT_CLEARABLE: The order customer cannot be cleared. Keep the current customer_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CUSTOMER_NOT_UPDATABLE_AFTER_PAYME: The order customer cannot change after payment begins. Set customer_id before starting payment, or keep the current customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_DELAYED_CAPTURE_SPLIT_PAYMENT_UNSU: Delayed capture currently supports only one payment leg per order attempt. Use a single manual-capture leg, or use automatic capture for split payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_DELIVERY_DESTINATION_REPRICE_REQUI: The new delivery destination changes shipping or tax, or the paid delivery method is unavailable. Refund and cancel the order, or contact the buyer before arranging delivery to a different destination.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_DISCOUNT_NO_CHARGE_IDS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_DISCOUNT_NO_LINE_ITEM_IDS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_FINANCIAL_MUTATION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order's financial fields cannot change after a refund is created. Use an explicit refund or credit adjustment instead of changing the order total.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_ACTIVE_PAYMENT_INTENT: The order has an active payment intent, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Cancel the payment intents listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_MANUAL_PAYMENTS: The order has recorded manual payments, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Reverse the manual payments on the invoices listed in blocking_resources, or collect the remaining balance on the existing invoice.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_CHARGES: The request names charges, but the order has no charges. Remove charges from the request, or refund the order's line items or amount_money instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_LINE_ITEMS: The order has no line items. Add line items to the order before issuing its invoice, or refund by amount_money without line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_REFUNDABLE_CHARGES: The request names charges, but none of the order's charges has a settled amount left to refund. Remove charges from the request, or refund the order's line items or amount_money instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_NO_REFUNDABLE_LINE_ITEMS: The request names line items, but none of the order's line items has a settled amount left to refund for this payment. Remove line_items from the request, or refund the order's charges or amount_money instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_HAS_OPEN_CHECKOUT: The order has an open checkout session, so the order cannot be invoiced or the invoice cannot be sent. Close the checkout sessions listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_NOT_RESOLVABLE: The order has no paid inventory failure to resolve. Resolve only orders whose inventory_exception_status is paid_inventory_failed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_UNRESOLVED: The order has an unresolved paid inventory failure, so its fulfillments cannot change. Resolve the order's inventory exception, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LINE_ITEM_TAX_INPUT_REQUIRED: A taxable order line item is missing required tax input. Provide the line item tax field identified by param, then retry. order_line_item_id identifies an existing line item. For an ad hoc line item, send the fields named by details[].param to PATCH /v1/orders/{order_id}/line-items/{order_line_item_id}. A catalog-backed or gift card line item does not accept tax changes, so remove it and add it again. Then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LINE_ITEM_VERSION_CONFLICT: The line item changed after it was read. Read the current order, then retry with the line item's version as expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LINKED_AMOUNT_NOT_UPDATABLE: The order owns this payment intent's amount. Update the order to change its payment amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_NOT_FULFILLABLE: Fulfillments can change only while the order's payment_status is paid. Read the order and retry after its payment_status is paid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The order is closed or fully paid, so it cannot accept this action. Read the order and continue from its current state, or use an open order with an unpaid balance.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: The order is not open for payment. Read the order and start or capture payments only while its status is open and it is not fully paid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_OWNED_PAYMENT_INTENT_REQUIRED: The selected payment intent is not owned by this order. Create payment intents through the order-scoped route, then select those IDs, or use payment_source for a one-shot payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ACTIVE: The order has lock-owning payment work in progress. Read active_payment_attempt. Resume it only when is_resumable is true; otherwise cancel, capture, or resolve it as allowed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND: The order has no active payment authorization for this payment intent. Read the order's payment attempts and capture or cancel the payment intent of the attempt whose status is requires_capture.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The order's customer does not match the customer of the selected payment intents or of this checkout. Use payment intents and a checkout for the order's customer_id, or ask the merchant to update the order's customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_FLOW_REQUIRED: The payment intent belongs to an order. Follow remediation.next_actions to pay, capture, or cancel through the owning order. Use a credential with commerce.orders.write and provide any required_fields.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE_IN_PROGRESS: Creation of an order-owned payment intent with this idempotency key is still in progress. Retry the same request with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE_REQUIRES_REV: Flint could not automatically reconcile the creation of the order's payment intent. Contact support with the request_id and the order ID. Do not start another payment for the order until support confirms the payment intent's state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_ALREADY_SETTLED: The order payment leg already settled and cannot be canceled. Create a refund or reversal instead of canceling the payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PAYMENT_LEG_CHECKOUT_ACTIVE: A hosted checkout session is open for the order, and the order already has an unpaid payment leg. Cancel the leg in payment_intent_ids with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/cancel before you stage another, or close the session in existing_checkout_session_id and collect the split payment in your own payment UI.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PERCENTAGE_TAX_FORBIDDEN: An order-scoped tax component uses percentage calculation. Use flat_amount for an order-scoped component. Put percentage components on line items or charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_EMAIL_ON_FILE: This order already has a receipt email. Omit email to send to the address on file.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: The order does not have an email address that can receive a receipt. Add an email address to the customer or order, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_MERCHANT_MANAGED: Flint receipt delivery is disabled because the merchant sends its own receipts. Contact the merchant to request another receipt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE: The order does not have a paid receipt that can be sent. Check that the order has a successful payment before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_RECIPIENT_LIMIT_REACHED: This order already sent receipts to 3 email addresses, the limit for checkout credentials. Send to an address already used, or send the receipt with a secret API key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECEIPT_RECIPIENT_RESTRICTED: This checkout link cannot send a receipt to a new email address. Omit email to send the receipt to the email given for the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: The order payment state requires operational reconciliation before more money movement is safe. Read the order and its payments to confirm the outcome. Contact support with the request_id and order ID before starting another payment if the outcome is unresolved.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REQUIRED_FOR_CHARGE_REFUND: Charge refunds need an order, and the payment intent has none. Send an order_id, or refund the payment intent by amount_money without charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REQUIRED_FOR_LINE_ITEM_REFUND: Line item refunds need an order, and the payment intent has none. Send an order_id, or refund the payment intent by amount_money without line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REQUIRED_FOR_TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUND: An order-scoped tax refund requires order_id. Provide the order_id that owns the tax breakdown.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_STATUS_NOT_CLOSABLE: The order's current status does not allow it to be closed. Read the order and complete the actions supported by its current status before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_FULL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Automatic tax needs a full street address for the order's tax location. Update the order's tax.location.address with line1, city, state, postal_code, and country, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_LOCATION_INVALID: The tax location is invalid or cannot be placed. Correct the address field identified by param, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_LOCATION_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_NOT_READY: The order's tax is not ready for issuing an invoice or collecting payment. For an order created by a return, tax follows the return and cannot be changed directly; read the return's current resolution. For other orders, read tax.status: send tax.location when requires_location; update the order's tax to recalculate when incomplete; then submit the request again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_NOT_UPDATABLE: The order's tax follows its return or cannot change after payment. Keep the tax settings for an order whose tax follows its return. For other orders, set tax before starting payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE: The tax connection has no rate for the order's tax location. Use external tax, or contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TAX_UNSUPPORTED_COUNTRY: Automatic tax does not support the selected country. Provide a US tax location, or use external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TIP_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: This order does not support requested-tip changes. Create a new order to use the current requested-tip model.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TOTALS_UNAVAILABLE: Flint could not calculate the order's totals from its stored state. Contact support with the request_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TOTAL_BELOW_NET_COLLECTED: The change would reduce the order total, or its items and charges without the unpaid tip, below the money already collected. Use an explicit refund or credit adjustment instead of reducing the order total.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION_CYCLE: The new parent organization is a descendant of this organization. Choose a parent_organization_id outside this organization's subtree.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The referenced organization is deleted. Choose an active organization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.OUTBOUND_PACKAGE_RETURN_FIELDS_FORBIDDEN: return_line_items applies only to packages on return shipments. Remove return_line_items, or create the package on a return shipment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.OUTBOUND_SHIPMENT_RETURN_FIELDS_FORBIDDE: return_id and return_line_items apply only to return shipments. Set direction to return, or remove return_id and return_line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PACKAGE_CHANGED: Another write changed the package while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the package again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PACKAGE_PARENT_CHANGED: The package's shipment or fulfillment changed while the transition was running. Read the current package and its shipment or fulfillment, then retry the transition if it is still valid.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_MODIFIER_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: The line item's modifiers cannot change after the line item has been paid for. Keep the current modifiers, or add a new line item with the modifiers you need.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_PRICE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: Line item prices cannot change after the order has received a payment. Keep the current unit_price_money, or add a new line item and refund the original instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_QUANTITY_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: The quantity of a paid line item cannot change. Add a new line item for additional quantity, or create a refund to reduce it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_QUANTITY_DECREASE_FORBIDD: The quantity is below the units already paid for or committed for this line item. Send a quantity at least as large as the paid or committed units, or create a refund instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_REMOVAL_FORBIDDEN: The line item has already been paid for and cannot be removed. Keep the line item and create a refund for it instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAID_LINE_ITEM_TAX_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: Tax settings cannot change on settled line items or charges. Keep the line item's or charge's current tax settings, or add a new line item or charge.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PARTIAL_CAPTURE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Affirm authorizations must be captured in full. Omit amount_money, or send the full capturable amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAUSE_DURATION_TOO_LONG: The pause is longer than the store lets buyers pause. Send pause_duration_cycles from 1 to the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.pause.max_cycles.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAUSE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't let buyers pause subscriptions. Offer the buyer cancellation instead. The store can turn on customer_account.buyer_capabilities.pause.enabled.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ACTION_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: The hosted payment attempt does not have enough remaining time to start a redirect payment. Start a fresh order payment attempt or choose card.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ALREADY_CANCELED: The payment intent has already been canceled. Retrieve the payment intent to confirm its status. No further cancellation is needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ALREADY_SETTLED: The payment method setup for this payment attempt has succeeded and cannot be canceled. Read the payment attempt and continue from its completed state instead of canceling it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ALREADY_SUCCEEDED: The payment intent has already succeeded. Retrieve the payment intent. No further confirmation is needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_CHANGED: The payment intent amount changed while the confirmation was starting. Retrieve the payment intent to check its amount, then confirm again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_MISMATCH: The submitted payment attempt does not own the selected payment intent. Refresh the order or payment attempt, then send the owning order_payment_attempt_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payment attempt already finished and cannot be canceled. Read the attempt status. A failed or expired attempt holds nothing to cancel, and settled money needs a refund instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_NOT_RESUMABLE: The requested payment attempt cannot be resumed from its current status. Read the attempt status and start, cancel, or capture only the work allowed by that state.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_REQUIRES_CAPTURE: An authorized payment is waiting to be captured or canceled. Capture or cancel the payment attempt or payment intent listed in blocking_resources, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_RESUME_CONFLICT: A payment-attempt resume request included fields that belong to a new start. Send order_payment_attempt_id alone, with only an optional expected_outstanding_money assertion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED: The payment authorization has expired and can no longer be captured. Start a new payment for the order instead of capturing this authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_CAPTURABLE: The payment intent has no active authorization to capture or cancel. Read the payment intent and capture or cancel only while its status is requires_capture.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CANCELED: The payment intent has been canceled and cannot be confirmed. Create a new payment intent to collect this payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CAPTURE_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The requested capture method is not allowed for this order payment caller or start shape. Use automatic capture, or create an explicit merchant-authorized payment leg for delayed capture.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_STATE_CHANGED: The confirmation request no longer matches the PaymentIntent's durable attempt. Refresh the PaymentIntent, then start a new confirmation only if its current state permits it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_CONFIRM_IN_PROGRESS: A different confirmation of this payment intent is already in progress. Wait for confirmation of the payment intent in blocking_resources to finish. Confirm again only if it still requires confirmation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_EXPIRED: The payment intent has expired and cannot be confirmed. Create a new payment intent to collect this payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_CANNOT_BE_UPDATED: The payment intent is processing, succeeded, canceled, or expired and can no longer be updated. Retrieve the payment intent to check its status. Create a new payment intent if you need different values.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_DISPUTED: A payment has an active or lost chargeback and cannot be refunded. Read the payment's dispute_status and refund an eligible payment instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_LIMIT_REACHED: The order has reached its lifetime limit of payment intents. Create a new order to collect this payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payment is processing and cannot be canceled because its bank debit was already submitted. Wait for the payment to succeed or fail. Refund it after it succeeds if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_NOT_PART_OF_ORDER: The payment intent does not belong to the order in the request. Send the order_id that owns the payment intent, or send only payment_intent_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_NOT_REFUNDABLE: Only a succeeded payment intent can be refunded. Cancel an uncaptured authorization instead, or wait for a processing payment to succeed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_INTENT_ORDER_MISMATCH: The payment intent is not linked to this order. Send a payment_intent_id that belongs to the order in the path.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: A payment on this resource is still in progress. Wait for the payment to finish, then retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key. blocking_resources names the blocking resource when Flint knows it: a checkout session, invoice, payment attempt, or payment intent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LEG_SELECTION_REQUIRED: The order payment request needs an explicit payment-leg selection. Select the payment intents listed in the error details, create an order-owned leg, or use payment_source when no selectable leg exists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_CHANGED_RETRY: The payment link changed before the checkout publication committed. Read the public payment link again and start a new resolve operation with a new context and idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_FULFILLMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The payment link references delivery configuration that is not currently available. Update the payment link to use active delivery methods, then resolve it again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_INACTIVE: The payment link is inactive, so it cannot start a checkout. Show inactive_message to the buyer when present. The merchant must set the payment link status to active before buyers can use it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_LINE_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: modifiers names a line item that is not selected for checkout. Send modifiers only for line item keys that have a quantity of 1 or more in this checkout.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_MAX_COMPLETIONS_REACHED: The payment link has reached its maximum number of completions. Use another payment link, or raise the link's max_completions.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_METADATA_TOO_LARGE: The metadata and the largest possible custom field answers exceed the 32,768-byte order metadata budget. Lower max_length on some custom fields, use fewer custom fields, or reduce metadata.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_METADATA_TOO_MANY_KEYS: The metadata pairs plus custom fields exceed 44, the limit after 6 order metadata pairs reserved for Flint. Remove metadata pairs or custom fields so they total 44 or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_RESOLUTION_CONTEXT_INVALID: The payment-link resolution context is malformed, invalid, or belongs to another payment link. Read the public payment link again and start a new resolve operation with the newly issued context.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_RESOLUTION_CONTEXT_REFRESH_: The resolution context expired, no longer matches the link delivery methods, or has too little time left to start checkout. Read the public payment link again and start a new resolve operation with the refreshed context.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_RESOLUTION_REPLAY_UNAVAILAB: The checkout recorded for this payment-link operation can no longer issue authentication. Read the public payment link again and start a new checkout operation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_LINK_SALES_ENDED: Sales through the payment link have ended. Show inactive_message to the buyer when present. The merchant can set a later sales_end_at on the payment link to sell again.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The payment method belongs to a different customer. Use an active payment method owned by the subscription customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_DOMAIN_OPERATION_IN_PROGR: Another payment method domain operation is still in progress. Wait for the active operation to finish, then retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTIONS: A subscription that is not canceled still uses the payment method. Move each subscription to another payment method or cancel it, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_ACTIVE: The saved payment method is not active. Use an active saved payment method, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_READY: The payment method setup has not finished. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key once the buyer finishes card setup.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_ON_SESSION_ONLY: The buyer saved this card for checkout only, so Flint does not charge it without them. Use a payment method whose usage is off_session, or collect a card the buyer saves for future charges.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: A required saved payment method was not provided or could not be resolved. Provide or collect an active saved payment method, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: An emailed code can't confirm this card: the customer's email isn't the email this checkout's payment was made with. Confirm the card with the code texted to the number given with the payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_NOT_PENDING: The card from this checkout's payment no longer waits for confirmation: it is saved, or was not confirmed within 24 hours. Read payment_method_save on the checkout session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_METHOD_SAVE_NOT_READY: No card from this checkout's payment waits for confirmation yet; the payment may still be finishing. Read the checkout session again in a few seconds, then request the code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED: The collection context has no outstanding balance to charge. Complete the zero-balance order without a payment source, or use setup_payment_source for an allowed future-billing setup.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another operation is in progress for this payment intent. Wait for the operation on the payment intent listed in blocking_resources to finish, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTIONS_NOT_COMPARABLE: Cost comparison needs ACH debit and at least one card payment option. Enable ach_debit and card, apple_pay, or google_pay, or set show_cost_comparison to false.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The invoice balance exceeds the configured limit for this payment option. Use an allowed payment option with a sufficient limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_LIMIT_NOT_ENABLED: A payment option limit refers to a payment option that is not enabled. Add the payment option to enabled_payment_options or remove its limit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED: The payment option or payment method is not allowed for this payment. Choose a payment option or payment method this payment allows. The error's message and reason name the rule that blocked it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_READY: The payment option has one or more readiness blockers. Use the error details to identify every blocker, its reason, and the responsible next step.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: This settings scope cannot configure the payment option. Configure the payment option in merchant settings.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_OPTION_UNAVAILABLE: The requested payment option is not available for this merchant, amount, or checkout. Choose a payment option that is enabled and available for this merchant and amount, or enable one in settings, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSING_NOT_ENABLED: Flint has not enabled payment processing for this merchant environment. Contact Flint support with the request_id. Retrying the same request fails until Flint enables processing.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSING_UNAVAILABLE: Payment processing is temporarily unavailable for this merchant environment. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Contact support with the request_id if processing remains unavailable.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_REJECTED: The payment processor rejected the request. Retrieve the payment intent to check its current status and amount, correct the request if needed, then retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE: The merchant has no payment processor account set up for this environment. Complete the merchant's onboarding requirements for this environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_RETURN_URL_INVALID: The payment return destination violates Flint's clean redirect rules. Use an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment. Test-mode loopback URLs may use HTTP.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_REVIEW_OPEN: The payment has an open risk review and must be approved before it can be captured. Approve the review named in blocking_resources and remediation.next_actions, then retry the capture.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_CONFLICT: The request supplied mutually exclusive payment credentials. Keep exactly one credential field from conflicting_fields and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED: The submitted payment source is not allowed for this caller or payment mode. Use a payment source allowed for the authenticated caller and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_NOT_UPDATABLE: A payment source can be attached only while the payment intent requires a payment method. Retrieve the payment intent to check its status. Complete its pending action, or create a new order payment intent for the new payment source.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH: The saved payment method is not owned by the customer authorized for this order payment. Use a saved payment method owned by the checkout customer, or collect a new payment source.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_REQUIRED: The payment start request does not include a payment source. Submit payment_intents with credentials, payment_source, setup_payment_source, or a resumable order_payment_attempt_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_SELECTION_CONFLICT: The request supplied both payment_source_selection and payment_options. Remove payment_source_selection and use payment_options for the order payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The submitted payment source is no longer available for this attempt. Collect or select another payment source and start a new attempt.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_START_SHAPE_CONFLICT: The request mixed mutually exclusive order payment start shapes. Keep exactly one of payment_source, payment_intents, or setup_payment_source and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYMENT_UPDATE_REJECTED: The payment update was rejected. Check the requested fields, then send the corrected update with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUTS_NOT_ENABLED: Payouts are not enabled for this merchant. Check status_reason and next_actions in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete them, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DELAY_PROVIDER_CONTROLLED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DESTINATIONS_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILAB: Payout destinations cannot be managed for this merchant. Check the manage_payout_destinations capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_DESTINATION_UPDATE_EMPTY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_FEE_NOT_DETERMINABLE: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payout cannot be canceled in its current status. Read the payout and check current_status before attempting to cancel it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_SETTINGS_MANAGED_EXTERNALLY: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_SETTINGS_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Payout settings cannot be managed for this merchant. Check the manage_payout_settings capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_SETTINGS_UPDATE_EMPTY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PAYOUT_STATUS_NOT_CANCELABLE: The payout's current status does not allow cancellation. Inspect current_status and retrieve the payout to confirm its outcome.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PERCENT_OFF_REQUIRED: The stored promotion has no percentage discount. Set application_method.percent_off on the promotion before applying this change.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE: The subscription plan does not accept new signups because it is inactive or archived. Use an active subscription plan.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PRICE_TOO_HIGH: The unit price amount exceeds the maximum. Send a unit_price_money.amount of 99,999,999 or less, in minor units.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING_FEE_PRICING_NOT_AUTHORIZED: No authorized processing price covers this payment, so it was rejected before reaching the processor. Contact the merchant account owner to confirm that this payment option and amount are enabled. Retrying the same request will not succeed until the account configuration changes.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROCESSOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: The merchant has not finished live account setup with the payment processor. Complete merchant onboarding, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PRODUCT_LINE_ITEM_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The line item identifies a product without a sellable variant or bundle. Provide variant_id, bundle_id, or ad-hoc line item fields instead of product_id alone. When order_line_item_id identifies an existing line item, remove it and add a replacement line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PRODUCT_OPTIONS_REQUIRED: The product has no active options, so it cannot have additional variants. Add an active option to the product before creating variants, or change the simple product through its default variant.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROFILE_UPDATE_STATUS_UNKNOWN: Flint could not confirm the account profile update. Read the merchant profile to confirm whether the update applied before sending another update. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_ARCHIVED: The promotion is archived and cannot be changed. Create a new promotion to apply another discount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_CODES_DISABLED: Promotion codes are turned off in the merchant's promotion settings. Set promotions.codes_enabled to true with PATCH /v1/settings first, or stop turning on promotion codes in the field identified by param.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_CONFLICT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_DECLINED: The promotion could not be applied to this order. Use reason to correct the promotion or order inputs, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_FILTER_TARGET_CONFLICT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_HAS_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_OFFERS: Active subscription offers use this promotion, and an offer's discount must apply to every renewal. Remove the promotion from the offers in blocking_resources, or make those offers inactive, then change the recurrence.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_NOT_CODE_GATED: The promotion is automatic, so it cannot have promotion codes. Create codes only for a promotion whose redemption_type is code.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_NOT_REDEEMABLE: Another payment took this promotion's last use while this payment was starting. Another payment took this promotion's last use while this payment was starting. Retry with a new Idempotency-Key. Flint then removes the discount and returns ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, so show the buyer the new total before paying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROMOTION_SHAPE_IMMUTABLE: A redeemed promotion cannot change its discount_class or application_method type. Keep the current discount_class and application_method type, or create a new promotion.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.PROVIDER_ACCOUNT_CLEANUP_REQUIRED: The merchant is not ready for this operation. Complete the required merchant readiness or onboarding action before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_ABOVE_MAX: A quantity_overrides value is above the line item's max_quantity or above 9,999. Send a quantity at or below the line item's max_quantity and no more than 9,999.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_BELOW_MIN: A quantity_overrides value is below the line item's min_quantity or below 1. Send a quantity of at least 1 and at or above the line item's min_quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other quantities for this subscription. Change it only when the subscription's quantity_options lists more than one option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.QUANTITY_NOT_ADJUSTABLE: quantity_overrides names a line item whose quantity buyers cannot change. Remove the line item from quantity_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request exceeded the configured rate limit. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Use the Retry-After header when present.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RECEIPT_EMAIL_NOT_UPDATABLE: receipt_email can only be updated before the payment is confirmed. Omit receipt_email from the update.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RECIPIENT_EMAIL_REQUIRED: Invoice email delivery requires a recipient email. Set recipient_email or issue with caller_managed delivery.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENTS_EXCEED_AUTOMATIC: The line item's refund adjustments and withheld tax equal or exceed the line's automatic refund amount. Lower the refund_adjustments amounts or withheld tax so part of the line is still refunded, or leave the line out of the refund.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_AUDIT_ACTOR_ID_TOO_LON: tax_adjustment_audit.actor_id is longer than 255 characters. Send an actor_id of 255 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_AUDIT_SOURCE_TOO_LONG: tax_adjustment_audit.source is longer than 255 characters. Send a source of 255 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_LINE_ITEM_MISMATCH: The adjustment being refunded belongs to a different line item than the one in the request. Move the adjustment_refunds entry under the line_items entry whose order_line_item_id matches the adjustment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_PAYMENT_INTENT_MISMATC: The adjustment being refunded was withheld from a different payment than the payment_intent_id in the request. Send the payment_intent_id the adjustment was withheld from, or omit payment_intent_id and refund by order_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_PAYMENT_INTENT_NOT_REF: A named line item or adjustment refund is tied to a payment that has nothing left to refund on the order. Remove the target tied to that payment, or refund it from a payment that still has a refundable amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_DESCRIPTION_TOO: An adjustment reason description is longer than 1,024 characters. Shorten the description in refund_adjustments[].reason or tax_adjustment_reason to 1,024 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT: The line items and adjustment refunds tied to one payment add up to more than that payment can still refund. Read the order's payments and refunds, and lower the named line items or adjustment_refunds amounts for that payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_ADJUSTMENT_REFUND_EXCEEDS_REMAINI: The adjustment refund amount is more than the adjustment's remaining withheld amount. Read the adjustment's remaining_money on the original refund and send no more than that amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_AMOUNT_NOT_ALLOCATED: Part of amount_money cannot be assigned to the order's line items, charges, tips, or tax, even when no targets are named. Refund a smaller amount, name the order's flat tax in tax_breakdown_refunds with its full remaining tax_money, or refund the full remaining amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_EXPIRED: The payment method's provider refund-submission window has ended. Reimburse the customer outside the original payment method and preserve the Refund history for reconciliation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_TARGETS_EXCEED_REFUND_AMOUNT: The line items, charges, and tax breakdowns in the request add up to more than amount_money or their tender_allocations. Raise amount_money or the tender_allocations amounts to cover every named target, or remove targets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_TARGETS_NOT_ALLOCATED: Some named line items, charges, or tax breakdowns were paid by a tender the refund does not return money to. Add tender_allocations for the payments that funded the named targets, or remove those targets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REFUND_TENDER_CAPACITY_CONFLICT: Refund allocations exceed an original tender's remaining value or do not cover the selected order components. Read the order and its refunds, include pending refunds in capacity, cover selected order components, and submit revised allocations with a new Idempotency-Key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REPORT_CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: gift_card_liability_v1 reports support USD only. Set currency to USD.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REPORT_DOWNLOAD_EXPIRED: The report download expired. Create a new report for the same interval.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REPORT_INTERVAL_INCOMPLETE: The report interval has not finished yet. Use an interval_end_at at or before the current time.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REPORT_INTERVAL_TOO_LARGE: The report interval exceeds 366 days in the report's timezone. Request an interval of at most 366 days.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_BLOCKED: Flint's firewall blocked the request before it reached the API because its body contains a URL that points to a private, loopback, or cloud metadata address. Remove any URL that points to a private, loopback, or cloud metadata address from the request, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_BODY_NOT_ALLOWED: This operation does not accept request fields. Send an empty request body or {}.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request body is larger than the endpoint accepts. Send a body within the limit named in the error message. Split a large write into several requests, such as adding order line items in batches.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_CANCELED: The request was canceled before it completed. Send the request again if you still need it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response and request log, correct the request or resource state, then submit a new request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The request timed out before Flint could complete it. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the timeout persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUIRED: A required field is missing. Send the field named by param, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REQUIRED_CUSTOM_FIELD_MISSING: A required custom field has no answer. Send a non-empty answer in custom_field_values for every required custom field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESERVED_FIELD_NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESERVED_METADATA_KEY: Metadata keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint. Rename the metadata key so it does not start with flint_.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESOURCE_IN_USE: References to this resource prevent the change. Resolve the references in details[0].blocking_resources before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The requested resource could not be found for the authenticated merchant and environment. Check the resource ID, mode, and merchant context, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETENTION_OFFER_PAUSE_CYCLES_NOT_ALLOWED: A pause length was sent for a retention offer that isn't a pause. Remove retention_offer.pause_cycles, or set retention_offer.kind to pause_instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETENTION_OFFER_PAUSE_CYCLES_REQUIRED: A pause_instead offer needs its pause length. Set customer_account.buyer_capabilities.retention_offer.pause_cycles from 1 to 12.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETENTION_OFFER_PAUSE_TOO_LONG: The offered pause is longer than the store lets buyers pause. Set retention_offer.pause_cycles to at most pause.max_cycles, or raise pause.max_cycles.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETENTION_OFFER_REQUIRES_PAUSE: A pause_instead offer needs buyers to be able to pause. Set pause.enabled to true, or set retention_offer.kind to none.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: The requested Return action is not available in the current lifecycle state. Read the resource's supported_actions and current blockers before choosing the next action.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED: This order collects a return balance. Use POST /v1/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-session.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_COMPLETION_BLOCKED: The Return still has completion blockers. Read completion_blockers, resolve each outstanding fact or effect, and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_DISPOSITION_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The disposition exceeds available receipt or finalized inspection capacity. Read the current receipt or inspection line capacity and submit an available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_BUYER: The buyer Return request includes a field that only the merchant can set. Remove the field. Buyers cannot set it; the merchant sets it with a secret key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_FULFILLMENT_ALLOCATION_AMBIGUOUS: The Order line belongs to multiple completed Fulfillments. Choose one of the candidate fulfillment_id values returned by the error.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_INSPECTION_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The inspection exceeds current receipt-line capacity. Read the current receipt line and inspect only its available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_INVALID: The Return request is structurally or semantically invalid. Correct the fields identified by the error and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_LINE_CANCELLATION_CONFLICT: The requested Return line quantity is no longer safely cancelable. Use available_quantity and blocking_resources to cancel a smaller quantity or resolve the blocking work first.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_PACKAGE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_SHIPME: A package quantity exceeds the quantity the return shipment declares for that Return line. Send a quantity no greater than the shipment's return_line_items quantity for that line.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_PACKAGE_LINE_DUPLICATED: A Return line appears more than once in the package's return_line_items. List each return_line_item_id once and combine its quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_PACKAGE_QUANTITY_INVALID: A return_line_items quantity is not greater than zero. Send a positive quantity for each return line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_POLICY_CONFLICT: More than one Return policy matched with the same precedence. Change policy priority or scope so the evaluation has one deterministic winner.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_RECEIPT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED: The receipt verification exceeds outstanding handback capacity. Read the Return line quantities and verify only the available quantity.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SELF_SERVICE_NOT_ALLOWED: The return policy does not allow the buyer to request this return or resolution. Ask the merchant to review the request under their return policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SHIPMENT_INVALID: The return line items do not match the Return or this fulfillment. Correct return_id and return_line_items as described in the error message, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SHIPMENT_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILAB: The return shipment quantity exceeds the remaining declared shipment capacity. Read the return line quantities and send only the quantity still available for shipment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_SHIPMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID: A return_line_items quantity is not greater than zero. Send a positive quantity for each return line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_VALUE_EXCEEDED: The proposed resolution exceeds available Return quantity or value. Preview or read the current Return and allocate only unreserved value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RETURN_VERSION_CONFLICT: Another write changed the Return while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the Return again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REVERSAL_EXCEEDS_MANUAL_PAYMENTS: The reversal is larger than the manual payments applied to the invoice. Retrieve the invoice and reverse no more than its applied manual payment amount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REVIEW_ALREADY_CLOSED: The review is already closed. Retrieve the review to inspect its outcome and closed reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.REVIEW_RESOLUTION_IN_PROGRESS: A different review resolution is already in progress. Retrieve the review to inspect its pending action and resolution start time before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PAYMENT_FL: A risk rule requires 3D Secure, which this payment flow cannot complete because the cardholder is not present. Send the customer a payment link, or change the rule to skip this payment_flow.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_ACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PAYMENT_OP: A risk rule requires an action, such as review or 3D Secure, that the selected payment option does not support. Use a different payment option, or change the risk rule.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_LIST_ARCHIVED: The predicate references an archived risk list. Use an active risk list alias in the predicate.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RISK_LIST_TYPE_MISMATCH: The risk list item_type is incompatible with the predicate attribute. Use a risk list whose item_type supports the predicate attribute.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_FORBIDDEN: Your organization role cannot assign the requested role. Assign a role below your own: owners can assign admin, operator, or viewer, and admins can assign operator or viewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ROLE_MANAGEMENT_FORBIDDEN: Your organization role cannot change this member's current role. Ask a member with a higher role to make the change. Owners manage admins, operators, and viewers; admins manage operators and viewers.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ROOT_ORGANIZATION_CREATION_FORBIDDEN: API callers cannot create a root organization. Send parent_organization_id for an organization you manage, and do not clear the parent of an existing organization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: No public API route matched the request path. Check the path and remove unsupported trailing slashes or legacy routes before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RULE_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE_AT_STAGE: This risk rule action cannot be combined with post-authorization attributes. Use only pre-authorization attributes with this action, or choose an action that runs after authorization.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RULE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.RULE_RESERVED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_ARCHIVED: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_INACTIVE: The request could not be completed as submitted or in its current state. Inspect the error response, correct the request or resource state, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_MANAGEMENT_FORBIDDEN: The user's merchant role does not allow sandbox management. Ask a merchant owner or admin to make this change, or use a live API key that holds developer.sandboxes.write.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX_SELECTION_REQUIRED: The test-mode API key is not bound to a sandbox. Create or use a sandbox-bound test key for the sandbox this request should target, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE_LIMIT_REACHED: No more confirmation codes are available for this card on this channel. Confirm the saved card through the other channel.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: Saving a card requires one newly collected card sent in stripe.confirmation_token. Send the card the buyer typed as the only credential, in stripe.confirmation_token, with save_payment_method.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout does not offer saving the buyer's card. Read the checkout session with its checkout credential and send save_payment_method only when can_save_payment_method is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_PHONE_INVALID: save_payment_method_phone must be a US or Canadian mobile phone number in E.164 format. Send the number with +1, such as +14155552671, or save the card without a number.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_PHONE_NOT_ALLOWED: save_payment_method_phone applies only with save_payment_method, while the checkout acts for no customer or for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Send save_payment_method without save_payment_method_phone when the checkout acts for the customer the merchant named or a texted code bound it, or with save_payment_method: true otherwise.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_PHONE_NOT_OFFERED: This checkout can't text a code to confirm a saved card. Read the checkout session and send save_payment_method_phone only when can_save_payment_method_with_phone is true.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRES_FULL_PAYMEN: Saving a card requires a payment that completes the order. Pay the full balance or omit save_payment_method.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_TOKEN_MISMATCH: The stripe.confirmation_token does not match the buyer's choice to save the card. Create the stripe.confirmation_token with setup_future_usage on_session when the buyer saves the card, and without setup_future_usage when they do not.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED: Only a card typed into checkout can be saved for faster checkout, and this wallet, bank, or Affirm confirmation token was created to keep the payment method. Create wallet, bank, and Affirm confirmation tokens without setup_future_usage. A payment that sends save_payment_method with one then goes ahead without the save, and its payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SAVE_PAYMENT_METHOD_VERIFICATION_REQUIRE: Saving the card needs the buyer's email confirmed in this checkout first. Request a code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications, confirm it, then pay again with the checkout credential the confirmation returned.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SCHEDULED_SEND_IN_PAST: The scheduled send time is not in the future. Set scheduled_send_at to a future time, or omit it to keep the invoice as a draft.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_KEY_MODE: The requested scope is not available for the target API key mode. Remove the scope or create or use a live key from Dashboard, Developers, API keys.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SELF_ROLE_EDITS_FORBIDDEN: A member cannot change their own organization role. Use an API key created by a different member to change this user's role.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SENSITIVE_IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_INVALID: A secret-bearing mutation did not provide the recovery metadata required for safe durable replay. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm the outcome. Contact Flint support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVER_GENERATED_ID: The request supplied an ID that Flint assigns during creation. Remove the server-generated ID from the create request.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_CHARGE_DISCOUNT_NO_LINE_ITEM_IDS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_CHARGE_DISCOUNT_REQUIRES_CHARGE_: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_CHARGE_DISCOUNT_SCOPE_INVALID: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A service required to complete the request is temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SETTINGS_WRITE_FORBIDDEN: The credential is not allowed to change settings. Use an API key with the settings.write scope.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SETUP_SOURCE_NON_ZERO_ORDER: setup_payment_source can only be used when the order has no balance to pay. Pay the outstanding balance with payment_source or payment_intents, or use setup_payment_source only for a zero-balance subscription order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SETUP_SOURCE_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: setup_payment_source can only be used for an order that creates a subscription. Complete the zero-balance order without a payment source, or use an order created from a subscription plan.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_CHANGED: Another write changed the shipment while this request ran, after part of the change had started. The request sent no expected_version. Read the shipment again to see what was applied, then decide whether to send the change again. To make a stale version return VERSION_CONFLICT instead, send expected_version.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_ITEM_LINE_ITEM_NOT_IN_F: The order_line_item_id is not part of this package's fulfillment. Use an order_line_item_id from the fulfillment's line_items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_ITEM_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_F: The package items for this order line item would exceed its fulfillment quantity. Reduce quantity so the line's package items total no more than its quantity on the fulfillment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_NOT_MUTABLE: The package's contents can change only while its status is created or packed. Change items only on packages whose status is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_NOT_VOIDABLE: A package can be voided only while its status is created or packed. Read the package status, and void a package or its shipment only while every affected package is created or packed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_PROVIDER_REFERENCE_INCO: external_reference_id is set without external_system. Send external_system together with external_reference_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SHIPMENT_PACKAGE_TERMINAL: A delivered, returned, or voided package allows only metadata changes. Send only metadata for this package.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SKIP_LIMIT_REACHED: The buyer has reached the store's consecutive skip limit. Wait for the next charged cycle, which resets the skip count, or ask the merchant to skip this cycle.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SKIP_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow buyers to skip subscription cycles. Ask the store to skip the cycle or enable customer_account.buyer_capabilities.skip.enabled.
