x-flint-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_CONTEXT_CONFLICT: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.STANDARD_PAYOUTS_UNAVAILABLE: Standard payouts are not enabled for this merchant. Check the create_standard_payouts capability in readiness.capabilities on GET /v1/merchant, complete its next actions, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.STANDARD_PAYOUT_REQUIRES_MANUAL_SCHEDULE: Standard manual payouts require a manual payout schedule. Change the payout schedule interval to manual before creating a standard payout.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_PAUSED: The subscription is already paused with a different length. Resume the subscription before pausing it with a new pause_duration_cycles.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_INTERVAL_NOT_OFFERE: The plan does not offer the selected billing interval. Choose a billing_interval and billing_interval_count pair from the plan's billing_interval_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_START_INVALID: The subscription billing start branch is missing, mixed, or invalid. Send exactly one immediate, scheduled, or imported billing_start branch.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED: The canceled subscription cannot be changed. Create a new subscription for a new agreement.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_MISMATCH: The stripe.confirmation_token cannot be kept for the subscription's renewals, so nothing was charged. Create the stripe.confirmation_token from a card or wallet with setup_future_usage off_session, then pay with a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_LINES_NOT_COMBINAB: Subscribed items with the same billing interval share one shipment, but these items ship separately, so one delivery choice can't cover them. Resume returns it as a 409 conflict when a paused subscription's items no longer ship together. In an order, give one of the items a different billing interval, or buy it once. In a subscription plan, put the items in separate plans. On a subscription, change the items' delivery profiles so they ship together, or replace or remove one of the items.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_METHOD_NOT_OFFERED: The plan does not offer the selected delivery method. Choose an eligible method returned by a subscription preview in delivery_options mode.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED: A delivery method cannot price unattended subscription renewals. Choose a shipment or local_delivery method that does not require caller_supplied rates or a delivery window.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_MIGRATION_IN_PROGR: A migration already moves subscribers off this method. Wait for the migration identified in details to finish before starting another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_MIGRATION_TARGET_U: The destination delivery method is not active. Choose an active shipment or local delivery method.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_PROFILE_ACTION_REQ: A physical subscription line's delivery profile needs configuration. Complete the delivery profile for the catalog variant identified in the error details, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_PROFILE_MISSING: A physical subscription line has no delivery profile. Assign a configured delivery profile to the catalog variant identified in the error details.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_REQUIRED: This subscription requires a delivery preference. Send delivery with a supported method, destination, and recipient.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: The selected delivery method cannot serve this subscription. Delivery and line item writes return it as a validation error; resume and renew return it as a 409 conflict when the stored delivery can no longer be used. Choose an offered delivery method that serves the address, or correct the address before retrying. If the rate is unavailable, retry later, update the delivery recipient, or contact the store.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_EXTERNAL_BILLING_ANCHOR_NOT: External billing schedules do not use a billing anchor day. Remove billing_anchor_day or select billing_schedule.owner flint.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_FULFILLMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED: A subscription line cannot ship or deliver through a delivery method. Give the line's catalog item a delivery profile that allows shipment or local_delivery, or remove the line from the subscription. Recurring pickup and scheduled delivery windows are not supported.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_IMPORT_PERIOD_NOT_CURRENT: The imported paid period does not cover the current time. Provide the start of a paid period whose computed end is still in the future.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_INITIATED_BY_INVALID: The schedule mutation does not identify a supported initiator. Set initiated_by to buyer, merchant, or integration.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_MODE: A payment link that uses a subscription plan cannot replace its line_items. Remove line_items from the request. Change the subscription plan's line items instead.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_NEXT_BILLING_AT_BEFORE_PERI: The requested next billing time is before the current subscription period starts. Set next_billing_at to current_period_start_at or a later time.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_NEXT_BILLING_AT_NOT_FUTURE: The requested next billing time is not in the future. Provide the earliest acceptable future next_billing_at value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_NEXT_BILLING_AT_TOO_FAR: The Flint-owned billing date moves more than one plan interval forward. Choose a date within one plan interval or pause the subscription.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_ARCHIVED: The subscription offer has been archived. Create another offer. Archived offers cannot be changed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_NOT_ACTIVE: The subscription offer is not active. Choose an active offer or purchase this line once.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_ORDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Subscribing to an item through an offer starts its own subscription, so it needs an order that isn't already part of a subscription, a subscription plan checkout, an invoice, or a quick payment. Remove the subscription from the line, or sell the subscribed item in its own checkout.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_PROMOTION_NOT_FOREVER: The offer promotion does not have forever recurrence. Choose a promotion with recurrence.type set to forever.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_PROMOTION_UNAVAILABLE: The offer promotion is archived, disabled, expired, not yet started, used up (max_uses reached), or its targeting excludes the offer products and variants. Choose a promotion that can apply without a code to new subscribers.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_TARGET_CONFLICT: A catalog target already has an active subscription offer. Change the target or deactivate the offer identified in details before retrying.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_OFFER_VARIANT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The variant is not included in this subscription offer. Choose an active variant matched by the offer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_IN_PROGRESS: A payment retry is already in progress for this subscription. Poll the current payment retry until it succeeds or fails before starting another.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED: This subscription has reached 3 payment retries for the current billing period, including retries started by the store. Contact the store for help recovering the past-due payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED: A manual payment retry is only available for a past-due subscription. Fetch the subscription and create a retry only while its status is past_due.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_QUANTITY_NOT_OFFERED: The plan does not offer the selected quantity. Choose a quantity from the plan's quantity_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_RENEW_NOT_ALLOWED: The subscription's current status does not allow an immediate renewal. Read the current status and resolve the subscription's delivery or payment issue before renewing.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE_CLEAR_NOT_ALLOWED: A Flint-owned schedule cannot clear its next billing date. Provide next_billing_at or transfer the schedule to external ownership.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_SCHEDULE_MUTATION_NOT_ALLOW: The subscription lifecycle state blocks the schedule mutation. Read the current status in error details and wait for recovery or choose a lifecycle action that applies.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_SERVICE_LOCATION_INVALID: The subscription service location is missing, mixed, or belongs to another customer. Send one valid service_location source owned by the subscription customer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_STARTS_AT_NOT_FUTURE: The scheduled subscription start is not in the future. Set billing_start.starts_at to a future RFC3339 timestamp.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_STARTS_AT_TRIAL_CONFLICT: A scheduled start cannot be combined with a plan trial. Use an immediate start for the trial or use a plan without a trial.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_START_OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED: A paid checkout cannot use a scheduled or imported subscription start. Use the immediate billing_start branch for a checkout that already collected payment.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_TRIAL_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PHY: Physical subscription plans cannot have a free trial. Remove trial_period_days and use a once promotion for a first-shipment discount.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUBSET_ONLY_VIOLATION: The new value includes options outside the set an organization settings policy allows. Send only values the organization allows for the setting identified by param, or ask the organization to change its settings policy.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUGGESTED_AMOUNT_ABOVE_MAX: A suggested donation amount is greater than donation_max_amount_money. Set each donation_suggested_amount_money_options amount at or below donation_max_amount_money, or raise the maximum.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUGGESTED_AMOUNT_BELOW_MIN: A suggested donation amount is less than donation_min_amount_money. Set each donation_suggested_amount_money_options amount at or above donation_min_amount_money, or lower the minimum.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SUGGESTED_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: A line item's suggested price is outside its min_unit_price_money and max_unit_price_money range. Set each suggested_unit_price_money_options amount between min_unit_price_money and max_unit_price_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.SWAP_NOT_ALLOWED: The store doesn't offer other items for this subscription line. Swap only to a variant listed in the line's plan swap_variants.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_ADJUSTMENT_AUDIT_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_M: tax_adjustment_audit is set on a line item whose tax_refund_mode is automatic. Set tax_refund_mode to explicit, or remove tax_adjustment_audit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_: tax_adjustment_reason is set on a line item whose tax_refund_mode is automatic. Set tax_refund_mode to explicit, or remove tax_adjustment_reason.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_MODE: Tax cannot be withheld through refund_adjustments. Remove the tax_adjustment or applies_to tax adjustment. To refund less tax, set tax_refund_mode to explicit with tax_money, tax_adjustment_reason, and tax_adjustment_audit.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_LINE_ITEM_MISMATCH: A tax_breakdown_id in the line's tax_breakdown_refunds belongs to a different line item or currency. Use tax_breakdown_id values from this line item's tax breakdowns.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_NOT_ORDER_SCOPED_FLAT: The selected tax breakdown is not an order-scoped additive flat tax. Use a flat tax_breakdown_id from the original order, or refund percentage tax through its line allocation.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUNDS_REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_M: tax_breakdown_refunds is set on a line item whose tax_refund_mode is automatic. Set tax_refund_mode to explicit with tax_money, or remove tax_breakdown_refunds.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUNDS_WITHOUT_TAX: The line item sends tax_breakdown_refunds, but the refund returns no tax for that line. Remove tax_breakdown_refunds from the line, or send a positive tax_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUND_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The tax refund is more than the jurisdiction tax that remains refundable. Read the order's tax breakdowns and refunds, and refund no more tax than remains for each tax_breakdown_id.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_REFUND_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The line item's tax_breakdown_refunds do not add up to its tax_money. Make the tax_breakdown_refunds[].tax_money amounts sum to the line's tax_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_TARGETS_EXCEED_REFUND_AMOU: Tax breakdown refund targets exceed the requested refund amount. Increase amount_money or remove tax breakdown targets.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_BREAKDOWN_UNAVAILABLE: The line item's tax has no jurisdiction breakdown, so tax_breakdown_refunds cannot be applied. Remove tax_breakdown_refunds from the line and refund its tax with tax_money only.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_CALCULATION_NOT_ALLOWED: A line item or charge tax calculation was supplied while the order uses automatic tax or tax is disabled. Use external tax for the order. On order PATCH, send calculations in tax.line_item_calculations and tax.charge_calculations in the same request that switches to external tax.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_CALCULATION_REQUIRED: External tax is missing a calculation for a line item or charge with an amount, including non-taxable ones. Provide tax.calculation for each line item and charge with an amount, including non-taxable ones. Read details[].param for each affected field; order_line_item_id or order_charge_id identifies the component already on the order.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: Live payments are paused until a supported automatic tax category is chosen. Choose a supported automatic tax category in tax settings.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_INPUT_CONFLICT: The tax input disables tax and also supplies a calculation or location. Set tax.enabled to true, or omit tax.calculation and tax.location.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_MONEY_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_MODE: tax_money is set on a line item whose tax_refund_mode is automatic. Set tax_refund_mode to explicit, or remove tax_money.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TAX_REFUND_EXCEEDS_AUTOMATIC: The explicit tax_money is more than the tax the line would refund automatically. Send a tax_money amount below the line's automatic tax refund, or use tax_refund_mode automatic.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TEST_PROCESSOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: The merchant has not connected a test payment processor account. Connect a test processor account for this environment, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TICKET_PREFIX_LOCKED: event_config.ticket_prefix cannot change after the event has issued tickets. Keep the current ticket_prefix, or create a new event payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TICKET_PREFIX_TOO_LONG: event_config.ticket_prefix is longer than 5 characters. Shorten event_config.ticket_prefix to 5 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TIP_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: The balance left to collect is smaller than the order's unpaid tip, so no payment can carry the tip. A manual payment usually covered part of the tip without recording it. Contact support with the request_id to record the tip.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TIP_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A tip amount uses a different currency from the order, checkout session, or payment amount it belongs to, or from the other configured tip amounts. Send tip amounts in the currency of the order, checkout session, or amount_money, and configured tip amounts in one currency.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TIP_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: The tip is larger than the payment amount it belongs to. Send a tip no larger than amount_money. The tip is part of amount_money, not added to it.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TIP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The requested tip is above the maximum allowed for the order. Use a requested tip no greater than maximum_money, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TOO_MANY_CUSTOM_FIELDS: The payment link has more than 20 custom fields. Send 20 or fewer custom_fields.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TOO_MANY_LINE_ITEMS: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TOO_MANY_SUGGESTED_AMOUNTS: More than 3 suggested amounts were provided. Send at most 3 entries in donation_suggested_amount_money_options or line_items[].suggested_unit_price_money_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TRANSACTION_PURPOSE_NOT_APPLICABLE: The request supplied an ACH-only field without requesting ACH Direct Debit. Remove transaction_purpose or include ach_debit in payment_options.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TRIAL_NEGATIVE: The trial period is negative. Send a trial_period_days value from 0 through 365.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.TRIAL_TOO_LONG: The trial period is longer than 365 days. Send a trial_period_days value from 0 through 365.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE: A promotion rule uses an unknown attribute. Use a documented promotion rule attribute or a metadata.<key> attribute.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_BUNDLE_COMPONENT: The bundle component ID does not belong to this bundle. Use a bundle_component_id returned for this bundle, or omit it to create a new component.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_CUSTOM_FIELD_KEY: custom_field_values has a key that is not a custom field on the payment link. Use only custom field keys from the payment link.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_FIELD: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Remove or correct the unknown field. If you send a corrected write, use a new idempotency key.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_LINE_ITEM_KEY: An override names a line item key that is not on the payment link. Use only line item keys from the payment link in quantity_overrides and unit_price_overrides.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_OPTION: The option ID does not belong to this product. Use an option_id returned for this product, or omit it to create a new option.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_OPTION_VALUE: The option value ID does not belong to this option. Use an option_value_id returned for this option, or omit it to create a new value.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_LINK_CUSTOM_FIELD_ID: The payment_link_custom_field_id does not identify a custom field on this payment link. Use a payment_link_custom_field_id from this payment link, or omit it to create a new custom field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_LINK_LINE_ITEM_ID: The payment_link_line_item_id does not identify a line item on this payment link. Use a payment_link_line_item_id from this payment link, or omit it to create a new line item.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_PREDICATE_FIELD: A risk rule predicate node contains a field it does not accept. Remove the field named by param from the predicate node.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_RULE_VALUE: A promotion rule value is not allowed for its attribute. Use one of the values listed in the message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_SCOPE: The request includes a scope that is not in Flint's public scope catalog. Use a canonical scope from the API key scope catalog and retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSAFE_FEEDBACK_CONTENT: The feedback contains unsafe control characters, credentials, or secret material. Remove secrets and unsafe characters, then submit only the evidence needed to describe the behavior.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_APPLICATION_TYPE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE: The request body used an unsupported Content-Type. Send JSON request bodies with Content-Type: application/json, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_PREVIEW_DISCOUNT: Discount previews support only promotion discounts. Send discount.promotion with a promotion_id or promotion_code, or omit discount to preview automatic promotions.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_PROCESSOR: This merchant environment has no supported payment processor account yet. Complete account setup for this environment through onboarding, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCT_FIELD: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM: The request included a query parameter this endpoint does not support. Remove the unsupported query parameter or use a documented accepted expand encoding.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_RESOURCE_TYPE: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.UPDATE_MASK_REQUIRED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.URL_TOO_LONG: A legal policy URL is longer than 2,048 characters. Send the URL identified by param with 2,048 characters or fewer.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VALUE_REQUIRED: A product option value label is missing. Provide a non-empty value label.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VALUE_TOO_LONG: A text value is longer than its field allows. Shorten the value identified by param to the maximum length in the error message.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VARIANT_NOT_SELLABLE: The variant or its product is inactive or unavailable for sale. Choose a sellable variant or activate the product and variant and make the variant available for sale.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VERIFICATION_ALREADY_USED: The request could not be authenticated. Send a valid Flint credential supported by this endpoint, then retry.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: The verification token has reached its incorrect-code limit. Call POST /v1/onboarding/start to send a new code, then verify with the new token.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.VERSION_CONFLICT: The expected_version, or another expected_* value, in the request is stale because the resource changed after the caller read it. Inventory count apply also uses this code for a stale saved physical observation; those conflicts omit param because the current action request has no physical assertion field. Read the resource again, rebuild the change from its current state, and send the new version in the same field.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_IN_FLIGHT: The webhook delivery is already being processed. Wait for the active delivery attempt to finish, then retry the resend if needed.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_ACTIVE: The webhook endpoint is inactive. Set the endpoint status to active and resolve any endpoint configuration issue before resending.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_EVENT_PAYLOAD_EXPIRED: The retained webhook event payload has expired. Use a newer webhook event. Expired payloads cannot be resent.
x-flint-enum-descriptions.WEEKLY_PAYOUT_DAYS_NOT_ALLOWED: The request payload or query parameters did not pass validation. Fix the field identified by the error response, then retry.

Do not retry automatically. Correct the request or follow next_steps or next_actions.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

order_id.description: Order this payment intent belongs to. When it is set, create, confirm, capture, and cancel the payment through the order's routes; the standalone payment intent routes return ORDER_PAYMENT_FLOW_REQUIRED.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

x-enum-descriptions: Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. No webhook is sent for this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. cancellation_reason is authorization_expired, and the payment_intent.canceled event reports it.

next_billing_at.description: When Flint next starts a scheduled renewal charge, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while a trialing or active subscription has a billing date and isn't set to cancel at the end of its period. Absent when no renewal is scheduled: a paused subscription resumes at scheduled_resume_at, a past_due one reports the failed billing date in missed_billing_at and retries at next_retry_at, an incomplete one retries at next_retry_at, a scheduled start begins at starts_at, one set to cancel ends at current_period_end_at, and an external schedule awaiting a date reports awaiting_billing_schedule.

status.description:
Public work status. Fulfillments with request_status accepted project to status pending. Fulfillments with outcome.outcome_type no_show project to status failed. A fulfillment with active_hold projects to its public work status from before the hold.
- `pending`: Work has not started. Start, schedule, accept, hold, cancel, or fail it as supported_actions allows.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page where you render this embedded checkout, such as https://shop.example.com. Only this origin can show the checkout's gift card challenge and receive its result. It does not let the browser call the Flint API. Accepted only when surface is embedded. Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

redirects.description: Buyer destinations. Embedded checkout requires success_redirect_url when a redirect payment option is offered. Keep return_url and redirects.success_redirect_url consistent when sending both.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the buyer after paying, such as the Return's page in the customer account. Limited to 2048 characters (Unicode code points) before trimming surrounding whitespace. It must be an HTTPS address of the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url when the merchant hosts the account. HTTP is accepted only for localhost in test mode. Anything else fails with INVALID_RETURN_URL.

surface.description: Defaults to hosted. The same surface reuses the open checkout. A different surface replaces it only while no payment is in progress; otherwise the request returns CHECKOUT_SURFACE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED.

GiftCard.description: Merchant-issued purchased gift card. Posted balance includes reserved value; available value is balance minus reservations. Frozen value remains part of outstanding liability. Gift cards are independent resources and cannot be transferred across merchants or currencies.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

restrictions.description: The restrictions that keep the card frozen. unfreeze is supported only when every restriction is merchant_freeze. A funding_dispute with dispute_status lost needs a gift card funding disposition.

dispute_amount_money.description: The whole disputed payment amount, which can include consideration for other purchases. It is separate from the original gift card consideration and honored face value.

external_reference_id.description: Your reference for the payment or import record that funded this value, such as a POS sale ID. Required; 1 to 255 characters.

payment_intent_id.description: For standalone funding, use a captured payment intent without an order_id. Order-linked payments fund purchased cards through their original order.

GiftCardLoad.description: Independent funding resource. Value and consideration are separate. External funding and import provenance are merchant-attested; no payment is collected by recording them. Replacement refund lots retain original funding provenance and do not represent new paid funding.

funding_disputes.description: Restrictions tied to original funding, including value restored to replacement cards. A win clears only its own restriction. A loss keeps spending restricted until you create a gift card funding disposition.

idempotency_key.description: Your Idempotency-Key for the command that created this record. null when Flint created it or no key was sent.

purchase_refund_value_holds.description: Pending original cash refunds holding unspent value on this descendant funding lot. Unknown provider outcomes retain these holds.

purchase_refunds.description: Cash refunds and manual payment reversals against this original funding load. Pending refunds reserve their value; confirmed success removes it, and confirmed failure releases the hold.

delivery.description: Included on notification retrieval. Contains the most recent sending attempts and delivery events, newest first. A failed attempt describes the send call; use notification.status to determine whether acceptance remains unconfirmed.

dispute_id.description: Present only for type funding_dispute. The dispute on the payment that funded value on this card.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the order, in this order: start_return, then resend_receipt. A buyer's read through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists both every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. A list of orders leaves start_return out, since only a read of one order checks return eligibility. start_return is due when the last open return window ends.

buyer_contact.description: Email and phone saved when payment started, from the pay request's buyer_contact or the paying checkout session's saved contact. It does not change the linked customer.

closed_reason_message.description: The note supplied when the order was closed. It is not shown to the buyer.

delivery_destination.description: The shipment or local-delivery destination committed for this order. Payment freezes this value; fulfillment recipient changes do not replace it. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order, including pickup choices without a delivery destination. Read with GET /v1/orders/{order_id}; other order responses may omit this field. While present, change the destination through the delivery selection. Omitted when no selection governs the order.

inventory_exception_reason.description: Why inventory could not be committed after payment, or how the exception was resolved. Omitted when no reason was recorded. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.

inventory_reservation_id.description: The reservation holding stock for this order, when one exists.

inventory_routing_source.description: Where this order's tracked demand is routed. Required before an order containing tracked variants can hold stock.

payment_link_id.description: Payment link whose checkout created this order. Absent for orders that did not come from a payment link. Filter GET /v1/orders by payment_link_id to list a link's orders.

return_credit_settlements.description: Value applied to this order from items the buyer returned, such as an exchange's replacement order. Included in settlement_amounts.paid_money.

return_resolution_id.description: ID of the return resolution that created this order as a replacement. Omitted for orders a return did not create.

subscription_cycle.description: Charged subscription cycle associated with this order. Signup is cycle 1; unpaid retries and skipped renewals do not advance the cycle.

subscription_delivery_changed_at.description: Time the subscriber changed delivery after this paid renewal was prepared. The order keeps its committed destination until you correct it or refund and replace it.

ticketed_event.description: Event and tickets this order sold through an event payment link. Absent on other orders.

version.description: Order version for optimistic concurrency. Send this value as the expected version when changing the order.

activity_type.description: The action recorded on the order. Omitted when the activity type cannot be identified. Clients must accept values added in future releases.

assigned_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by a non-terminal fulfillment, including a fulfillment on hold.

bundle_component_id.description: ID of the bundle component these quantities describe. Omitted for a single item.

canceled_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by canceled or no_show fulfillments.

failed_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by failed fulfillments that kept their quantity. Failed fulfillments that released quantity own nothing; their quantity becomes unassigned again.

fulfilled_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Quantity owned by completed fulfillments.

required_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Total quantity requiring fulfillment, in line units for a single item or component units for a bundle component. Equals the sum of the other five quantity fields.

unassigned_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported. Required quantity owned by no fulfillment, in any resolution mode. Includes quantity released by a failed fulfillment.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

pause_duration_cycles.description: Billing cycles to pause for, at least 1. Omit it to pause until the subscription is resumed. A pause with a duration resumes automatically at scheduled_resume_at. Repeating the same pause length returns the paused subscription; changing the length requires resuming first. When the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.pause.max_cycles is set, a buyer must send a value from 1 to that limit.

buyer_contact.description: Buyer email and phone recorded on the order. A checkout session payment uses the session's saved contact for omitted fields. Email and phone cannot be null.

expected_outstanding_money.description: The outstanding balance you reviewed. Required with checkout credentials, and with an API key or partner token when the order has an open checkout session. Optional otherwise.

expected_version.description: Optional version from the order you reviewed. A mismatch returns ORDER_CHANGED_REFRESH_REQUIRED, even when the outstanding amount is unchanged. Starting a payment advances the order's version. After a declined or failed attempt, use the order returned in the pay response or read the order again before retrying. When accepted_gift_card_allocation is sent, its order_version must match this value.

save_payment_method.description: The buyer's choice to save the card they typed for faster checkout at this merchant. Send true only from the checkout session's own credential, when the session's can_save_payment_method is true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, for one newly collected card sent as stripe.confirmation_token created with setup_future_usage on_session. The card is saved with usage on_session once the payment succeeds, for the customer the checkout acts for: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. A typed buyer_contact.email never decides it. A checkout that acts for no customer refuses the save until the buyer confirms their email with a code, unless it sends save_payment_method_phone. A checkout the buyer bound by a texted code saves the card with that number. A checkout whose buyer confirmed the customer's email can also send save_payment_method_phone, to save the card with a number the buyer confirms by text after paying. A checkout can send the buyer's choice with every payment button: Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, in stripe.confirmation_token created with no setup_future_usage, pays without the save, and the payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved with reason payment_method_not_saveable. The session's save_payment_method_types lists what is saved. Send false or omit it when the buyer does not choose to save; stripe.confirmation_token must then have no setup_future_usage.

save_payment_method_phone.description: A US or Canadian mobile phone number in E.164 format, such as +14155552671, that confirms a card saved while the checkout acts for no customer, or for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Send it with save_payment_method: true only from the checkout session's own credential, when the session's can_save_payment_method_with_phone is true. The card is kept for the customer the checkout acts for, or else the merchant's customer with the buyer's email, once the payment succeeds, or once it is approved when the merchant captures later, but works for nothing until the buyer confirms it within 24 hours, with a code texted to this number or, when the customer's email is the email of the payment, emailed there instead: request the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications and purpose confirm_saved_payment_method, and read payment_method_save on the checkout session. A card saved with the number makes it the customer's saved number, and the cards saved with the number it replaces are removed. A card not confirmed in time is not saved.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Capture is unavailable at or after this time, even if the payment still has requires_capture status.

capturable_money.description: Payment intent's stored capturable amount. A positive amount does not override authorization_expires_at or the payment status.

selected_payment_option.description: Payment option used by this leg, using the same values as PaymentIntent.selected_payment_option. Fixed when the attempt becomes terminal. Omitted when no payment option has been selected.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. No webhook is sent for this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. cancellation_reason is authorization_expired, and the payment_intent.canceled event reports it.

PaymentClientAction.description: Typed provider-specific browser action payload. Execute the selected provider action before continuing the owning payment through Flint.

PaymentCollectionStripeElements.description: Stripe Elements collection guidance. Follow next_step in the browser, then submit the result to submit_to through Flint.

mode.description: Whether Elements is collecting a payment source for an immediate payment or a setup source for future use.

next_step.description: Browser collection operation to perform before calling submit_to.

payment_method_creation.description: Stripe Elements payment method creation mode. Follow next_step: standalone PaymentIntents and checkout-authenticated order collection create a ConfirmationToken, while merchant-authenticated order collection and setup collection create a PaymentMethod.

submit_to.description: Flint operation that accepts the result of next_step.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

message.description: Flint-authored merchant-facing payment failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

PaymentIntent.description: One payment from a buyer, standalone or as a leg of an order. amount_money is the amount requested. Once the payment is authorized, authorized_money equals amount_money and splits into captured_money (collected), capturable_money (still on hold), and released_money (returned without being charged), so authorized_money always equals the sum of those three. Reconcile revenue from captured_money.

add_on_fees.description: Itemized invoice, subscription, and automatic tax fees collected with this payment. Available to the merchant only. Empty until fees settle or when no add-ons apply. Refunds do not return or revise these fees. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Deadline to capture a manual-capture hold. The authorization lapses at this time, and a capture attempted after it fails even if status is still requires_capture. Set when the hold is placed.

authorized_at.description: When the processor authorized the payment. Absent until then.

authorized_money.description: The amount the processor authorized. It always equals amount_money and doesn't change once set. Absent until the payment is authorized, and on payments canceled before authorization.

cancellation_reason.description: Flint-normalized reason the payment intent was canceled. Unknown processor values are returned as payment_canceled.

capturable_money.description: The part of the authorization you can still capture. Positive only while status is requires_capture, and zero after you capture or cancel or the authorization expires. The authorization lapses at authorization_expires_at, and a capture attempted after that fails even if this is positive. Absent until the payment is authorized.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

captured_at.description: When money was captured. For automatic capture, this is when the payment succeeded. Absent until capture.

captured_money.description: The amount collected from the buyer. Reconcile revenue and print receipts from this amount, not amount_money. Zero while a hold is open, and positive whenever status is succeeded. processing_fee_money, merchant_net_money, and refunds are based on it. Absent until the payment is authorized.

checkout_session_id.description: Flint checkout session ID associated with this payment, when present.

current_payment_action.description: Typed browser authority for the current standalone payment action. Complete it, then call the same confirm endpoint without a replacement credential. Null when no buyer action is needed, and always null for a credential without the payments.payment_intents.write scope. With that scope, it can also be null while status is requires_action if Flint cannot produce the action yet; retrieve the payment intent again.

customer.description: The linked customer. Returned only with expand=customer.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

dispute_status.description: Dispute state of this payment. none means no dispute or inquiry is open or recorded. The inquiry_ values track an issuer inquiry or early warning that isn't a chargeback. Read the dispute with GET /v1/disputes for its deadline and evidence.
x-enum-descriptions: No dispute is recorded for this payment.
The issuer asked for information before any chargeback. Respond by evidence_due_at.
You responded to the inquiry and the issuer is reviewing it.
The inquiry closed without becoming a chargeback. Final.
A chargeback is open and needs your response by evidence_due_at.
Evidence was submitted and the bank is deciding.
Decided against you, or a bank return that could not be contested. Final.
Resolved before it became a chargeback. Final.
Flint received a dispute state it does not recognize yet. Not final. Treat the dispute as open, do not assume an outcome, and read it again later. A response session still opens.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment_hold.description: Present when a payment provider asked Flint to pause fulfillment for this payment. While its status is active, open fulfillments on the order are on hold with reason payment_review. payment_intent.fulfillment_hold_updated is sent when the hold starts and when it lifts.

invoice.description: The linked invoice. Returned only with expand=invoice.

invoice_id.description: Invoice this payment intent collects, when it pays an invoice.

last_payment_error.description: Most recent payment error. Null when no payment error is recorded.

merchant_id.description: Merchant that owns this payment intent.

merchant_net_money.description: Captured amount minus processing_fee_money and every amount in add_on_fees. Later merchant assessments and credits are separate balance effects. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint and aren't returned.

order.description: The linked order. Returned only with expand=order.

order_id.description: Order this payment intent belongs to. When it is set, create, confirm, capture, and cancel the payment through the order's routes; the standalone payment intent routes return ORDER_PAYMENT_FLOW_REQUIRED.

payment_flow.description: How the payment was started. Fixed when the payment intent is created.
x-enum-descriptions: Started in a Flint checkout session.
The first payment of a subscription.
Entered in the Dashboard virtual terminal.
Created by your integration through the API.

payment_options.description: Payment options the buyer can use for this payment.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

processing_fee_money.description: Flint's all-in processing fee for this payment. It is the complete price Flint charges to process the payment, never a provider cost passed through. The fee is final once the card payment is captured or the ACH payment succeeds; canceled payments and failures before success have none. Invoice, subscription, and automatic tax fees are itemized separately in add_on_fees. Your net for the payment is captured_money minus this fee and the add-on fees. Refunds do not return or revise it. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

receipt_email.description: Email address for this payment's receipt. When it isn't set, Flint uses the customer's email.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

refunded_money.description: Total of refunds against captured_money that the processor has accepted, including refunds still pending. Failed and canceled refunds aren't counted. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

released_money.description: The part of the authorization returned to the buyer without being charged: the uncaptured remainder after a partial capture, or the whole authorization after a cancellation or expiry. It was never collected, so it needs no refund and can't be captured later. Absent until the payment is authorized.

return_id.description: Flint return ID associated with this payment, when present.

risk.description: Risk assessment. Always present with merchant credentials; null when no risk assessment is available. Omitted with the checkout credential.

selected_payment_option.description: The payment option the most recent confirmation used. Absent until the payment intent is first confirmed.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money.

transaction_purpose.description: Why a bank debit is taken. Set only when payment_options includes ach_debit, and fixed once the payment intent exists.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with an empty body for a standalone payment intent. No webhook is sent for this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. current_payment_action describes the step. Afterward, call confirm with an empty body, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.
Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. cancellation_reason is authorization_expired, and the payment_intent.canceled event reports it.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money.

transaction_purpose.description: Why a bank debit is taken. Set only when payment_options includes ach_debit, and fixed once the payment intent exists.

PaymentLimitSettings.description: Optional merchant limits that can lower Flint's payment-option and surface policy limits.

max_amounts.description: Maximum USD amounts keyed by default, surface, or an exact payment_option.surface selector. Merchant settings cannot raise Flint's policy ceiling.

min_amounts.description: Minimum USD amounts keyed by default, surface, or an exact payment_option.surface selector. Merchant settings cannot lower Flint's payment-option floor.

max_amounts.description: Replaces this merchant limit map. Keys are default, a surface, payment_option.default, or payment_option.surface. Amounts must satisfy Flint's existing selector bounds and effective minimum/maximum range. Send null to clear this map; reads then omit it.

min_amounts.description: Replaces this merchant limit map. Keys are default, a surface, payment_option.default, or payment_option.surface. Amounts must satisfy Flint's existing selector bounds and effective minimum/maximum range. Send null to clear this map; reads then omit it.

delivery_method_ids.description: Delivery methods the link offers. Empty when the link has none, and then its checkouts offer settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids when the order has items to deliver.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

sales_end_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp after which the link stops starting checkouts and resolve returns PAYMENT_LINK_SALES_ENDED. Unset means sales do not end on their own, except that an event link without sales_end_at stops selling at event_config.event_at. A checkout opened before the end can still start payment for up to 15 minutes after it.

sales_summary.description: Present only with expand=sales_summary on GET /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}; not supported on the list route. Available to merchant callers, including dashboard sessions and API keys with checkouts.payment_links.read. Uses the same paid-order definition as the merchant sales summary.

total_quantity_sold.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

key.description: Unique custom field key. Must not have leading or trailing whitespace. Buyer answers are stored in order metadata as custom_field_<key>.

max_length.description: Maximum answer length for text and textarea fields, counted in Unicode code points. Defaults to 255 for text and 1000 for textarea when omitted. Each code point can occupy up to four UTF-8 bytes in the combined metadata size budget.

options.description: Dropdown choices. Dropdown fields require at least one option. Options must not have leading or trailing whitespace. The longest option in UTF-8 bytes counts toward the combined metadata size budget.

payment_link_custom_field_id.description: Stable ID of an existing custom field. Omit it to create a new custom field.

PaymentLinkCustomerConfig.description: What each checkout the payment link starts asks the buyer for. Omit a field to use your checkout settings. A shipping address is collected when the buyer picks a delivery option that ships, not by a setting here.

address_autocomplete_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers address suggestions while the buyer enters an address.

require_billing_address.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's billing address.

require_email.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's email address. Event and subscription links always require it.

require_phone.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's phone number.

max_total_quantity.description: Most tickets the event sells across all orders. Absent means no limit. On update, send null to remove the limit; a value below the tickets already sold or held by payments in progress returns MAX_TOTAL_QUANTITY_BELOW_SOLD. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

ticket_prefix.description: Prefix for ticket numbers, up to 5 characters. It cannot change after the event has issued tickets.

On update, send null to remove the limit; a value below the tickets already sold or held by payments in progress returns MAX_TOTAL_QUANTITY_BELOW_SOLD. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

PaymentLinkExpirationConfig.description: Lifetime of each checkout session the payment link starts, not of the payment link itself. The link keeps taking new checkouts after a session expires. To stop the link selling at a set time, use sales_end_at.

expiration_url.description: Optional URL to send a buyer to when their checkout session expires.

expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds each checkout session started from the link stays open, from 60 to 86,400. Defaults to your checkout settings, or 24 hours. This does not end the payment link; use sales_end_at for that.

PaymentLinkExpirationPatchInput.description: Lifetime of each checkout session the payment link starts, not of the payment link itself. The link keeps taking new checkouts after a session expires. To stop the link selling at a set time, use sales_end_at.

is_catalog_item_unavailable.description: True when this line item references a variant or bundle that is missing, deleted, or inactive, so it cannot be sold right now. Always false on ad-hoc line items.

key.description: Stable line item key used in checkout overrides. Must not have leading or trailing whitespace. Assigned as line_item_1, line_item_2, and so on when omitted, skipping numbers already used by explicit keys; retained for an existing line item when omitted on update.

max_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

min_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

resolved_name.description: Current catalog name of the referenced variant or bundle. A variant reads as the product name, plus the variant name when the variant is a named option combination. This is the catalog value at read time, not a stored snapshot: checkout resolves it again when a buyer opens the link. Absent on ad-hoc line items and when the catalog object no longer exists.

resolved_unit_price_money.description: Current catalog unit price of the referenced variant or bundle. This is the catalog value at read time, not a stored snapshot: checkout resolves the price again when a buyer opens the link, so the amount a buyer pays can differ. Absent on ad-hoc line items and when the catalog object no longer exists.

key.description: Stable line item key used in checkout overrides. Must not have leading or trailing whitespace. Assigned as line_item_1, line_item_2, and so on when omitted, skipping numbers already used by explicit keys; retained for an existing line item when omitted on update.

max_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

min_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.
